plans.text: # EZD-5603 · Assistant panel, states and photo (split proposal) - **ACs:** AC-EZD-5603-1 … AC-EZD-5603-14 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:1839-1852`, stage-0). Each AC goes to one part below. AC-10, AC-12, AC-13 and AC-14 are split by clause (see the AC map). AC-10's Accept, Adjust and Reject clause is mapped to EZD-5604, whose plan adds the three buttons to its `expectTouchTargets` test (Q-0651 (a); note for TRACE and the AC map). - **Complexity:** high (both parts); reasons per part - **Areas:** ui, testing, security, api, dependencies - **User-visible result:** An Assistant button on the plan's rail opens a panel where the inspector sits. Josh types a prompt, picks Sonnet or Opus, and reads a plain-text reply with what it cost and the session total. With no key, a bad key or no credit, the panel says so plainly and links to My profile. The prompt is never lost. A photo (JPG, PNG, HEIC or WebP, up to 20 MB) can go with one prompt. It is shrunk in the browser and stripped of location data on the server before Anthropic sees it. - Phase: 56 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: split proposal ## Split proposal **Why.** Planned whole, the ticket would touch about 28 files and need about 36 tests. That is over the size rule (PROCESS.md section 6 "Ticket size": about 20 files or 25 tests; Josh 2026-10-22). Where the count comes from: - **14 stage-0 ACs, five of them compound.** AC-12 has five clauses and AC-14 has four. - **A new screen region.** The panel goes in the inspector's place (Q-0474; board S03c aside 336 px, `S03cAIAssistant.dc.html:150`). It has: - a header, the conversation, the prompt box, the model picker and the cost line; - three key states: No key, key refused and out of credit (boards S03cAIAssistantNoKey and S03cAIAssistantKeyError; Q-0638 gaps 13 and 6); - the waiting state, the network and provider failure lines (Q-0637 wording row; 3a); - My profile mounted over the editor (Q-0638 gap 12); - the outbox drain before each prompt (Q-0638 gap 9; Q-0640 row 56-7; Q-0641 row 56-7); - the selection sent with a prompt (Q-0640 row 56-2); - history caps (Q-0638 gaps 7 and 9). - **A rail change.** `RailTool.shortcut` is required today (`app/src/components/shell/rail-types.ts:10`), but the Assistant's tooltip on the board has no key (`S03cAIAssistant.png`). `ToolRail` also has a single `activeId` (`ToolRail.tsx:7-19`), but the Assistant is pressed while a drawing tool stays active. - **A photo pipeline across browser and server.** In the browser: - the type and size checks (A4, A5); - a shrink to JPEG (long edge at most 1,568 px, at most 3,500,000 bytes); - HEIC conversion, which needs a decoder that the boundary rules make a lazy module (ARCH Entry points and lazy modules: `HEAVY_PACKAGES`, `app/src/lazy//`). On the server: - the JPEG magic-byte check; - a `sharp` re-encode with `limitInputPixels` that strips EXIF GPS and XMP; - an image block in the provider call for that one prompt only (Q-0637 photo row; Q-0638 gap 7). Two new direct dependencies need lines in docs/architecture.md (CLAUDE.md rule 7). Q-0637 asks for two checks first: whether `sharp` runs on the host, and how iOS handles HEIC. **Why cut here.** - The photo is the only part that crosses into server code and new dependencies. It changes EZD-5602's body reader at one marked branch: P5602 D-Body, "a `photo` entry → `photo_not_supported` (EZD-5603 replaces this branch with its strip)". It also changes the provider request content (P5602 D-Request). Part a uses EZD-5602's route as planned and changes no server code. This keeps part a's security surface to the browser only. - Part b needs part a's prompt box, send path and error mapping, so the order is a → b. EZD-5604 depends on the base number, so it waits for both parts (`vault/tickets/README.md`, "How tickets are written"). - Same pattern as EZD-213 and EZD-212: the screen first, then the piece with its own dependencies and checks. Each part is planned as its own unit from its section here. Each part plan applies the planner lessons for ui, testing, security, api and dependencies, notably: - L-021: grep the tests that pin the icon list (`app/src/components/shell/HeaderButton.icon.test.tsx`), the rail entries (`ToolRail.test.tsx`, `tool-defs.test.ts`) and the inspector region (`EmptyEditor.test.tsx`), and name each edit; - L-052: the empty, over-limit and malformed cases for the prompt and the photo; - L-054: checklist rows measured from the board HTML; - L-060: every new button in `expectTouchTargets` (`app/test-harness/touch-targets.ts:8`); - L-064: each fixture file named with its source, and each browser row with its Playwright project and command; - L-061: the photo's byte bound, with boundary values. ### Part EZD-5603a · Assistant panel, picker, states and cost line - **Scope:** - **rail button.** "Assistant" with the `auto_awesome` icon (already in `icon-names.generated.ts`) goes in the rail's bottom group (board S03c: `S03cAIAssistant.dc.html:83`, tooltip "Assistant" with no key). It is shown only with Edit model (Q-0474; Q-0638 gap 17; S03c Who sees it) and only on Plan (Q-0638 gap 13). It is pressed while the panel is open. `RailTool.shortcut` becomes optional; the tooltip `kbd` and `aria-keyshortcuts` render only when a shortcut is given (rail-types.ts, ToolRail.tsx). - **panel.** It goes in the `inspector` aside (`EditorFrame` props `inspector`, `inspectorLabel`: `app/src/components/shell/EditorFrame.tsx:11-21`) instead of EZD-213b's inspector, 336 px wide (board aside). With the panel open outside Adjust it stays until ×, a selection does not close it, and the inspector returns on close (Q-0640 row 56-8). - **header.** "Assistant" with the icon, the sub-line "Plan · runs on your Anthropic key", and × named "Close assistant" (S03c wording; Q-0638 gap 13). - **key state.** Read from `GET /api/profile` `aiKey: { last4 } | null` (P5601 section 3) when the panel opens, and again when My profile closes (Q-0638 gap 12). The part plan proposes the loading and read-failure lines under 3a. - **No key state.** Board S03cAIAssistantNoKey: the heading line, the body line, and "Open My profile" with `arrow_forward`. The prompt box and send are disabled (Q-0638 gap 13). Drawing by hand is unchanged (S03c States). - **Open My profile.** Mounts `MyProfileDialog` from `app/src/lazy/my-profile` over the editor through `lazyModule`, as `AvatarMenu.tsx:21,54` does (Q-0638 gap 12; ARCH lazy modules). The conversation and the prompt survive. - **conversation.** - An empty conversation shows only the prompt box (Q-0638 gap 13). - The user's prompt shows as a bubble. - A reply renders as plain text, with no links, images or markup (Q-0637; AC-9). - A text-only reply has no buttons (Q-0638 gap 13). - Under each reply is the cost line "This prompt: about $X · This session: $Y". It uses `formatUsd(costMicroUsd)` and `formatUsd(sessionTotalMicroUsd(costs))` from `app/src/lib/assistant/cost.ts` (P5602 section 3; 09l; S03c wording). - The session total covers this editor page load and is held in memory only (Q-0638 gap 13; 00f glossary "Session (Assistant)": this plan names its code name). - A billed `assistant_invalid_reply` adds its `costMicroUsd` to the session (Q-0638 gap 5; P5602 D-Map). - **model picker.** "Model · pick per prompt"; "Claude Sonnet 5.5 · about 2¢ a prompt" first, then "Claude Opus 5.5 · about 4¢ a prompt". The button shows "Sonnet 5.5" or "Opus 5.5", and its accessible name is "Model" (S03c wording; Q-0474; Q-0638 gap 13). The values are `'sonnet'` and `'opus'` (`ASSISTANT_MODELS`, P5602 step 5). After a send the picker keeps the last pick for the rest of this editor page load; each page load starts on Sonnet 5.5 (Q-0653 (a); Q-0474). - **send.** The request is `POST /api/projects/[id]/assistant`, multipart with one field `request` holding a JSON `AssistantInput` (`{ prompt, history, model, floorId, selectedIds }`, P5602 section 3 and step 11). The steps: 1. Drain the outbox (`OutboxSync.flush()`, `app/src/lib/outbox/outbox-sync.ts:51`) before every prompt. 2. If the drain fails, make no request. The prompt stays, and the normal save message shows (Q-0638 gap 9; Q-0640 row 56-7; Q-0641 row 56-7). 3. Read the selected ids from EZD-208's selection (Q-0640 rows 56-2 and 56-8). 4. While waiting, send is disabled and a waiting line shows (Q-0638 gap 13; wording under 3a). 5. When the tab closes or the panel unmounts, abort the request (Q-0637 call path). The send control is named "Send" (Q-0638 gap 13). The prompt is capped at 8,000 characters (P5602 D-Body). - **history.** - It holds only completed user and reply pairs, because the server needs alternating turns of even length (P5602 D-Body). - Each turn is cut to 2,000 characters. - Past 20 turns, the oldest pair is dropped (Q-0638 gaps 7 and 9). - History is text only. - **errors.** Each `error.code` from the route maps to a line (P5602 D-Map and section 6 keys): - `assistant_key_refused` and `assistant_out_of_credit` show the approved lines in the board's amber box with "Open My profile" (S03c wording; board S03cAIAssistantKeyError). - `assistant_no_key` shows the No key state. - Every other code shows its `message_key`; a network failure shows a line proposed under 3a. On every failure the prompt text stays in the box and the drawing is untouched (Q-0474; AC-4, AC-12). - **touch.** Send, the model picker and its options, × and Open My profile each have a tap target of at least 44 px with no keyboard (Q-0630 standing rule; S03d E; L-060). - **wording.** en and es catalog keys for every board string, plus Proposed wording for the waiting, loading, read-failure and network lines. - **Tests (about 22) and files (about 17):** - Component tests: the rail button for an editor and none for view-only; panel open and close with the inspector back; the No key state; key refused and out of credit; the cost line and session total with the 09l rows; plain-text rendering of a reply holding ``, `![x](y)` and ``; the picker; the waiting state; the history caps; the drain-failure path. - Earlier-test edits for the rail type and the inspector region (L-021). - Browser specs on the stub recordings (`ASSISTANT_RECORDINGS`, P5602 section 3), copied to `/anthropic/assistant.plan.json`: a text-only reply with its cost line; out of credit; and Open My profile followed by the key re-read. - Touch targets. - Files: `app/src/editor/assistant/` (the panel, the picker, the conversation, the session store, the client request), `ProjectEditor.tsx`, `DrawingTools.tsx` (rail bottom group), `rail-types.ts`, `ToolRail.tsx`, the en and es catalogs, `icon-names` and the sprite if a key or send icon is new, and the tests. - **Done when:** - An editor sees the Assistant button and a view-only user does not. Opening it shows the panel in the inspector's place with the board's title, sub-line and placeholder. × brings the inspector back. - The picker offers Sonnet 5.5 first, then Opus 5.5, with the board's wording, and the request carries the chosen model. - With no key, the No key text and "Open My profile" show and the prompt is disabled. - A refused key or no credit shows its approved line and "Open My profile". The prompt text stays, and the model is unchanged. - Under a reply, the cost line reads "This prompt: about $0.02 · This session: $0.04" after replies costing 20,000 and 20,000 micro-dollars (09l rows). - A reply holding a link or image markup shows it as text. - While waiting, send is disabled with the waiting line. After a 429, 5xx or timeout the prompt stays. - With 22 completed turns, the request holds the last 20. A 2,500-character reply goes into history as 2,000 characters. - A failed outbox drain makes no request, and the prompt stays. - The selection goes with the prompt as `selectedIds`. - My profile opens over the editor, and closing it re-reads the key state. - Every new control passes the 44 px check. - **ACs:** AC-EZD-5603-1, -2, -3, -4, -5, -9; AC-10 (Send, model picker, close); AC-12 (send disabled with waiting line; prompt stays after 429, 5xx, timeout; No key disables the prompt; Plan only; My profile over the editor and re-read); AC-13 (history clauses); AC-14 (panel stays until ×, selection goes with the prompt, inspector returns, drain before a prompt and its failure path with the prompt). - **Depends on:** - from the row: EZD-5602 (route, `cost.ts`, recordings, error keys) and EZD-213 (all parts by base number; EZD-213b mounts the inspector that the panel replaces). - **Missing from the row:** - EZD-208, for the selection the prompt sends (P208 section 3 `getUi().ids`). It comes through EZD-213, but this part reads it directly. - EZD-5601, for the `aiKey` on `GET /api/profile` and the S01g section that Open My profile shows. It comes through EZD-5602. - Done: EZD-108 (`MyProfileDialog`), EZD-120c (editor route), EZD-016a (browser harness; the part has a visual checklist), EZD-010b (icons), EZD-014c (`expectTouchTargets`). - **The part plan settles:** - how a failed drain is detected after `flush()` resolves (sync `status` `error` or `offline`, or rows left in the outbox), from `outbox-sync.ts`; - where the current floor id comes from; - which icons are new, by name from the board HTML; - the code name for the session total (00f). - **Complexity:** high. It is a new screen region with key, error, waiting and permission states, async ordering (drain, then send, then abort) and a cross-ticket contract (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Sonnet 5.5; builder Opus 5.5. - **security-review: yes**, browser only. The work touches the API (the multipart request to the assistant route) and data access (the selection and history sent off the device; no client name, address or price added by EZ Draft; Q-0474). There is no route, table or policy change. **Reviewers:** code-reviewer · calc-auditor no (the cost math is P5602 T1's; this part only displays it) · ui-verifier yes · security-reviewer yes. ### Part EZD-5603b · Assistant photo: control, browser shrink, server strip - **Scope:** - **control.** - "Photo" with the board's `add_photo_alternate` icon. Its screen-reader name is "Attach a photo" (A1; AC-11). - It accepts JPG, PNG, HEIC and WebP up to 20 MB, one photo per prompt (S03dSelectedObjects-wording.md approved rules). 20 MB is 20,000,000 bytes (decimal): 20,000,000 is accepted and 20,000,001 shows A5 (Q-0652 (b); Q-0512, Q-0637, S03dSelectedObjects-wording.md:32). - A wrong type shows A4 and a larger file shows A5, in the board's error box (board S03cAIAssistantPhoto states). - The attached photo shows as a thumbnail with its file name and size. Its × is labelled "Remove photo" (A2), with a 44 px hit area around the 22 px circle (`S03cAIAssistantPhoto.dc.html:194`; L-060). - A3 shows under the prompt (AC-6). The sent prompt's bubble shows the photo above it, from memory only (board, line 180). - **browser shrink.** Decode the photo, with HEIC through a decoder in a new lazy module. Draw it to a canvas with a long edge of at most 1,568 px. Encode it as JPEG, lowering quality until it is at most 3,500,000 bytes. A photo that cannot be decoded is refused with nothing sent (Q-0637 photo row; AC-7). Q-0637 asks for iOS Safari's HEIC behaviour to be checked first. - **request.** Add a binary `photo` part to the multipart body. The whole body must be at most 4,000,000 bytes, and a test runs at that maximum (Q-0638 gap 7; AC-13). The photo goes only with its prompt. Later prompts' history is text only (AC-8). - **server strip.** This replaces P5602 D-Body's `photo_not_supported` branch. - Take at most 4,000,000 bytes, JPEG only by its magic bytes. - Re-encode with `sharp` and `limitInputPixels`, with no metadata carried over. - On any failure, refuse with a code and a line under 3a and make no provider call (Q-0637 photo row). - The base64 image block appears only in the provider request (Q-0638 gap 7; P5602 D-Request content). - The bytes stay in function memory. They are never written to storage, a job, a log, Sentry or the console (Q-0637; AC-8). - **dependencies.** `sharp` becomes a direct dependency of `app`; it is in the lockfile today only through Next (`pnpm-lock.yaml:4038`, 0.35.5). Add the HEIC decoder. Each gets a docs/architecture.md line (Adding a dependency; CLAUDE.md rule 7). The decoder goes in `HEAVY_PACKAGES` with its lazy folder (ARCH Entry points and lazy modules). Q-0637 asks for `sharp` on the host to be checked first. - **the photo stays.** It stays in the box after a 429, 5xx or timeout, and after a failed drain (Q-0638 gap 13; Q-0640 row 56-7). - **touch.** Photo and Remove photo pass the 44 px check (AC-10). - **Tests (about 14) and files (about 12):** - Unit tests of the browser checks: - each accepted type; - `.gif`, `.pdf`, `.svg` and an empty file; - 20,000,000 bytes accepted and 20,000,001 bytes showing A5 (Q-0652 (b)). - Shrink tests: a 4032 × 3024 JPEG comes out with a long edge of 1,568 and at most 3,500,000 bytes; a HEIC fixture is converted. - Server-strip tests: - a JPEG fixture carrying EXIF GPS and XMP reaches the stub with neither, read back with `sharp(...).metadata()`; - a PNG sent as `photo`, 4,000,001 bytes and corrupt JPEG data are each refused with no provider call. - Body tests: exactly 4,000,000 bytes with the largest photo succeeds; the second prompt's stub request has no image block; no storage upload, job row, Sentry event or console output carries the photo bytes or a canary in them. - Component tests: A1 to A5, and the photo stays after a 429. - Touch targets. - Files: the photo control and the prepare module in `app/src/editor/assistant/`, the lazy HEIC folder, `server/assistant/photo.ts`, P5602's `assistant.ts` body branch and request content, `AI/providers/anthropic.ts` content type, `eslint-rules/boundaries.mjs`, `app/package.json`, `docs/architecture.md`, catalogs, fixtures (a GPS and XMP JPEG built in the test with `sharp().withExif()` and `withXmp()`, and a committed HEIC sample with its source), and the tests. - **Done when:** - The Photo control is named "Attach a photo". It takes JPG, PNG, HEIC and WebP up to 20 MB, one per prompt. A wrong type shows A4, a larger file shows A5, × reads "Remove photo", and A3 shows under the prompt. - The browser sends a JPEG with a long edge of at most 1,568 px and at most 3,500,000 bytes, and HEIC is converted. - A photo with EXIF GPS and XMP reaches the stub with neither. A failed strip refuses with no provider call. - A 4,000,000-byte body with the largest photo succeeds. - The photo is not in the next prompt's request, and it is never stored or logged. - The photo stays after a 429, 5xx, timeout or failed drain. - Photo and Remove photo pass the 44 px check. - **ACs:** AC-EZD-5603-6, -7, -8, -11; AC-10 (Photo, Remove photo); AC-12 (photo stays after 429, 5xx, timeout); AC-13 (4,000,000-byte multipart body); AC-14 (photo stays when the drain fails). - **Depends on:** EZD-5603a. EZD-5602 is missing from the derived row as a direct dependency: this part edits P5602's body branch and provider request content (P5602 steps 6-8 and 11). EZD-016a is done. - **The part plan settles:** the HEIC decoder package, its licence and whether it runs in a Web Worker; how iOS Safari handles HEIC; and whether `sharp` runs on the host. These are the "checked first" items in Q-0637, looked up through `retriever-web` with a REPORT at that plan. It also settles the server refusal code and its 3a line. - **Complexity:** high. It adds image decoding in two runtimes, two new dependencies, a security-sensitive strip and a body-size limit (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Opus 5.5 (binary fixtures and byte-exact bounds); builder Opus 5.5. - **security-review: yes.** It touches the API (multipart body and the route's photo branch), data access (photo metadata off the device; nothing stored) and dependencies (`sharp`, the HEIC decoder). **Reviewers:** code-reviewer · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier yes · security-reviewer yes. ### AC map | Part | ACs | | --- | --- | | EZD-5603a | 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9; 10 (Send, model picker, close); 12 (waiting, prompt stays, No key disables, Plan only, My profile); 13 (history); 14 (panel stays, selection, inspector returns, drain and its failure with the prompt) | | EZD-5603b | 6, 7, 8, 11; 10 (Photo, Remove photo); 12 (photo stays); 13 (4,000,000-byte body); 14 (photo stays when the drain fails) | | EZD-5604 (Q-0651 (a)) | 10 (Accept, Adjust, Reject) | ## 2. Sources - Spec: `sections/screens/S03c-ai-assistant.md` (Who sees it, Layout, Key, States, What goes to the AI, What EZ Draft keeps, Limits); `sections/09l-ai-assistant-cost-examples.md`; `sections/00f-glossary-phase-05.md:32`; `sections/11-non-functional-requirements.md:21` (editor 500 KB before its lazy parts); `acceptance-criteria.md:1839-1852` (and 1853-1870 for EZD-5604 and EZD-5605); `non-goals.md` (photo-to-plan stays v2: Q-0638 gap 17). - Decisions: `decisions/05-screens.md` 2026-10-31 row, Q-0474, Q-0630 (tablet rule; photo in the first AI phase; S03c photo approved), Q-0637 (call path, photo, wording), Q-0638 (gaps 5, 6, 7, 9, 12, 13, 17), Q-0640 (rows 56-2, 56-7, 56-8), Q-0641 (row 56-7); `decisions/10-permissions-and-settings.md` 2026-10-31 user-key row, Q-0474, Q-0637 (key storage, usage), Q-0512 and Q-0637 (20 MB = 20,000,000 bytes, through Q-0652 (b)); Q-0651, Q-0652, Q-0653 (answered-agent). - Mockups: `vault/mockups/S03cAIAssistant.png`, `S03cAIAssistantNoKey.png`, `S03cAIAssistantKeyError.png`, `S03cAIAssistantPhoto.png` and their `html/project/*.dc.html`; `S03cAIAssistant-wording.md` (approved 2026-11-07); `S03dSelectedObjects-wording.md` (A1-A5 and the photo rules, approved 2026-11-07). These are Studio boards; sample data (prompt, costs, file name, size) is not a decision. - Dependency contracts: `vault/plans/EZD-5602.md` section 3, plus the rows it points to (steps 5, 11, 12; D-Body, D-Request, D-Map, D-Route); `vault/plans/EZD-5601.md` section 3; `vault/plans/EZD-213.md` (split proposal, part b). - Code read 2026-11-09: `app/src/components/shell/EditorFrame.tsx`, `rail-types.ts`, `ToolRail.tsx`; `app/src/editor/ProjectEditor.tsx`; `app/src/editor/tools/DrawingTools.tsx:19-36` (`bottom={[]}`); `app/src/lib/outbox/outbox-sync.ts:49-55,514-519` (`flush`); `app/src/lazy/my-profile/index.ts`; `app/src/components/account/AvatarMenu.tsx:21,54`; `app/src/components/icon/icon-names.generated.ts`; `app/test-harness/touch-targets.ts:8`; `pnpm-lock.yaml:4038`. - Research: R-051 (host body limit, through Q-0637), R-055 and R-056 (through P5602). No report covers HEIC or `sharp` on the host; part b's plan gets one. Architecture: Entry points and lazy modules (EZD-020); Editor shell (EZD-012); Messages and language (t()); Design tokens, fonts and icons; Browser tests (EZD-016a); AI (EZD-021); AI stubs and the network guard (EZD-021); Dependencies ## 10. Open questions None open. Answered (answered-agent, in the ledger): - Q-0651 (a): AC-EZD-5603-10's Accept, Adjust and Reject clause maps to EZD-5604; its plan adds the three buttons to its `expectTouchTargets` test (note for TRACE and the AC map). - Q-0652 (b): 20 MB = 20,000,000 bytes (decimal). Boundary test: 20,000,000 accepted, 20,000,001 shows A5 (Q-0512, Q-0637, S03dSelectedObjects-wording.md:32). - Q-0653 (a): the model picker keeps the last pick for the editor page load; it starts on Sonnet 5.5.

# EZD-5605 · Assistant Accept, Adjust, Reject and events

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-5605-1 … AC-EZD-5605-8 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:1863-1870`, stage-0)
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** ui, testing, security, data-model, api
- **User-visible result:** On an Assistant preview, Accept saves the whole change in one go (one Undo takes all of it back), Adjust lets Josh fix the preview by hand first while the rest of the drawing is locked, and Reject leaves the drawing as it was. A refused save says why and keeps the preview.

| D-Save (how Accept saves) | Accept never calls `applyEdit`. It sends the save set with `sync.sendNow` and only after a `saved` answer puts it in the model with `applySavedEdit` (one undo step, no `onCommit`, because it is already saved). A refusal or failure changes no model, undo stack, outbox entry or preview. | Q-0638 gap 10 ("preview stays until the server says saved; a save refused leaves everything as it was"); AC-5; `outbox-sync.ts` loop moves refusals to the conflict list, which would half-save |
| D-SendNow | Chained on `writes` like `keepMine`. (1) `changes.length` 0 or > `MAX_CHANGES_PER_SAVE` (100, `A/lib/outbox/outbox.ts:115`) → `{ kind: 'unsaved' }`, no storage call, no fetch. (2) `clearTimer()`; await `running`; disposed, `blocked()` or offline → `unsaved`. (3) `lock.tryRun(lockName, …)`: run `loop()` then `recordPending()` exactly as `drain` does; then `blocked()`, offline, or any `storage.list()` entry of `projectId` left → `unsaved`. (4) `storage.put(projectId, lockEpoch, changes, Date.now())`; `mine` = `storage.list()` entries with that project and an id in `changes`. (5) `stillValid()` false → `storage.drop(mine)`, `cancelled`, no fetch. (6) `send({ projectId, lockEpoch, send: mine, drop: [] }, [], true)`; body adds `assistant: true`. (7) `saved` → `o.onSaved?.(projectId, objects)`, `storage.commit(projectId, mine, objects)`, `set({ failures: 0, status: 'saved', lastSavedAt: Date.now() })`, return it. (8) `refused` or `failed` → `storage.drop(mine)`, `set({ status: restingStatus() })`, return the outcome; `problem` and `failures` untouched, nothing moved to conflicts. (9) Lock not taken → `unsaved`. (10) Any storage throw → `storageFailed(error)` (as the loop does), `unsaved`; a commit throw after `saved` pushes `{ projectId, sent: mine, saved }` on `unstored` first, as `loop` does, and still returns the `saved` outcome. | architecture "Patch store and outbox (EZD-120b)"; `outbox-sync.ts:405-520`; L-059 |
| D-Marker | Route: right after the `model.saved` try block and before the closure loop, when `req.assistant === true`, `emit('model.ai_change_accepted', { objectIds: req.changes.map((c) => c.id), count: req.changes.length }, { tenantId: result.tenantId, projectId: id, actorId: p.session.appUserId })`; a throw is reported with `reportError(new Error('model_ai_change_accepted_event_failed'), { source: 'function', location: ROUTE, tags: { 'ezd.cause': errorType(e) } })` and the save still answers 200. | D-Accept order | `accept()`: (1) busy → `busy`. (2) `previews.getState()`: `preview === null` → `no_preview`; `stale` → `stale` (5604b shows its line). (3) busy true, notify. ## 7. Security review
security-review: yes. Areas: API (save body field and event), data access (the save path for AI output, all-or-nothing), permissions (Edit model still checked by the route and `save_objects`).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer always · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier yes · security-reviewer yes.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
high: a new save path inside the outbox's lock and drain, a store that switches every editor controller between the model and a scratch copy, and seams into four dependency plans. Test-author Opus 5.5 (async sync fakes, store references); builder Opus 5.5.

## 9. Dependencies
- From the row: EZD-5604 (both parts: S1-S5, S7), EZD-217 (K2-K4, B2), EZD-213 (the panel replaces the inspector), EZD-211 (chips, P211 section 3).
- Missing from the row: EZD-208 (selection controller, `SelectionDeps`, `select-all`; P208 A4-A6), EZD-212 (handles and chips used in Adjust, Move tool; S6), EZD-5603 (panel, prompt box, Assistant rail button; S5), EZD-5602 (stub recordings for T22), EZD-016a (browser harness; done), EZD-294 (numbers; done), EZD-120b (outbox; done).
- Risks: `sendNow` shares the tab lock with the drain, so a slow AI save delays hand saves by one request. Two tabs of one user editing the same object in the same second can merge into the AI batch's entry; `mine` is filtered by id and the server's base-seq check refuses a stale write. Seams S1-S7 are names this plan picks before those plans exist; a different choice there means re-validation here (Q-0654).

## 10. Open questions
- **Q-0654 (a), answered-agent** (orchestrator): the orchestrator gives seam rows S1-S7 to the EZD-5603, EZD-5604a, EZD-5604b and EZD-212 part planners as required names; this plan is re-validated against their section 3 at Stage 3 step 1 (vault/PROCESS.md).

# EZD-204a · Opening data v4

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-204-5, AC-EZD-204-6, AC-EZD-204-10, AC-EZD-204-14, AC-EZD-204-15
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** data-model, migrations, testing
- **User-visible result:** Nothing new on screen yet. Doors and windows store swing, hand, impact rating, shutter type and typed-or-auto rough opening; doors saved earlier open as Hinge left, swing left, Not rated, rough opening as typed.
- Phase: 5 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
Part a of the EZD-204 split (`vault/plans/EZD-204.md` Split proposal, Part EZD-204a; its rows are carried here, checked against develop `387d0512` on 2026-11-09). Short names: `G` = `packages/geometry/src`, `A` = `app/src`. EZD-294 is merged (`5cc18fae`): `openingDataSchema` keeps its `attributes.number` (`G/schema/opening.ts:18`).

Data: no table, SQL or RLS change. Model schema v3 → v4 (03b rule 5; ARCH Model schema Version rule): stored openings gain six fields, so the version rises, with `MIGRATIONS[3]` and `samples/v4.json`.

### Build steps

| 2 | `G/schema/migrate.ts` | change | `CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 4`; private `migrateV3ToV4: MigrateStep`; `MIGRATIONS` gains `3: migrateV3ToV4` | `migrateV1ToV2` in the same file | `pnpm --filter @ezdraft/geometry exec vitest run src/schema` |

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Opening v4 | `geometry: z.strictObject({ center: pointSchema, hostWallId: z.uuid().nullable(), axis: pointSchema.nullable() })`. `attributes` keeps `kind`, `width`, `height`, `roughOpening` (all positive, unchanged), `sillHeight` (`min(0)`) and `number` (optional), and adds five required keys: `swing: z.enum(DOOR_SWINGS).nullable()`, `hand: z.enum(DOOR_HANDS).nullable()`, `impactRating: z.enum(IMPACT_RATINGS)`, `shutterType: z.enum(SHUTTER_TYPES).nullable()`, `roughOpeningMode: z.enum(ROUGH_OPENING_MODES)`. A failure is the existing `invalid_data` issue of `parseStoredObject` (`G/schema/index.ts:60`). No code reads `openingDataSchema.shape` today (grep, 2026-11-09); `openingDataShape` is exported for later tickets. | Q-0630 rows 4, 14, 38; Q-0633 G11; Q-0640 rows 2, 7; Q-0508 |

| `axis` (stored values) | Null while hosted (rule (c)), so the host gives the direction. While flagged it holds the unit start→end direction of the last host; EZD-204b's hosting sets and clears it. `createOpeningData` and the v3 → v4 step always write `null`. | 04 Selection, undo and flags ("stay put"); CLAUDE.md rule 18 |

| v3 → v4 step | Like `migrateV1ToV2`, copies only `data`, `data.geometry` and `data.attributes`. When `obj.type === 'opening'` and `data`, `data.geometry` and `data.attributes` are all records (`isRecord`): `geometry = { ...geometry, axis: null }`; `attributes = { ...attributes, swing: d, hand: d, impactRating: 'not_rated', shutterType: null, roughOpeningMode: 'typed' }` with `d = attributes.kind === 'door' ? 'left' : null`. Every other object (other types, null or malformed opening data) is returned as `{ id, type, schema_version: 4, data }` with `data` by reference. Never mutates the input. | AC-EZD-204-6, -15; Q-0642 row 2; Q-0641 row 3; EZD-203 security review round 1 (comment above `migrateV1ToV2`) |

Never edit it by hand or after merge. | ARCH Model schema (`samples/v<n>.json` never edited after merge) |
| `autoRoughOpening` | Door: `{ width: width + 2, height: height + 2.5 }`. Window: `{ width: width + 0.5, height: height + 0.5 }`. A new object; no rounding; no input check. | Q-0630 question 1 row 3 (`09-calculations-and-rules.md:21`) |
| `createOpeningData` | `geometry: { center: { x: center.x, y: center.y }, hostWallId: host.id, axis: null }`, `status: 'existing'`, `level: host.data.level`. Door attributes: `kind 'door'`, `DEFAULT_DOOR_SIZE` width and height, `roughOpening: autoRoughOpening('door', DEFAULT_DOOR_SIZE)`, `sillHeight: 0`, `swing: input.swing ?? 'left'`, `hand: 'left'`. Window: `kind 'window'`, `DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE`, `roughOpening: autoRoughOpening('window', DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE)`, `sillHeight: DEFAULT_WINDOW_SILL_IN`, `swing: null`, `hand: null` (`input.swing` ignored). Attribute key order: kind, width, height, roughOpening, sillHeight, swing, hand, impactRating, shutterType, roughOpeningMode. `center` is not validated. | Q-0630 question 1 (sizes); Q-0630 row 6 (Existing); AC-EZD-204-14; Q-0641 row 3 (new door Hinge left, swing to a side EZD-211 passes); EZD-294 N7 (EZD-211 numbers it); door sill 0 as `samples/v1.json` and `benchmark.ts` `DOOR` |

# EZD-204b · Offsets, hosting and the Not on a wall flag

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-204-1, AC-EZD-204-2, AC-EZD-204-3, AC-EZD-204-4, AC-EZD-204-7, AC-EZD-204-8, AC-EZD-204-9, AC-EZD-204-10, AC-EZD-204-11, AC-EZD-204-12, AC-EZD-204-13, AC-EZD-204-15
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** data-model, geometry, testing, tokens
- **User-visible result:** When a wall edit leaves a door or window off every wall, it stays where it was and draws in error red on the plan; it clears when a wall touches it again, in the same undo step. Doors draw with their own hinge end and swing side.
- Phase: 5 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: planned

# EZD-211a · Door and window geometry and tool logic

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-211-1, -3, -4, -5, -7, -8, -9, -10, -12, -13, -14, -15, -16, -17, -18, -19, -20 (the logic of each; the on-screen half is EZD-211b)
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** ui, testing, data-model, geometry
- **User-visible result:** Nothing on screen yet: the door and window placing rules (preview on a wall, typed offsets, Space flip, arc and hinge-dot flips, tablet press-drag-lift) exist and are tested, ready for EZD-211b to put on the rail.
- Phase: 5 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: planned
- Parent: `vault/plans/EZD-211.md` Split proposal Part EZD-211a and its sections 1-10; rows kept except: no icon step (`door_front`, `window` already in `icons.json`, 61ebd7a0); owned band from `attributes.thickness` (parent: `geometry.thickness`); `openingOwnedAt` also takes the 44 px target tolerance; `doorSymbolInFrame` shared with `build.ts`; `previewFailure` replaces `previewHost`; no `ctx.level`; Q-0643 (c) in R6; titles `EZD-211a`.

## 1. What to build
G = `packages/geometry/src`, A = `app/src`. P204a, P204b, P294 = those plans' section 3 and the Build-step signatures and Decided rows named. D:x = Decided row "x" below. tol = `COMPARISON_TOLERANCE_IN` (1/64", `G/tolerance.ts`, 03g). ppi = pixels per inch.

Data: no table, migration or `schema_version` change; no money field. The reducer returns opening objects (P204a `OpeningObject`); nothing is saved in this part (EZD-211b saves through `store.applyEdit`).

| Choice | Decision | Source |

No new dependency | ARCH Folder layout; P204a step 4; P204b step 1; P294 |
| Fields and tools | `OFFSET_LEFT_FIELD = { id: 'offsetLeft', label: 'office.typed.field.offset_left', kind: 'length', lengthKind: 'other', optional: true }`; `OFFSET_RIGHT_FIELD` the same with `offsetRight`, `office.typed.field.offset_right`; `OPENING_WIDTH_FIELD = { id: 'width', label: 'office.typed.field.width', kind: 'length', lengthKind: 'positive', optional: true }`. `DOOR_TOOL = { id: 'door', icon: 'door_front', fields: [OFFSET_LEFT_FIELD, OFFSET_RIGHT_FIELD, OPENING_WIDTH_FIELD] }`; `WINDOW_TOOL` the same with id `'window'`, icon `'window'` | Q-0636 (order); Q-0630 09 row 14 (width above 0, offset accepts 0); board S03 rail (`door_front`, `window`); 03g row 9 |
| `doorSymbolInFrame` | `hingeLow = (hand === 'left') === leftEndIsLow(f.d, f.vertical)`; `sh = hingeLow ? sc − width/2 : sc + width/2`; swing `'left'` → face `f.oL`, `k = +1`; `'right'` → face `f.oR`, `k = −1`; `hinge = f.start + f.d·sh + f.n·face`; `swingNormal = k·f.n`; `leafEnd = hinge + swingNormal·width`; `radius = width`; `u = hingeLow ? f.d : −f.d`, `v = swingNormal`; `startAngle` = degrees of `atan2` of (`u.x·v.y − u.y·v.x > 0 ? u : v`), +360 when below 0, −360 when 360 or more; `endAngle = startAngle + 90` | P204b Decided "Door symbol" (the same maths, now in one place); rule 18 |
| `doorSymbol` | `null` when `kind` is `'window'`, `swing` or `hand` is null, or (hosted) `host` is null, `host.id` lower-cased differs from `hostWallId` lower-cased, or `pointsEqual(host start, host end)`. Hosted frame: `start` = host start, `d` = unit start→end, `n = (−d.y, d.x)`, `oL`/`oR` by `thicknessSide` exactly as `build.ts` `faceOffsets` (`right` → 0, −t; `left` → t, 0; `center` → t/2, −t/2; t = `attributes.thickness`), `vertical = isVerticalLine(host.data.geometry)`, `sc = (center − start)·d`. Flagged (`hostWallId` null; `host` ignored): `start = center`, `d = axis ?? (1, 0)`, `n = (−d.y, d.x)`, `oL = oR = 0`, `vertical = isVerticalLine({ start: center − d·w/2, end: center + d·w/2 })`, `sc = 0`. Then `doorSymbolInFrame`. No span check | P204b Decided "Door symbol", "Flagged opening", "Frame"; `build.ts` `faceOffsets` |
| `swingSideOf` | `c = (end − start) × (p − start)` (`dx·(p.y − s.y) − dy·(p.x − s.x)`): `c < 0` → `'right'`, else `'left'` (0 included) | Q-0641 row 3; P204b "Door symbol" (`'left'` = the `n` side) |
| No snap | Opening tools never call `snap()`; the pointer's model point is projected on the host line; no snap marker | S03 Door (exact place by typing or chips); 03g (computed coordinates not rounded) |
| `openingPreview` | `invalid_input` when `point.x`, `point.y` or `width` is not finite or `width <= 0`, or `hostCorners(host, walls)` has fewer than 2 entries. `L = wallLength(host line)`, `d` unit; `s = clamp((point − start)·d, 0, L)`; `i` = last corner index with `at <= s`, clamped to `0 … n−2`; `lo = corners[i].at`, `hi = corners[i+1].at`; `lowOffset = clamp(s − width/2 − lo, 0, max(0, hi − lo − width))`; `side = leftEndIsLow(d, isVerticalLine(host line)) ? 'left' : 'right'`; `r = placeAtOffset({ host, walls, openings, width, near: point, side, offset: lowOffset, ignoreId: null })`; failure → `{ ok: false, reason: r.reason }`. Success → `withOpeningSize(createOpeningData({ kind, host, center: r.center, swing }), { width, height })`, `swing = swingSideOf(host, point)` swapped when `flipped`, `height` = `DEFAULT_DOOR_SIZE.height` or `DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE.height` | P204b `placeAtOffset`, `hostCorners` (same bay rule); P204a `leftEndIsLow`; Q-0630 09 row 1 |
| `withOpeningSize` | New object, input never mutated: geometry and every attribute copied; `width`, `height` set; `roughOpeningMode === 'auto'` → `roughOpening = autoRoughOpening(kind, size)`; `'typed'` → `roughOpening` copied unchanged. No input check | Q-0630 09 row 3 (follows the size until typed); AC-13 |
| `doorTargetAt` | `null` when `doorSymbol` is null. `r = |p − hinge|`. `r <= tolIn` → `'dot'`. Else `|r − radius| <= tolIn` and `((a − startAngle) mod 360 + 360) mod 360 <= endAngle − startAngle` (`a` = degrees of `atan2(p − hinge)`) → `'arc'`. Else `null`. Callers pass `DOOR_TARGET_PX / ppi` (a 44 px round target) | S03d E (44 px each); AC-15 |
| `openingOwnedAt` | True when any of: `doorTargetAt(o, host, p, targetTolIn) !== null`; `p` within `ownTolIn` plus the band of the span segment `center ± d·width/2` (hosted: `d` = host unit direction, band = `host.data.attributes.thickness`, false when the host fails `doorSymbol`'s host checks; flagged: `d = axis ?? (1, 0)`, band 0); for a door, `|p − hinge| <= radius + ownTolIn` and `(p − hinge)·swingNormal >= 0`. Callers pass `ownTolIn = SNAP_CAPTURE_PX / ppi` (10 px), `targetTolIn = DOOR_TARGET_PX / ppi` | Q-0641 row 2 ("until the pointer leaves it"); Q-0633 G12 (10 px capture) |
| Without moving | A press is "not moved" while the screen distance from its down point is `<= PRESS_MOVE_PX`; `moved` turns true at the first `move` past it and stays true | AC-15; Q-0642 row 1 (10 px) |
| Reducer | `OpeningInput = { type: 'pointer'; kind: 'down' \| 'move' \| 'up' \| 'cancel'; at: Point; screen: Point; touch: boolean; wallId: string \| null } \| { type: 'typed'; values: TypedValues; screen: Point \| null } \| { type: 'space' } \| { type: 'escape' }`; `OpeningContext = { newId: () => string; walls: readonly WallObject[]; openings: readonly OpeningObject[]; highs: NumberHighs; pixelsPerInch: number }`; `Owned = { id: string; mode: 'pointer' \| 'typed' \| 'touch'; at: Point \| null }`; `OpeningPress = { screen: Point; host: string \| null; target: 'arc' \| 'dot' \| 'owned' \| null; moved: boolean }`; `OpeningToolState = { kind: 'door' \| 'window'; preview: OpeningData \| null; previewFailure: OpeningFailure \| null; flipped: boolean; owned: Owned \| null; press: OpeningPress \| null }`; `OpeningStep = { state: OpeningToolState; save: OpeningObject[]; select: string \| null; message: MessageKey \| null; exit: boolean }`. Initial: preview, previewFailure, owned, press null, flipped false. Pure, never throws, never mutates. Defaults per step: `save []`, `select null`, `message null`, `exit false` | ARCH Drawing tools (pure reducers) |
| Lookups | Every input first: the owned opening = `ctx.openings` entry whose id lower-cased equals `owned.id` lower-cased; none → `owned = null`. A wall id resolves to the `ctx.walls` entry with that id lower-cased; an id with no entry counts as `null`. An opening's host = its `hostWallId` resolved the same way | Q-0641 row 2; P204b (ids compared lower-cased) |
| Release | Ownership ends (`owned = null`), checked at a pointer `move` with no press and at every `down`, before anything else: `pointer` mode, input not touch, `openingOwnedAt` false at `at`; `typed` mode, `at` null, or `|screen − owned.at| > PRESS_MOVE_PX`; `touch` mode, a `down` with `touch` true, `wallId` resolving to a wall and `openingOwnedAt` false. Also on `escape` | Q-0641 row 2; Q-0642 row 1 |
| Hover | Mouse or pen `move` with no press, after Release: owned → preview and previewFailure null; `wallId` null → both null; else `openingPreview` at `at` with the kind's default width and `flipped`: success → preview set, previewFailure null; failure → preview null, previewFailure its reason. A touch `move` with no press does nothing | AC-3; Q-0641 row 2 |
| Down | After Release: owned and `doorTargetAt(owned, host, at, DOOR_TARGET_PX / ppi)` hits → `press.target` `'arc'` or `'dot'`; owned and `openingOwnedAt` → `'owned'`; else `wallId` resolves → `press.host` = that id and the preview as Hover; else `press.host = null`, preview null. `press.screen = screen`, `moved false` | AC-3, 15, 17; Q-0634 |
| Move while pressed | `moved` per D:Without moving; `press.host` set → the preview follows on that wall (`openingPreview` with host = that wall whatever `wallId` is) | Q-0634 (drag along it); S03 Door |
| Up | `'arc'` not moved → `save [flipSwing(owned)]`; `'dot'` not moved → `save [flipHand(owned)]`; `'arc'` or `'dot'` moved → nothing (the hinge-dot resize is EZD-212); `'owned'` → nothing; `press.host` with a preview → D:Place; `press.host` with no preview → message for previewFailure (D:Messages); `press.host` null → nothing, no message. Press cleared | AC-4, 15, 17; Q-0633 row 2; P204a Flips |
| Cancel | `cancel` → press, preview and previewFailure null; nothing saved. An `up`, or a `move` with `touch` true, arriving with no press → state unchanged, default step | Q-0634 |
| Place | `id = ctx.newId()`; `numberNewObjects([{ id, type: 'opening', data: preview }], ctx.highs).objects[0]` (number = `highs[kind] + 1`); `save` = that object, `select = id`, `owned = { id, mode, at }` (click: `'pointer'`, at null; touch up: `'touch'`, at null; typed: `'typed'`, at = input `screen`); preview and previewFailure null, `flipped false`, `exit false` | AC-16; Q-0625 (a); P294 N7; AC-19; Q-0640 row 6 |
| Typed | Target: the owned opening, else the preview, else message `no_wall`. Target host unresolved → `no_wall`. `w = values.width ?? target width`. All three values null: a preview is placed where it is (D:Place); an owned target → nothing, no message. Exactly one offset set → `placeAtOffset({ side: that side, offset, width: w, near: target center, ignoreId: owned id or null, host, walls, openings })`. Only `width` set → `side 'left'`, `offset = openingOffsets(target, host, walls).left` (a preview is wrapped as `{ id: 'preview', type: 'opening', data }`; null → `no_wall`). Both offsets set → D:Both offsets. Success → `data = withOpeningSize({ ...target data, geometry: { ...geometry, center } }, { width: w, height: target height })`: a preview target → D:Place with that data, mode `'typed'`; an owned target → `save [{ id: owned.id, type: 'opening', data }]` (number kept), `owned` unchanged. Failure → its message, nothing saved. Every typed input sets `press = null`, so a later `up` places nothing | AC-1, 5, 8, 18; Q-0636; 09k Offset, Door resize |
| Both offsets | Bay = `hostCorners` pair around the target center's `s` (D:openingPreview rule). Accepted only when `coordsEqual(left + w + right, hi − lo)` (1/64" inclusive); then placed as "Offset left alone" with `left`. Else message `office.tools.opening.offsets_mismatch`, nothing saved | Q-0643 (c); 03g row 2 |
| Space | `space`: owned door → `save [flipSwing(owned)]`; else a door preview → `flipped` toggled and the preview's `swing` toggled, center unchanged; else nothing. A window never flips | AC-7, 14; Q-0630 05 row 34; Q-0630 03 row 4 |
| Esc | `escape` (one the typed layer did not take) → `exit true`, state = `initialOpeningToolState(kind)` | AC-19; Q-0640 row 6 |
| Messages | `past_corner` → `office.tools.opening.past_corner`; `overlap` → `office.tools.opening.overlap`; `invalid_input`, null failure or no target → `office.tools.opening.no_wall` | P204b failures; section 6 |
| Edge inputs | A typed width of 0, or one rounding to 0 at 1/16", is refused inside the field by `'positive'` (formats message, field stays open, P209 Enter); a negative length cannot parse (`G/length.ts` shapes); offsets accept 0 (`'other'`); an offset or width too large → `past_corner`; `screen` null at Enter → released at the first move | G8; Q-0630 09 row 14; 09k Offset maximum, Door resize |

## 7. Security review
security-review: no. No table, route, permission, SQL or save path change; pure functions and one catalog file.
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer always · calc-auditor yes (offsets, rough openings, hit and owned areas, arc angles) · ui-verifier no · security-reviewer no.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
high: a pointer state machine with three ownership modes over two unbuilt dependencies, plus offset, hit and angle maths a calc-auditor checks. Test-author opus-5-5 medium, builder opus-5-5 medium.

## 9. Dependencies
Ticket row: EZD-204a, EZD-204b (planned, not built: `createOpeningData`, `flipSwing`, `flipHand`, `autoRoughOpening`, `leftEndIsLow`, `isVerticalLine`, `hostCorners`, `placeAtOffset`, `openingOffsets`, `doorItems` and `Frame.vertical` in `build.ts`; this ticket builds after both merge), EZD-294 (done: `numberNewObjects`, `NumberHighs`), EZD-209 (done: `TypedLengthField`, `TypedValues`), EZD-210a (done: reducer pattern, fixtures), EZD-201 (done: `G/length.ts`), EZD-010b (done; no longer needed, both icons are in `icons.json`). Also used, not on the row, all done: EZD-238 (`build.ts`), EZD-203 (`G/walls`), EZD-120b (`withWalls` fixtures).
Risks: if EZD-204b's merged `doorItems` or `Frame` deviates from its plan, step 3 and G5 need re-validation; the `build.ts` change must leave every `src/drawing` test unchanged.

## 10. Open questions
None. Q-0643 (both offsets typed) is answered (c) and applied in D:Both offsets and R6.

# EZD-208a · Selection logic and drawing

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-208-4, AC-EZD-208-10, AC-EZD-208-11, AC-EZD-208-12, AC-EZD-208-18 (the controller also carries the logic EZD-208b's ACs 1, 2, 5-9, 13-16 test in the browser)
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** ui, testing
- **User-visible result:** nothing new on screen yet: the pick, cycle, box, key and drawing logic for Select exists and is unit-tested; EZD-208b puts it on the plan.
- Phase: 5 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: planned · Re-validated 2026-11-09 against EZD-204a/204b merged code (citations only; no test value changed)

## 1. What to build
`G` = `packages/geometry/src`, `A` = `app/src`. Split part a of `vault/plans/EZD-208.md` (Split proposal; its D-rows are restated here as R-rows, which govern). Data: none; selection is session state, never saved (S03 Canvas interactions; 04 Tool rail "Selection carries across tabs"). Every new or changed file's header comment gains `EZD-208a Build step N (vault/plans/EZD-208a.md section 3 <rows>)`.

Earlier-phase unit files edited or extended (E1, H1, SC1-SC2, K1-K2, DC1) run in the gate only at full scope; the step 3-6 commands run them whole (no `EZD_TEST_GREP`), and the builder reports those runs.

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R1 Candidates | Walls and openings on the open floor (`openFloorId`, `A/editor/plan/batches.ts`) that the drawing list draws: a wall unless `pointsEqual(start, end)`; a hosted opening whose host is a drawn wall on that floor and whose clamped span is not empty; a flagged opening (`hostWallId` null). Rooms, floors and other types never. Under the cursor = `shapeDistance` 0; if none is, every shape with distance `<= toleranceIn` counts. Order ("D1 order"): `area` ascending, then id lower-cased ascending (`<` string compare). | Q-0630 rows 7, 8; AC-11, AC-18; `G/drawing/build.ts` lines 130-172 (53b8d3cc); EZD-204b Decided "Flagged opening" |
| R2 Shapes | G2: quad `[left.start, left.end, right.end, right.start]` of `wallFaceLines(wall.data)` (`G/walls/wall.ts`), `area` = absolute shoelace area. G3 hosted: `d = (end − start)/L`, `n = (−d.y, d.x)`, face offsets `oL`/`oR` = `right` → `0`/`−t`, `left` → `t`/`0`, `center` → `t/2`/`−t/2` (`t` = `attributes.thickness`); `sc = (center − start)·d`; `lo = max(0, sc − w/2)`, `hi = min(L, sc + w/2)`; `null` when `lo > hi` or `coordsEqual(lo, hi)`; quad `[start+lo·d+oL·n, start+hi·d+oL·n, start+hi·d+oR·n, start+lo·d+oR·n]`, `area = (hi − lo) × t`. G3 flagged: `d = axis ?? {x: 1, y: 0}`, bar `center ∓ (w/2)·d`, `area` 0. Door leaf and arc are not in the shape. | Q-0630 row 7; Q-0633 G6 ("the door body still cycles"); `build.ts` `faceOffsets` (lines 83-93), span lines 163-171, flagged bar lines 243-257 (53b8d3cc); EZD-204a Decided "`axis` (stored values)" |
| R3 Same spot | `SAME_SPOT_PX = 10` region px, compared on `event.screen` with `Math.hypot`. A press becomes a drag at distance `> 10` from the press point. ## 5. Visual checklist
None: this part adds no element to a screen and nothing calls `setSelectedIds` until EZD-208b, whose plan carries the checklist (S03dWallSelected, S03dDoorSelected, S03dStates, S03dTablet). Hover on a wall gains translucent outline lines (R11), proven unedited by step 10's specs.

## 6. Proposed wording
None. No user-visible string; `office.tool.select` "Select" exists (`en.ts:337`).

## 7. Security review
security-review: no. Selection reads the open model in the browser and writes nothing.
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer always · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier no · security-reviewer no.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
high: hit geometry on two object kinds, a pointer and key state machine, and changes inside the canvas controller and scene under 11 rule 4. Test-author opus-5-5 medium; builder opus-5-5 medium.

## 9. Dependencies
- Row: EZD-207a, 207b, 207c, 206, 209, 210b, 204a (98675b22), 204b (53b8d3cc), all done. This plan uses 204a/204b's `createOpeningData`, `OpeningObject`, `axis`, and flagged openings drawn on layer `flagged` with `LAYER_TOKEN.flagged`; all match the merged code. Recorded deviations, none affecting this plan: 204a `flipSwing`/`flipHand` return `null` for a null swing or hand (not used here); 204b door builders pass `a.hand!`/`a.swing!` to `doorItems` (the drawn items 208a reads are unchanged); 206 `WallSnapIndex` keeps walls, not faces (208a uses `createSpatialIndex` only); 207a-c, 209, 210b deviations predate this plan, whose merged-code reads (section 2) include them. Not on the row, done: EZD-205a (`roomValue`, rooms), EZD-210a (`tools/index.ts`), EZD-238 (drawing list).
- Not needed: EZD-016a (no visual checklist).
- `editorRail` and `SELECT_RAIL_TOOL` stay in this part, as the parent's section 3 A3 and A6 placed them.
- Risks: R10 changes the hover path EZD-210b's gap pick reads (kept by the `'wall'` fallback and `getHoveredWallId`); the selection meshes must not upload during a pan (A5 uploads only on change; EZD-207c benchmark has no selection); EZD-211 (`claim`) and EZD-5605 (`selectable`) extend `SelectionDeps`.

## 10. Open questions
None.

# EZD-212a · Move, resize and chip geometry

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-212-4, AC-EZD-212-5, AC-EZD-212-9, AC-EZD-212-11, AC-EZD-212-14, AC-EZD-212-17, AC-EZD-212-20, AC-EZD-212-21 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:919-926`, stage-0)
- **Complexity:** high
- **Areas:** geometry, testing
- **User-visible result:** nothing on screen yet: the geometry core can move a selection (walls stretch their neighbours, doors slide along their wall), resize a wall end or a door, and measure and set the distance chips that EZD-212b and EZD-212c put on the plan.
- Phase: 5 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
`G` = `packages/geometry/src`. Pure TypeScript, no DOM, no React (ARCH Folder layout). Every function returns new objects and never mutates its input (pattern `G/walls/move.ts`, `G/rooms/absorb.ts`). Ids compare lower-cased (`sameId` in `G/walls/move.ts:18`). `tol` = `COMPARISON_TOLERANCE_IN` (0.015625, `G/tolerance.ts`; 03g, inclusive).

Imported, not created (L-043; grep 2026-11-09): `moveWall`, `MoveWallResult` (`G/walls/move.ts`); `findWallJoins`, `WallEnd`, `WallJoin` (`G/walls/joins.ts`); `wallLength`, `wallLengthProblem`, `wallFaceLines`, `WallObject`, `WallLine` (`G/walls/wall.ts`); `pointsEqual`, `coordsEqual`, `COMPARISON_TOLERANCE_IN` (`G/tolerance.ts`); `formatLength`, `PLAN_DISPLAY_DENOMINATOR`, `parseLength` (`G/length.ts`); `ModelObject`, `Point` (`G/schema`). Tests only: `findRoomOutlines` (`G/rooms/outlines.ts:110`), `roomAreaSqFt`, `outlineAreaSqIn` (`G/rooms/area.ts:29`, `:20`), `reconcileRooms` (`G/rooms/sync.ts:28`), `findClosures` (`G/rooms/closure.ts:143`), `keepOutOfSquare` (`G/rooms/override.ts:37`), `openingOnWall` (`G/openings/offsets.ts:70`), `openingHostUpdates` (`G/openings/hosting.ts:31`, input `{ level, walls, previousWalls, openings }`), `createOpeningData` (`G/openings/opening.ts:24`, input `{ kind, host, center, swing? }`; also step 2). No open question: Q-0657 answered (b) (phase-auditor; a flagged opening's Width resizes along its `axis`, Decided `resizeOpening` (3)); the start-handle item is settled below. From EZD-204a (merged 98675b22): `OpeningObject` (`G/openings/opening.ts:8`), `autoRoughOpening` (`:18`), `isOpeningFlagged` (`:69`), `isVerticalLine` (`:73`), `leftEndIsLow` (`:77`). From EZD-204b (merged 53b8d3cc): `openingSpan` (`G/openings/offsets.ts:53`, `{ along, lo, hi, across } | null`), `hostCorners` (`:78`, `HostCorner[]`, `[]` for a zero-length host), `openingOffsets` (`:120`, `OpeningOffsets | null`), `placeAtOffset` (`:141`, `PlaceAtOffsetInput` → `{ ok: true; center } | { ok: false; reason: 'invalid_input' | 'past_corner' | 'overlap' }`). All re-exported from the package root (`G/openings/index.ts`).

## 5. Visual checklist
None (no screen changes; geometry only).

## 6. Proposed wording
None (refusals are codes; EZD-212b and EZD-212c map them to messages).

## 7. Security review
security-review: no (pure geometry; no route, table, policy, permission or money).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer · calc-auditor yes · ui-verifier no · security-reviewer no.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
High: geometry with the 1/64" tolerance, 1/16" rounding, joins, tee faces and room areas (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Opus 5.5 (calculation-heavy values), builder Opus 5.5.

## 9. Dependencies
Row: EZD-204a (done, 98675b22), EZD-204b (done, 53b8d3cc) (the opening v4 schema, `createOpeningData`, `autoRoughOpening`, `leftEndIsLow`, `isVerticalLine`, `hostCorners`, `openingOffsets`, `openingSpan`, `placeAtOffset`, `openingHostUpdates`), EZD-203 (`moveWall`, `findWallJoins`), EZD-205b (override clear in `reconcileRooms`, `keepOutOfSquare`, `openChain`), EZD-201 (`parseLength`, `formatLength`). Missing from the row (done): EZD-205a (`findRoomOutlines`, `roomAreaSqFt`, `reconcileRooms`, rooms fixtures), EZD-202 (schema, `ModelObject`).
Risks: (1) S3's 1/16" room needs `findRoomOutlines` to keep a 0.0625" × 120" outline (09k says it exists at 0.05 SF); if it drops it, that is an EZD-205a defect, raised as one, not a test change. (2) Closed 2026-11-09: EZD-204b merged with the names, signatures and failure codes this plan uses (re-validation, section 2). (3) 11 rule 4: these functions scan the level; EZD-212b and EZD-212c own per-move cost. (4) The flagged resize (Q-0657 (b)) relies on the `axis` rule and the +x default, both confirmed in merged code (`G/openings/hosting.ts:59`, `:85`; `door-symbol.ts:59`).

## 10. Open questions
None open. Q-0657 answered (b) (phase-auditor): a door or window Not on a wall resizes keeping the chosen jamb fixed along its stored `axis` (no `not_on_wall` for width); applied in Decided `resizeOpening` (3) and O2.

# EZD-211b · Door and window tools on the plan

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-211-1 to AC-EZD-211-20 (the EZD-211b rows, `vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:899-918`)
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** ui, testing
- **User-visible result:** Press D or N (or tap Door or Window), point at a wall and see the door or window with its distances to both corners; click, lift or type an offset to place it; Space, the arc and the hinge dot flip the door.
- Phase: 5 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
G = `packages/geometry/src`, A = `app/src`. P211 = `vault/plans/EZD-211.md` (split proposal; this part is its steps 13-24 and the Decided rows named under Part EZD-211b, carried here with the fixes in D:Parent fixes). P211a, P208a, P208b, P204a = those plans' section 3; P204b = its section 3 and step 1 signatures. D:x = Decided row "x" below. ppi = `handle.getPixelsPerInch()`.

Data: none. No table, migration or `schema_version` change; opening objects (P204a Opening v4: `data.geometry.center`, `.hostWallId`; `data.attributes.kind`, `width`, `height`, `swing`, `hand`, `sillHeight`, `number`) are written through `store.applyEdit` and the outbox. No money field.

### Build steps

None (no screen changes; EZD-213b has the checklist).

## 6. Proposed wording
Settled here for EZD-213b to render (P213 "The part plan settles"); style of S03d W-list and `office.tools.gap.*`. Reused as approved: `office.length.refused` for a refused Rough opening (Q-0640 row 5-5); `office.tools.gap.zero_length`, `.too_long` (cap 200' 0" = `MAX_WALL_LENGTH_IN` 2400), `.join_lost` for Length (`en.ts:500-502`); "Wall" / "Door" / "Window" for an unnumbered title (`en.ts:408-410`); "Not on a wall".

| --- | --- |
| W1, wall with no room on either side | Not in a room |
| W1, opening with no room | Wall 7 (the host only) |
| W1, opening not on a wall | Not on a wall |
| W5, free wall end | to the end of the wall |
| W5, corner wall without a number | to the inside corner |
| W9, no room on either side | Up on the plan / Down on the plan (vertical wall: Left on the plan / Right on the plan) |
| W10, no room on the swing side | Opens outside · hinge on the left |
| W10, no room on either side | Opens up on the plan · hinge on the left |
| W10, vertical wall (Q-0642) | hinge at the top / hinge at the bottom |
| W14, several doors or windows | 2 doors selected / 2 windows selected |
| Thickness, stud would be 0" | That would leave the stud 0" thick |
| Thickness, no stud | This wall has no stud layer to change |
| Layer at 0" | A layer must be thicker than 0" |
| Only stud changed | The wall needs its stud layer |
| Height, Size or Rough opening at 0" | Must be more than 0" |
| Width or Offset past a corner | That goes past the end of the wall |
| Width or Offset over another opening | That overlaps another door or window |

No text for `not_found`, `not_applicable`, `not_shared`, `not_door`, `not_window`, `not_shutter` or `negative`: EZD-213b shows only the fields the selection takes (Decided "Which objects a field takes", "Single-object fields"; Q-0645 (a)) and a typed length has no minus sign (`G/length.ts` shapes), so the panel cannot send them. `invalid_input` from a typed field cannot occur after `parseLength` (finite); EZD-213b shows `office.length.refused` for it.

## 7. Security review
security-review: no (pure functions; no route, table, policy, permission or money).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer · calc-auditor yes · ui-verifier no · security-reviewer no.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
High: 1/16" rounding, the 1/64" tolerance, room areas through the reconcile and joined-wall moves (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Opus 5.5, builder Opus 5.5.

## 9. Dependencies
- Ticket row: EZD-204a, EZD-204b (done; STATUS deviations re-validated 2026-11-12, section 2: no test value changed), EZD-212a (Q-0657 (b): Width on an opening Not on a wall resizes it along its `axis`; this plan follows it through `resizeOpening`), EZD-294, EZD-201, EZD-203, EZD-205a, EZD-120b, EZD-210a (done). None missing.
- Risks: a deviation in P204b's `openingOffsets` / `wallEditChanges` or P212a's `resizeWall` / `resizeOpening` changes T8, T11, T13, T17 (re-validated 2026-11-12 against the merged code: unchanged). The view parses the whole level per call; on the benchmark floor (about 1,500 objects, ARCH Benchmark project) it must stay inside the 50 ms selection budget (measured by EZD-213b).

## 10. Open questions
None open. Answered (phase-auditor), each matching the plan's default:
- Q-0658 answered (a): with more than one stud layer, a typed Thickness changes the first stud in layer order, left face to right face (Decided `setWallThickness`, T2).
- Q-0659 answered (a): Height, door and window Width and Height, Rough opening and Sill height display at 1/16" like Thickness (Decided "Display text", T20, T21, T24).

# EZD-212b · Move tool and dragging

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-212-3, AC-EZD-212-6, AC-EZD-212-7, AC-EZD-212-15, AC-EZD-212-16, AC-EZD-212-18 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:927-932`, stage-0)
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** ui, testing, canvas
- **User-visible result:** Josh presses M (or the Move button) and moves the selection by dragging, by clicking a base point then a target point, or by typing a distance, with snapping and a dashed preview; with Select he drags objects straight away; a door slides along its wall and a door left off every wall turns red.
- Phase: 5 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: planned · Re-validated 2026-11-12 against develop 36e25c9b (212a a25a4656, 208a, 208b, 204a, 204b, 211b a6d830d8 merged)

## 1. What to build
Paths: `A/` = `app/src/`, `G/` = `packages/geometry/src/`. 212a, 204b, 208a, 208b, 211b = `vault/plans/EZD-<id>.md` section 3, all merged; where a name below differs from those plans, the merged code named here governs (re-validated 2026-11-12). | `office.tools.gap.use_move` (replaces `fix_later`) | This gap runs both ways. Move a wall to close it. |
Refusals reuse `office.tools.gap.zero_length`, `.too_long`, `.join_lost` (approved, `en.ts:602-604`).

## 7. Security review
security-review: no (client tool gating only; the server already refuses saves without Edit model, S03 Permissions; no route, table, policy or migration).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer always · calc-auditor no (numbers come from 212a and 09k) · ui-verifier yes · security-reviewer no.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
high: a new pointer pattern shared by the drawing and selection controllers across about 22 files, with exact snap-dependent values (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Sonnet 5.5; builder Opus 5.5.

## 9. Dependencies
Row: EZD-212a, EZD-208a, EZD-208b, EZD-206, EZD-209, EZD-210b, EZD-294, EZD-010b, EZD-016a (visual checklist). Missing from the row: EZD-204a (`OpeningObject`, `createOpeningData`) and EZD-204b (`openingHostUpdates`), both used directly (reached today only through 212a and 208a); EZD-217 (`openingsOn`, `openingChange` exported, 65b98407); EZD-211b (`SelectionLink`, `attachSelection`, `claimSelectPointer`, `DrawingFrame.opening`, door and window rail entries; a6d830d8); EZD-219 (snap settings); EZD-120b (`applyEdit`, `undo`). All are done.
Risks: every dependency is merged; this plan was re-validated against develop 36e25c9b (2026-11-12). D7 builds inside 211b's controller (`ToolState`, `buildFrame`, `keyDown`), so a later change to those lines before this build needs another re-validation of D7, D8 and section 3. QP-1 is a UI choice that changes no test value here. Per-move cost: one `moveSelection` or `dragTo` plus `previewShapes` over the open floor's objects, no React (11 rule 4); the benchmark pan check (EZD-207c) is unaffected (no new work on pan).

## 10. Open questions
- QP-1: With Select, a press on a selected door's hinge dot or swing arc (EZD-211b's flip targets, within 22 px) is taken by the flip before a drag can start, so dragging from those spots does nothing while dragging from the rest of the door moves it; options: (a) keep it as built (the door drags from its body only), or (b) a flip press that moves past 10 px becomes a drag of the door. The plan builds (a) until answered; no test value here depends on it (B2 presses at the door centre, 18" from the hinge, outside the 8.25" target at 8/3 px per inch).

## 5. Visual checklist
Viewport: desktop 1600 × 1000, fixture as B5 at `view` (8/3 px per inch). The tablet bar is checked by B6's computed styles.
| Element | State | Mockup |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Selected wall: two handles `r 5`, white, cobalt 2 px, at the centre-line ends | filled | S03dWallSelected |
| Wall chips: cobalt pills 26 px, white 13 px DM Mono, on a dashed `4 4` leader face to face, 12 px end ticks; `4' 10"` / `6' 10"` | filled | S03dWallSelected (`rx 13`) |
| Selected door: a handle at each jamb, hinge dot over the hinge one; chips `1' 8"` / `2' 2"` | filled | S03dDoorSelected |
| Door resize: dragged handle filled, dashed outline, width chip 36 px off the wall opposite the swing | filled | S03dDoorSelected State · resize |
| Two selected: no chips, no handles | empty | Q-0630 row 10 |
| View-only: chips as text, no handles, no Move | no permission | Q-0630 row 9 |
| Chip entry: Distance in the bar, box above; refused entry shows the formats message, box open | error | S03Plan typed bar |

## 6. Proposed wording
| Where | Text |
| --- | --- |
| `office.tools.resize.failed` (toast: a resize that could not be done; style of P212b `office.tools.move.failed`) | Couldn't change the size. Try again. |
`office.typed.next_field` "Next field" and `common.cancel` "Cancel" are approved (S03d T2, T3). Labels reuse `office.typed.field.distance` (P212b), `office.typed.field.offset_left`/`offset_right` (P211a), `office.typed.field.length`, `office.typed.field.width`; refusals reuse D4's keys.

## 7. Security review
security-review: no (client display and gating; saves need Edit model on the server, S03 Permissions; no route, table or policy change).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer · calc-auditor no (sizes come from P212a, audited there) · ui-verifier yes · security-reviewer no.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
high: a press claim shared with P211b and P212b, a per-move overlay without React, permission and touch tests (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author sonnet-5-5 medium; builder opus-5-5 high.

## 9. Dependencies
- Ticket row: EZD-212b (done, 6229456b), EZD-208a (done, 6bd575c3), EZD-208b (done, d660c58c), EZD-209 (done), EZD-210b (done), EZD-014a (done), EZD-016a (done; browser harness, required by section 5).
- Missing from the row (and from `tickets.json` `depends_on`; the orchestrator adds them): **EZD-211b** (done, a6d830d8: opening chips, claim seam, `OpeningFrame`, chip CSS); **EZD-211a** (done, ea169ee7: `PRESS_MOVE_PX`, `DOOR_TARGET_PX`, `doorTargetAt`, `doorSymbol`, door and window fields); **EZD-212a** (done, a25a4656: size and chip functions, used directly); **EZD-219** (done, a3de1bda: its STATUS ACTION adds it here and asks for `settings: snapSettings()` on every new snap call; D11 does this through `moveSnap`); EZD-204a/b (`openingSpan`, `leftEndIsLow`); EZD-010b (icons, done). All merged on develop by 2026-11-12; section 1 re-validated against their code that day (lesson EZD-025).
- Q-0657 answered (b) (flagged openings resize along `axis`; merged in `resize-opening.ts:62-71`): D1 and U1 still give a flagged opening no handles until QP-1 is settled.
- Q-0744 open (UI): QP-2.
- Risks: D11 widens the claim, so a press on a handle resizes instead of starting a Select drag (intended); chip buttons sit over the canvas at each leader's midpoint (with E of `ROOM` selected, near (72, 60)), so an earlier browser test that clicks there after selecting one wall would press a chip; step 12's runs of `move.spec.ts`, `selection.spec.ts`, `door-window-tools.spec.ts`, `drawing-tools.spec.ts` and `editor.spec.ts` prove none does, and a failure there is a PLAN-GAP, never a test edit; `wallChips` runs per pointer move in drags (no React render; the EZD-017 pan benchmark has no selection); E2 and E4 edit EZD-211b's and EZD-208a's tests.

## 10. Open questions
- QP-1 (design): Q-0657 was answered (b), so a Not-on-a-wall door or window can be resized (merged `resizeOpening`, keeping a jamb fixed along `axis`), but this plan (D1, U1) still shows it no drag handles; options: (a) keep no handles, the flagged opening is resized only from the inspector Width (EZD-213); (b) show both jamb handles at `center ± axis·width/2`, resized by `resizeOpening` with `keep` from `leftEndIsLow(axis, coordsEqual(axis.x, 0))` as `resize-opening.ts:64-66` reads it, which changes U1's flagged-door value from no handles to two. Recommended (b), the answer's "keeping the chosen jamb fixed".
- QP-2 (UI): open Q-0744 option (b) ("a flip press that moves past 10 px becomes a drag of the door") contradicts Q-0633 G6 ("on the hinge dot a press that moves resizes"), which this plan builds (D11, C6, E2); options: (a) Q-0744 covers the swing arc only and the hinge dot keeps G6's resize; (b) hold D11's dot branch until Q-0744 is answered. Recommended (a).

# EZD-5604a · Assistant change format, apply and check

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-5604-1 (format, 100 cap, whole-reply refusal), AC-EZD-5604-2, AC-EZD-5604-6, AC-EZD-5604-8 (temporary refs, status, remove as Delete, old and new shapes in the result), AC-EZD-5604-9 (provisional value, rough opening rules), AC-EZD-5604-10 (`acceptance-criteria.md:1877-1882`; split AC map, `vault/plans/EZD-5604.md`)
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** testing, data-model, security, api
- **User-visible result:** nothing on screen yet (EZD-5604b draws it). An Assistant reply becomes a checked list of drawing changes: every change passes the same rules as drawing by hand, and one bad change refuses the whole reply.
- Phase: 56 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
Shorthands: G = `packages/geometry/src` (`@ezdraft/geometry`), A = `app/src`, AS = `A/server/assistant`, AE = `A/editor/assistant`, AL = `A/lib/assistant`. P<n> = `vault/plans/EZD-<n>.md`, section 3 unless a row is named. Data: none (no table, route, policy, migration or `schema_version` change).

Start after every section 9 dependency is merged. Names this plan does not create come from the named plan's contract or merged code (L-043); a differing merged name goes back to the planner, never guessed.

### Build steps

| 2 | `AS/assistant.ts` | change | `type AssistantReply = { message: string; changes: AssistantChange[] }`; `AssistantSuccess.changes: AssistantChange[]`; `parseAssistantReply` per D-Parse; `ASSISTANT_SYSTEM_PROMPT` per D-Prompt; nothing else in the file changes | itself | `pnpm --filter @ezdraft/app exec vitest run src/server/assistant/assistant.test.ts` |
| 3 | `A/server/ai/test-harness/recordings/anthropic.ts` | change | the `add_door` and `move_wall` reply texts per D-Recordings; every other recording unchanged | itself | same as step 2 |
| 4 | `AE/apply-reply.ts` | new | `type AssistantRefusal` (D-Refusal); `type AssistantPreview = { ok: true; changes: Change[]; added: string[]; removed: string[]; updated: string[]; touched: string[]; provisional: Record<string, number> } \| { ok: false; reason: AssistantRefusal }`; `type OkPreview = Extract<AssistantPreview, { ok: true }>`; `touchedIds(before: Objects, changes: readonly Change[]): string[]`; `applyAssistantReply(input: { objects: Objects; floorId: string; changes: readonly AssistantChange[]; refs: Readonly<Record<string, string>>; highs: NumberHighs; newId: () => string }): AssistantPreview` | `A/editor/tools/model-changes.ts` (pure, header comment, imports from `@ezdraft/geometry`) | `pnpm --filter @ezdraft/app exec vitest run src/editor/assistant/apply-reply.test.ts` |
| 5 | `docs/architecture.md` | change | D-Docs | itself | `node --test scripts/conventions/__tests__/architecture-doc.test.mjs` |

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D-Schema | `z.union` of five `z.strictObject`s (zod 4.6.7; `z.number()` refuses NaN and ±Infinity, test C2). Shared parts: `R = z.string().regex(ASSISTANT_REF_PATTERN)`, `P = { x: z.number(), y: z.number() }` strict, `LAYER = { material: z.enum(WALL_MATERIALS), thickness: z.number() }` strict, `SIZE = { width: z.number(), height: z.number() }` strict. **WallAdd** `op 'add'`, `type 'wall'`, `ref R`, `floor R` opt, `start P`, `end P`, opt `thicknessSide z.enum(THICKNESS_SIDES)`, `thickness`, `height`, `bearing z.boolean()`, `layers z.array(LAYER)`. **OpeningAdd** `op 'add'`, `type z.enum(['door','window'])`, `ref R`, `floor R` opt, `hostWall R`, `center P`, opt `width`, `height`, `roughOpening SIZE`, `sillHeight`, `swing z.enum(DOOR_SWINGS)`, `hand z.enum(DOOR_HANDS)`, `impactRating z.enum(IMPACT_RATINGS)`, `shutterType z.enum(SHUTTER_TYPES)`. **WallUpdate** `op 'update'`, `type 'wall'`, `ref R`, opt `start`, `end`, `thickness`, `height`, `bearing`, `layers`. **OpeningUpdate** `op 'update'`, `type` door/window, `ref R`, opt `center`, `width`, `height`, `roughOpening`, `sillHeight`, `swing`, `hand`, `impactRating`, `shutterType`. **Remove** `op 'remove'`, `type z.enum(['wall','door','window'])`, `ref R`. Refines: WallAdd and WallUpdate refuse `thickness` and `layers` together; each update needs at least one optional key. No `status`, `number`, `roughOpeningMode`, `id`, `topCutToCeiling`; no `floor` or `hostWall` on an update; no `thicknessSide` on an update (strict, so refused). No other number bound: the hand setters check values (P213a "Above 0 inches"); `max_tokens` 8,192 bounds arrays (Q-0638 limits). Values are not rounded (03g). | Q-0637 change format row; Q-0638 gap 15 (status not writable, temporary refs); Q-0640 row 7 (flag not writable); Q-0642 row 4; AC-2 (only what hand drawing can set: P213a `InspectorEdit` has no top-cut, side or host field; Q-0630 row 11 a hosted door cannot be dragged off its wall) |

| D-Prompt | Append to `ASSISTANT_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, after "…links or images.", one space then exactly: `Each change is one JSON object. Add a wall: {"op":"add","type":"wall","ref":"n1","start":{"x":0,"y":0},"end":{"x":120,"y":0}} with optional thicknessSide (left, right or center), thickness, height, bearing and layers. Add a door or window: {"op":"add","type":"door","ref":"n2","hostWall":"w1","center":{"x":60,"y":0}} with the center on the host wall's line and optional width, height, roughOpening {width, height}, sillHeight (windows only), swing and hand (doors only; left or right), impactRating (not_rated, impact_rated or shutter) and shutterType. An add's ref is a new short name such as n1; later changes in this reply may use it as hostWall. Update: {"op":"update","type":"wall","ref":"w1"} plus only the fields that change: start and end (move both ends by the same distance to move a wall; move one end along the wall's line to change its length), thickness, height, bearing, layers (keep the number of layers); for a door or window center (along its own wall), width, height, roughOpening, sillHeight, swing, hand, impactRating, shutterType. Remove: {"op":"remove","type":"window","ref":"o1"}. Name each ref in at most one change. Never write status, number or any other field.` Not user-visible. | P5602 D-System ("EZD-5604 adds the change fields"); this table's D-Schema, D-Wall update, D-Opening update |
| D-Recordings | Texts (messages unchanged): `add_door` `{"message":"Added a 3' door on w2.","changes":[{"op":"add","type":"door","ref":"n1","hostWall":"w2","center":{"x":100,"y":0}}]}`; `move_wall` `{"message":"Moved w1 12 inches north.","changes":[{"op":"update","type":"wall","ref":"w1","start":{"x":120,"y":108},"end":{"x":0,"y":108}}]}`; `delete_window` is already valid and stays as is. | D-Refusal | `AssistantRefusal = 'unknown_ref' \| 'duplicate_ref' \| 'wrong_type' \| 'other_floor' \| 'wall_length' \| 'join_lost' \| 'wall_reshape' \| 'opening_position' \| 'invalid_value' \| 'invalid_result' \| 'too_many'`. Callee reasons: `zero_length`, `too_long` → `wall_length`; `join_lost` → `join_lost`; `past_corner`, `overlap`, `not_on_wall` → `opening_position`; `wall_not_found`, `not_found` → `unknown_ref`; every other (`invalid_point`, `invalid_delta`, `invalid_length`, `invalid_input`, each `WallEditReason` and `OpeningEditReason`) → `invalid_value`. EZD-5604b shows one plain message for all (AC-1). | Split proposal part a "result"; P203 `MoveWallResult`; P212a; P213a; P204b; P211a |
| D-Resolve | One pass over `changes` in order on `scratch = new Map(objects)`; `temp = new Map<string, string>()` (add ref → new id); `used = new Set<string>()` (every change's `ref`). Ids compare lower-cased (`sameId`, `G/walls/move.ts`). (1) A change whose `ref` is in `used` → `duplicate_ref`. (2) Add: `ref` that `Object.hasOwn(refs, ref)` → `duplicate_ref`; `floor` given and not (`Object.hasOwn(refs, floor)` and `refs[floor]` = `floorId`) → `other_floor`. (3) Update/remove `ref`, and an add's `hostWall`: id = `refs[ref]` when `Object.hasOwn`, else (hostWall only) `temp.get(ref)`, else `unknown_ref`; an update or remove whose ref is in `temp` → `duplicate_ref`.
