## 5. Visual checklist
None (no screen changes; EZD-5604b draws the preview).

## 6. Proposed wording
None (no user-visible text; the refusal message is EZD-5604b's; the system prompt is not user-visible).

## 7. Security review
security-review: yes. Areas: API (the reply parser and its refusal path) and data access (AI output is untrusted input that becomes model changes; refs checked with `Object.hasOwn`; AC-6). No table, route or policy change.
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer · calc-auditor yes (09k limits, rough opening, save-set counts) · ui-verifier no · security-reviewer yes.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
High: untrusted model output is turned into model changes through every hand-drawing rule and the room and host reconcile, with exact geometry and counts (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Opus 5.5; builder Opus 5.5.

## 9. Dependencies
- From the row: EZD-5602 (parser, `AssistantSuccess.refs`, recordings, system prompt), EZD-204a (`createOpeningData`, `DEFAULT_*_SIZE`, `v4.json`), EZD-204b (`openingHostUpdates`, `placeAtOffset`, `wallEditChanges` host updates), EZD-211a (`openingPreview`, `withOpeningSize`), EZD-213a (`setWall*`, `setOpening*`, `levelModelObjects`), EZD-217 (`deleteChanges`, `openingChange`, `openingsOn`), EZD-294 (numbers), EZD-210a (`wallEditChanges`), EZD-120b (`Objects`, `Change`, `applyEditTo`, `makeEdit`). EZD-211b is in the row but nothing here needs it.
- **Missing from the row:** EZD-212a (`resizeWall`, `endDragLength`, `placeOnWall`, `resizeOpening`; also reached through EZD-213a); EZD-203 (`moveWall`, `createWallData`; done) and EZD-205a (`reconcileRooms`; done).
- Risks: every dependency except EZD-294, EZD-210a and EZD-120b is unmerged, so names come from plan contracts (re-validate at Stage 3 step 1). A1, A11 and A13 assume one room update for a moved wall (P205a overlap match); a different merged count is a PLAN-GAP, not a test change. Typing `changes` can break tests that build `AssistantSuccess` with `{}` changes: the test-author greps `AssistantSuccess` in `*.test.ts*` and makes each element `{ op: 'remove', type: 'window', ref: 'o1' }` (L-021). No performance budget is touched (A11 runs 96 reconciles in one unit test).

## 10. Open questions
None.

# EZD-5604b · Assistant preview on the canvas and in the panel

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-5604-3, AC-EZD-5604-4, AC-EZD-5604-5, AC-EZD-5604-7; AC-EZD-5604-1 (the plain message), AC-EZD-5604-8 (old shape red dashed, new shape blue), AC-EZD-5604-9 (the chip shown) (`acceptance-criteria.md:1883-1889`; split AC map, `vault/plans/EZD-5604.md`); the Accept, Adjust, Reject clause of AC-EZD-5603-10 (Q-0651 (a))
- **Complexity:** high
- **Areas:** ui, tokens, testing, realtime
- **User-visible result:** After the Assistant answers with a change, the plan shows it as a preview: blue for what is added, red dashed for what is removed, with the legend and the new object's number, and Accept, Adjust and Reject under the reply. Nothing is saved. A reply that doesn't fit the drawing says so plainly. If the drawing changes under the preview, the preview goes stale and gives the prompt back.

## 6. Proposed wording

| `office.assistant.reply_refused` (under a reply whose change does not fit) | The assistant's change doesn't fit the drawing. Nothing on the drawing changed. Try wording the prompt another way. |
| `office.assistant.preview_stale` (stale preview) | The drawing changed after this preview was made, so it can't be accepted. |
| `office.assistant.preview_stale_action` (stale button) | Put the prompt back |

## 7. Security review
security-review: no. Nothing is saved; no table, route, policy or permission changes; P5604a carries the untrusted-input checks (split proposal part b).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier yes · security-reviewer no.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
High: a new canvas layer, a store with one staleness rule over local and remote mutations, and panel states across EZD-5603a, EZD-5604a and EZD-5605 contracts (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Sonnet 5.5; builder Opus 5.5.

## 9. Dependencies
- Row: EZD-5604a (`applyAssistantReply`, `OkPreview`), EZD-5603a (session, panel, editor wiring), EZD-5603b (Photo button, panel props), EZD-016a (done; harness). EZD-211a/b, EZD-213a/b/c, EZD-208a/b: kept from the row; no code of theirs is called here beyond what EZD-5603a mounts.
- **Missing from the row:** EZD-204b (`openingSpan`; also behind EZD-5604a) and EZD-204a (`createOpeningData`, G3). Done: EZD-294 (`NumberHighs`, `withObjectNumber`), EZD-238 (drawing list), EZD-210b (overlay), EZD-120b (store, patches).
- Q-0654: EZD-5605 is re-validated against section 3 (S3-S5, S7 match P5605's rows).
- Risks: EZD-5603a, EZD-5603b and EZD-5605 all edit `assistant-session.ts`, `AssistantPanel.tsx` and `ProjectEditor.tsx`; build order 5603a → 5603b → 5604b → 5605. Two `planDrawingList` passes per open or replace, none per pan.

## 10. Open questions
- Q-0662: answered-agent (a), 2026-11-09. While a preview is stale the canvas hides it (lines, chips and legend) and the stale line and its button show, since its old shapes no longer match the drawing. Applied in D-Layer, L1 and B2.
- Q-0663: answered-agent (b), 2026-11-09. The legend swatches use a new board-cited `--ez-radius-3: 3px` token (`S03cAIAssistant.dc.html:141-142`; 3 px is not in 04:11), as Q-0040 (c) did for 6 px. Applied in step 1, the Done-when list and section 5.

# EZD-364 · Fix: launcher units keep long background gates, and a gate clears the leftover app server on its lane - **ACs:** AC-EZD-364-1 (T1, T2), AC-EZD-364-2 (T3-T12; T10-T12 added after the code review, 2026-11-09) - **Complexity:** medium - **Areas:** tooling, testing, security - **User-visible result:** the phase gate runs to the end, and a test server left by a stopped gate no longer blocks the next gate; Josh no longer has to stop it with `sudo kill`. - Phase: 1 · Planned by: orchestrator (session 13) · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: ready ## 1. What to build Two faults, one chain (Josh 2026-11-09 chat: "please fix this left over server issue so it doesn't continue to happen"). 1. **Cause.** Claude Code 2.1.321 stops a `run_in_background` Bash command at its background deadline, the larger of the call's `timeout` and `BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS` (default 600000 ms). The gate-phase unit's full gate (`scripts/gate.mjs . --full`, gate-phase SKILL step 1) runs longer than 10 minutes, so it was stopped at exactly 10:00 (session 6780e373, task b285203og: started 20:13:35, "stopped after reaching its background time limit" 20:23:35 UTC, 2026-11-09). `scripts/run.mjs` `runUnit` already sets `CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS=0` for the same class of stop after the last turn (run.mjs:324-326); it does not set `BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS`. 2. **Symptom.** Playwright starts its `webServer` (`app/playwright.config.ts:135`, `pnpm start -p -H 127.0.0.1`) in its own process group, so when the gate is stopped mid e2e the server survives as user `ezdraft`, parent 1, and holds the lane's web port. The next gate's e2e fails with "http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health is already used" (gate-phase 4 handoff, 18:11 UTC). # EZD-214 · Status and phase switch (split proposal)

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-214-1 … AC-EZD-214-9 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:993-1001`, stage-0), shared out to the parts below (AC-1 split by clause; AC map)
- **Complexity:** high (both parts); reasons per part
- **Areas:** ui, data-model, migrations, testing, security, api
- **User-visible result:** The status bar's View control switches the plan between Existing and Proposed: the Existing view hides New work, the Proposed view hides Demo, and the project remembers the choice. A wall drawn in Proposed is New. A wall, door or window's Status can be set to Existing, Demo or New in the inspector, for one object or many at once.
- Phase: 6 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: split proposal

## Split proposal

**Why.** Planned whole, the ticket touches about 32 files and needs about 40 tests. That is over the size rule (PROCESS.md section 6 "Ticket size": about 20 files or 25 tests; Josh 2026-10-22). Where the count comes from:
- Data and API. `project.phase_default` exists as a plain nullable text column (`supabase/migrations/20261019165203_create_project.sql:18`). EZD-214 adds the check (existing or proposed), the default Existing and not null (03 Q-0664 row "View default"; AC-1). The column then has to be loaded with the model (`app/src/server/model/model.ts:329-332` selects only id, name, tenant_id, customer; `ModelLoad.project` in `app/src/lib/outbox/model-api.ts:14`). It also needs a write route checked on Edit model. No project update route exists (`app/src/app/api/projects/` has GET/POST list, model, objects, checkpoints, sync-conflicts). The RLS policy `project_update` lets any member who can see the project update the row (`supabase/migrations/20261019170006_create_tenancy_policies.sql:45-50`), so the route is where Edit model is checked: security review.
- Display. The phase view and the three Phase eyes live in a device-session store (03 Q-0664: "eye toggles … belong to the device session … reset on reload"; Q-0667: a View switch resets the eyes). The canvas then leaves hidden statuses out of the drawing list (`app/src/editor/plan/batches.ts:74` `planDrawingList`), the wall hover index (`app/src/editor/plan/hover.ts:135`) and the pick index (`app/src/editor/selection/pick-index.ts:64`). The hover and pick indexes resync by changed ids, so a visibility change needs a full resync, the way a floor change already does (`hover.ts:147-158`). Then comes the status-bar View control (board S03Plan footer) and its browser tests.
- Status on objects. Every creation path hard-codes `status: 'existing'`: `createWallData` (`packages/geometry/src/walls/wall.ts:58`), `createOpeningData` (`packages/geometry/src/openings/opening.ts:38`) and new rooms in `reconcileRooms` (`packages/geometry/src/rooms/sync.ts:92`). Their editor callers are `wall-chain.ts:58`, `room-rect.ts:54`, `model-changes.ts:135` and the opening tool (EZD-211a/b). Each must take the view's status (S03 Status bar "View" row; 03 Q-0630 row 6 "Existing until EZD-214"; AC-1, AC-5).
- The inspector Status select for walls, doors and windows, with bulk Mixed and one undo step, built on P213a/P213b (05 Q-0664 row "Status on objects").
- The assistant's change format gains `set_status` (05 Q-0664 row "AI commands"; P5604a D-Schema, D-Prompt).

**Why cut here.**
- Part a is the view: data, route, store, canvas filter and the status-bar control. It needs no inspector and no tool change. Its browser tests seed New and Demo objects through the existing test hook `__ezdraftEditor.edit` (`app/src/editor/ProjectEditor.tsx:165-177`).
- Part b is the status on objects: creation paths, inspector, assistant. It reads part a's store through one function, so neither part guesses the other's names.
- Each part is under the size rule: part a about 17 files and 23 tests, part b about 16 files and 18 tests.
- Built a → b. Each part is planned as its own unit from its section here. Each part plan applies the planner lessons for its areas. For part a: L-009 (run the check-constraint SQL on the pinned stack), L-016 and L-023 (only if a function is added), L-049 (the edit to `app/src/server/db/tenancy.test.ts:196`, which writes `phase_default: 'x'` and is refused by the new check), L-052 (empty, malformed and over-limit bodies on the route; every caller of `ModelLoad`), L-060 (migration timestamp after the newest on develop at merge time; touch targets for the two View buttons), L-061, L-054 and L-064. For part b: L-021 (catalog lists pinned by tests), L-050, L-052 (every caller of the changed creation signatures, including `app/src/server/projects/template-objects.ts:40`, `packages/geometry/src/benchmark/benchmark.ts:91` and the three `test-utils/fixtures.ts`) and L-064.

### Part EZD-214a · Phase view and display
- **Scope:**
  - **Migration.** `project.phase_default`: existing nulls become `existing`; default `existing`; not null; check `phase_default in ('existing','proposed')`. `database.types.ts` is regenerated (03 Q-0664 "View default"; AC-1 "new projects start Existing"; 09m row 7). No object row is rewritten. Every stored object is already Existing (09-calc Q-0558; 03 Q-0630 row 6; the three creation paths above), so both views show it (AC-6; 09m row 1).
  - **Load.** The model route returns the project's `phaseDefault` with the model (`ModelLoad.project`). Every `ModelLoad` fixture and caller gets the new field.
  - **Write.** A route sets `phase_default` for one project. It runs only with Edit model on that project (03 Q-0664: "the toggle writes it (Edit model)"; `requirePermission` pattern in `app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/model/route.ts:28-30`). A body other than `existing` or `proposed` is refused. Another company's project reads as not found. The edit lock is not built yet: the editor gates edits on `viewer.canEdit` only (`ProjectEditor.tsx:280`). The part plan states that the lock ticket adds the lock check to this route. Behaviour when the write cannot reach the server (Q-0670): offline, the newest choice is held and sent once the app is back online, newest wins; a write that fails while online shows the existing "Changes not saved" banner (`office.editor.save_failed`) with Retry. The part plan follows the same rules as P219 Decided "Save failure / offline" and "Failed banner" (the same answer, Q-0680), so both status-bar settings behave alike.
  - **Phase store** (device session, in `app/src/editor/`):
    - `view` (`existing` | `proposed`), starting from the loaded `phaseDefault`.
    - `eyes` (`existing`, `demo`, `new`, each on or off).
    - `setView(view)` resets the eyes to that view's defaults: Existing view → Existing and Demo on, New off; Proposed view → Existing and New on, Demo off (Q-0667; AC-9). For an editor it then writes `phase_default`. For a view-only user it writes nothing (AC-7; 05 Q-0664 "Views and permissions").
    - `setEye(status, on)` overrides the display until the next View switch or reload (AC-3; Q-0667).
    - `shown(status)` is the one test the canvas uses.
    - `newObjectStatus()` gives `existing` in the Existing view and `new` in the Proposed view. Part b reads it (S03 Status bar "View" row; AC-1).
    - Pure rules first, so 09m rows 1 to 7 are one table test.
  - **Canvas.** An object whose status is not shown is left out of the drawing list, wall hover and the pick index, for every object type through its `data.status`. Rooms carry status (Q-0570), and dimensions and text will (03 Q-0667), so a later type needs no change here (CLAUDE.md rule 18). A View or eye change rebuilds the drawing list once and resyncs both indexes in full. Pan and zoom stay as they are (11 rules 2 and 4). A hidden opening does not cut its wall: the wall is drawn whole where it sits, as the wall stands in that phase (Q-0668 (a)). A hidden object is part of nothing else: it is not box-selected, not taken by Select all, not snapped to while drawing or moving, and leaves the current selection when it becomes hidden (Q-0671 (a)).
  - **Status bar.** The View control from board S03Plan: label `View`, a group with accessible name `Phase view` and two buttons `Existing` and `Proposed`. The active button is white with ink text. It goes in `StatusBar`'s `start` slot (`app/src/components/shell/StatusBar.tsx:9`). The slot is shared with EZD-219's Scale, Snap, Cursor and Zoom, which are not built here. The control shows for view-only users too and works as display only (05 Q-0664 "Views and permissions").
  - **Test hook.** The phase store is exposed on the dev test hook, so EZD-218's eyes and these browser tests drive `setEye`.
- **Tests (about 23) and files (about 17):**
  - migration and db tests: check, default, backfill, the `tenancy.test.ts` edit;
  - route tests: 401, 403 without Edit model, 404 for another company, 400 for a bad body, 200 writes;
  - the load returns `phaseDefault`;
  - phase-store table tests: 09m rows 1 to 7, AC-9 reset, override held until switch;
  - canvas filter tests: the drawing list without hidden statuses; one rebuild per View switch; hover and pick skip hidden objects;
  - control component tests: the active button, and view-only;
  - browser specs for Josh's Slice 6 step 1, display half, with a seeded New wall: Existing hides it and Proposed shows it; the choice survives a reload; a view-only user's switch writes nothing.
- **Done when:**
  - With a New wall and a Demo wall in the model, the Existing view hides the New wall and shows the Demo wall, and the Proposed view does the reverse (09m rows 2, 4).
  - Turning an eye on or off overrides the view until the next switch, and a switch resets the eyes (09m rows 5, 6; Q-0667).
  - An editor's View choice is saved on `project.phase_default` and survives a reload; a new project opens in Existing.
  - A view-only user's switch changes the display and saves nothing.
  - Objects stored before this phase show in both views.
- **ACs:** AC-EZD-214-1 (control, saved choice, new projects Existing), -2, -3, -6, -7, -9.
- **Depends on:** EZD-213a, EZD-213b, EZD-213c (ticket row; same phase order). **Missing from the row:**
  - EZD-208b: it wires the selection controller into `ProjectEditor.tsx`, which this part also changes, and owns box select and Select all (Q-0671).  - EZD-016a: browser harness, visual checklist.
  - Done already: EZD-005a (project table), EZD-120b, EZD-120c (load and store), EZD-012b (`StatusBar`), EZD-207a, EZD-207b (canvas, hover), EZD-208a (pick index), EZD-210b (drawing tools).
- **The part plan settles:** the route path and body; the store's file and exported names; the visual checklist from board S03Plan (`.ssg`, `.ssi`, `.ssion` in `vault/mockups/html/project/S03Plan.dc.html:42-44,164`); how the answers to Q-0668 (a), Q-0670 and Q-0671 (a) are built.
- **Complexity:** high: a migration, a permission-checked write route, a store and a filter across three canvas indexes (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Sonnet 5.5, builder Opus 5.5.
- **security-review: yes**: permissions, data access, API (a new write route on `project`; RLS lets any visible member update the row). **Reviewers:** code-reviewer · security-reviewer yes · ui-verifier yes · calc-auditor no.

### Part EZD-214b · Status on objects
- **Scope:**
  - **New objects take the view's status.** `createWallData` and `createOpeningData` take a status. New rooms made by `reconcileRooms` take a status, and `wallEditChanges` passes it on (`app/src/editor/tools/model-changes.ts:105-143`). Every editor creation path passes part a's `newObjectStatus()`: wall chain, room rectangle (four walls and the room), door and window tools, rooms made by an edit, and assistant adds. Sources: S03 Decisions "Existing/Proposed sets the default status for new objects"; 03 Q-0630 row 6; AC-1, AC-5. Paste and Duplicate keep the copied status (05 Q-0630 row 19). Template walls at Create stay Existing (new projects start Existing; `app/src/server/projects/template-objects.ts:40`). The part plan decides whether the status argument is required, so no caller can leave it out (CLAUDE.md rule 18).
  - **Inspector Status select.** The wall panel's read-only Status row (P213b `inspector-status`, "Status, read only") becomes a select: Existing, Demo, New, each with its board dot. Grey `#7a828e`, red `oklch(0.6 0.19 28)` and cobalt `oklch(0.55 0.17 262)` are the S03Plan Phase rows (`S03Plan.dc.html:82-84`). Door and window panels get the same row after Impact rating / Sill height. There is no header pill (05 Q-0664 "Status on objects"; Q-0633 G7).
  - **Status edits.** P213a's `InspectorEdit` gains a status field. Bulk edit shows Status as Mixed when the selected objects differ. One change over the selection is one `applyEdit`, so it is one undo step (AC-4; `app/src/editor/model/model-store.ts:73-78`). Each object's status is set on its own and there is no cascade to hosted openings (S03 Decisions "Demo is set per object"). A bearing wall may be set to Demo until EZD-215 adds the engineer block (EZD-215 row; 05 Q-0630 row 15 precedent). View-only users read Status as plain text (05 Q-0630 row 9).
  - **Saved.** The change goes through the existing save path and survives a reload (AC-5; 03a).
  - **Assistant.** P5604a's `assistantChangeSchema` gains `{ op: 'set_status', ref, status }` (05 Q-0664 "AI commands"; AC-8). `applyAssistantReply` lists it under `updated`, so P5604b previews it as an update. The `D-Prompt` sentence "Never write status, …" is rewritten to name `set_status`. `remove` stays the Delete key. P5604a test C2's "`status` on an update is refused" stays true.
- **Tests (about 18) and files (about 16):**
  - geometry tests for the status argument of each creation function;
  - tool tests: a wall chain and a room rectangle drawn in Proposed are New, room included; a door placed in Proposed is New;
  - inspector edit and view tests: single, bulk, Mixed, one undo step;
  - panel tests: wall, door and window rows, and view-only;
  - assistant schema and apply tests;

- Q-0670: When an editor switches the View offline, or the `phase_default` write fails, the display switches at once, but whether the choice is (a) kept on the device and sent when the app is back online, latest choice winning (S03 States "Offline: edits continue and save on the device"), (b) shown as failed with the existing "Changes not saved" banner and Retry, or (c) dropped, so the next open uses the stored value, is undecided; recommended (a).

# EZD-135 · System status data and route

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-135-1, AC-EZD-135-2, AC-EZD-135-4 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:1044-1046`; `tickets.json` EZD-135 `acs`)
- **Complexity:** medium (section 8)
- **Areas:** security, migrations, data-model, api, testing
- **User-visible result:** none on screen yet: the server can now list the company's failed background jobs (last 30 days) and failed EZ Binder deliveries, and the last off-site file copy, database dump and restore drill, for users with the System status switch only; the page that shows them is EZD-135b.
- Phase: 6 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-11 · Status: planned
- Template: v2
- Plan step: code-bound

## Brief
This ticket is part a of the split in git d90b6f94 (`vault/tickets/phases/phase-01.md:48`; review-plans 6 finding 1, `vault/plans/review-phase-06.md`); the page, cards, wording and alert link are EZD-135b (`phase-01.md:49`). The code-bound step reuses the decisions, sources and part-a test rows (U1 (c), U2, U3, U4, D1, D2, D3) of the whole v2 plan kept in git at 6a0539ee (`vault/plans/EZD-135.md`), re-checking every code fact at develop HEAD (lesson EZD-025: cite merged code, not an earlier plan).
| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plain words | A read route, for users with the System status switch, that returns the active company's failed background jobs (status failed, last 30 days, newest first, 50 per page), its failed EZ Binder deliveries (`error_alert` kind `webhook_failed`), the last succeeded off-site file copy and database dump, and the last finished restore drill of any status; backup and drill rows come through a definer function that refuses a user without the switch |
| ACs | AC-EZD-135-1 (route part: refused without the switch), AC-EZD-135-2 (data part: the four lists and their rules), AC-EZD-135-4 |
| Screens | none (the page is EZD-135b) |
| Tables | `job` and `error_alert` (read through RLS, tenant only); `backup_run` (read only through the new definer function `public.system_backup_status()`); one new index on `job` for failed rows by finish time |
| Routes | `GET /api/settings/system-status?part=jobs\|webhooks\|backups[&page=n]` |
| Files (estimate) | 14 |
| Tests (estimate) | 25 |
| Split | no |

## 1. What to build

# EZD-218 · Left panel: Layers and Rooms (split proposal)

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-218-1 … AC-EZD-218-6 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:1010-1015`, stage-0), shared out to the parts below (AC-5 split by clause; AC map)
- **Complexity:** high (both parts); reasons per part
- **Areas:** ui, data-model, testing, migrations
- **User-visible result:** The plan editor gets its left panel. The Layers tab shows and hides Existing, Demo and New work, the overlays and the rooms, and locks a layer so nothing on it can be picked. The Rooms tab lists each room with its area. A room can be renamed and given a room type, floor finish and ceiling type, and these stay after a reload. Clicking a room, in the list or on the plan, selects it, and a list click also zooms to it.
- Phase: 6 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-10 · Status: split proposal

## Split proposal

**Why.** Planned whole, the ticket touches about 24 source files and 12 test files and needs about 36 tests. That is over the size rule (PROCESS.md section 6 "Ticket size": about 20 files or 25 tests; Josh 2026-10-22). It also builds on EZD-214a's phase store, whose file and names are not fixed yet: EZD-214 is still a split proposal, and its part plans settle them ("The part plan settles: … the store's file and exported names", `vault/plans/EZD-214.md`). Where the count comes from:
- **Room data.** Room attributes are `{ name }` only (`packages/geometry/src/schema/room.ts:19`, strict). Adding type, floor finish and ceiling type is not optional, so it is a new schema version (03 Q-0664 "Rooms gain …"; AC-6; 03b rule 5; ARCH Model schema "Version rule"). `CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION` is 4 (`schema/migrate.ts:15`), and no phase 5, 56 or 6 plan raises it. Five code paths make rooms: `rooms/sync.ts:89`, `rooms/override.ts:82`, `benchmark/benchmark.ts:129`, `app/src/server/projects/template-objects.ts:52`, and `app/src/editor/tools/model-changes.ts:62`, which passes data through. Tests pin version 4 in `numbers.test.ts:49`, `benchmark.test.ts:74`, `wall-layers.test.ts:84,106`, `opening.test.ts:96,196,201`, `migrate.test.ts:38`, `room.test.ts:79,89,93` and `app/src/server/model/opening-upgrade.db.test.ts:108`. About ten test fixtures build `attributes: { name }` rooms.
- **Rooms on the canvas.** The pick index holds walls and openings only (`app/src/editor/selection/pick-index.ts:83-97`; ARCH Selection "never rooms"; 05 Q-0630 row 8: "Rooms not selectable until EZD-218"). Rooms need a pick shape (`PickShape` has `quad` and `bar` only, `packages/geometry/src/selection/shapes.ts:10-12`). They also need a selected and hovered look: `objectGeometry` keeps only `existing`/`demo`/`new`/`flagged` items, and a room's fill is on layer `rooms` (`app/src/editor/plan/hover.ts:80-85`; `drawing/build.ts:180`). Every selection user must then cope with a room id. EZD-217 already skips rooms (P217 `copyItems`, test C5). EZD-212b moves walls and openings only (P212b D7 `moveModels`). The inspector's view skips rooms, but its edits refuse an id they do not handle (P213a "Selection ids").
- **The panel.** The tab row, the Layers tab (Phase, Overlays, Rooms) and the Rooms tab with its fields. A device-session layer store holds the Rooms and overlay eyes and every lock. Hiding reaches EZD-214a's canvas filter, and locks go through EZD-5605's `SelectionDeps.selectable?` seam (P5605 D-Selectable). Then the editor wiring, the messages and the browser tests.

**Why cut here.**
- Part a is the room data and the room as a selectable object. It needs no panel and can be tested through the existing test hook `__ezdraftEditor.edit` (`app/src/editor/ProjectEditor.tsx:165-177`) and `__ezdraftSelection` (P208b C7).
- Part b is the panel. It reads part a's room fields and part a's pick index unchanged, and EZD-214a's store through the names EZD-214a's plan fixes.
- Each part is under the size rule: part a about 14 source files and 16 tests, part b about 11 source files and 20 tests.
- Built a → b. Each part is planned as its own unit from its section here, after the questions below are answered and after EZD-214a's plan exists (part b), and applies the planner lessons for its areas. For part a: L-021 and L-049 (the pinned-version tests and room fixtures listed above, each a test-author edit row), L-042 (fixtures to update for the changed type), L-043, L-052 (every caller of the room-making paths) and L-064. For part b: L-021, L-048 (if any async read is added), L-050, L-054 and L-060 (every eye, lock, tab and row button listed for `expectTouchTargets`), L-062 and L-064.

**Settled from the sources (both parts follow these; not questions):**
- **Tabs.** There are two text tabs, Layers and Rooms, styled as the board's `.seg`/`.segon` (`S03Plan.dc.html:79`). Layers is the default. The Versions tab is hidden until EZD-122 (phase 9) ships it (Q-0673 (c); Q-0500; AC-1 as amended). This replaces the ticket row's five icon tabs. Tasks and Takeoff are added later as text tabs by EZD-1420 and EZD-1613 (05 Q-0664 "Left panel tabs").
- **Overlays.** Only overlay rows whose object kind exists are shown, and the Overlays heading is hidden while it has none (Q-0674 (b)). In phase 6 no overlay kind exists (Electrical slice 18, Ceiling slice 16, Architect DXF slice 13, Dimensions EZD-216), so the Layers tab shows Phase and Rooms only; each later ticket adds its row and, with the first row, the heading.
- **Lock look.** Unlocked: Material Symbols `lock_open` in the hidden-row grey `#9aa3af`; locked: `lock` in ink; 18 px like the eye (Q-0675 (a)).
- **Room selected and hovered look.** Selected: the room's outline in the selection cobalt, no fill; hovered: the outline in the translucent hover lines, no fill (Q-0676 (a)).
- **Drag inside a room.** A press with no wall or opening under it still starts a box, even inside a room; rooms are never dragged or moved (Q-0677 (a)).
- **Locking a layer with selected objects.** Its objects leave the selection at once (Q-0678 (a)), the same rule as for hidden objects (Q-0671 (a)).
- **Inspector with only a room selected.** The inspector title is the room's name, and under it one line points to the Rooms tab (Q-0679 (b); wording in section 6). The room's fields stay in the Rooms tab only.
- **Phase rows.** Existing, Demo and New with dots grey `#7a828e`, red `oklch(0.6 0.19 28)` and blue `oklch(0.55 0.17 262)` (`S03Plan.dc.html:82-84`). Their eyes are EZD-214a's `setEye` and eye state. A View switch resets them, and they always show what the canvas shows (05 Q-0667 "Phase eyes after a View switch"; P214 split "Phase store").
- **Rooms is a layer.** It has an eye and a lock like a Phase or Overlay row (00g "Layer": "a Phase row, an Overlay or Rooms … shown, hidden or locked"; PHASES Slice 6 Josh's script step 2 "lock the Rooms layer").
- **Locks.** Each layer row has a lock icon left of its eye (S03 Decisions "The layer filter is a lock icon on each layer row"; 05 Q-0664 "No new board"). Eyes and locks belong to the device session, are not saved and reset on reload (03 Q-0664 "View default"; AC-3).
- **Membership.**
  - An object is in the Phase layer of its `data.status`. A room is also in the Rooms layer. A later object kind joins its overlay when its ticket adds it: Dimensions is EZD-216, a dependent (00g "Overlay").
  - An object is drawn only when every layer it is in is shown.
  - An object can be selected only when none of its layers is locked (AC-2, AC-3; 00g "Eye", "Layer lock").
- **What a lock filters.** A locked object is left out of click, box select, Select all and the hover that shows what a click would select (S03 Canvas "Hover", "Drag on empty space … Respects layer filter", "Ctrl/Cmd+A … visible, selectable layers"; AC-3). Part b passes the lock test through P5605's `selectable` wrapper, combined with the assistant's Adjust filter, so both apply (P5605 D-Selectable, D-Wire).
- **View-only users.** Eyes, locks and the Rooms list work for them without saving. Room edits need Edit model, and a view-only user reads the fields as plain text (05 Q-0664 "Views and permissions"; Q-0630 row 9).
- **Room fields** (03 Q-0664 "Rooms gain …"; S15h line 22; S05 line 32; AC-4, AC-6):
  - `attributes.roomType`: one of `kitchen`, `bath`, `laundry`, `other`, or `null`.
  - `attributes.floorFinish`: free text, `''` when none, until EZD-1611a.
  - `attributes.ceilingType`: one of `flat`, `single_slope`, `vaulted`, `tray`, `coffered`, or `null`.
  - The v4 → v5 step gives every stored room `null`, `''` and `null`.
  - Photos wait for EZD-220 (03 Q-0664).
  - A name may not be blank (`roomDataSchema` `name: z.string().min(1)`, `room.ts:19`).
- **Area in the lists.** Whole square feet, halves up, shown as `{n} sf` (`roomAreaSqFt`, `rooms/area.ts:29`; 09j Room area rows 1-10; board `165 sf`; AC-4).
- **Room picking.**
  - A click first picks walls and openings exactly as now (P208a R5: under the cursor, else within 10 px).
  - Only when there is none does it pick the rooms that hold the point, smallest first.
  - A repeated click cycles outward from a wall to the room (S03 Canvas "Click", "Repeated click … next larger object"; 05 Q-0630 row 7). Rooms go last so that wall picking from inside a room keeps its 10 px capture.
  - Box select (inside or touch) and Select all include the rooms of the open floor (S03 Canvas; AC-5).
- **Selection users.** The inspector is given the selection without room ids, so neither its view nor its edits ever see one (P213a "Selection ids … rooms … view skips them"; CLAUDE.md rule 18). Delete, Copy and Duplicate already skip rooms (P217 C5), and Move moves walls and openings only (P212b D7).
- **Room row click.** It calls `selection.select([id])` (P208a A12, which keeps only selectable ids) and `handle.showObject(id)` (P207b; ARCH Plan canvas "Show"). AC-5 says "a room row", so this holds for rows in the Layers tab and in the Rooms tab.
- **Rooms tab layout.** Rows are styled as the board's Layers > Rooms rows (`S03Plan.dc.html:95-96`). The room that is selected alone shows its fields under its row, in the inspector's field style (S03dWallSelected). There is no board for this, so it follows the nearest Studio board (tickets README rule 5; 05 Q-0664 "No new board"). Rooms are listed for the open floor in stored order, the order P213a uses for room names ("Sub-line rooms … map order").
- **Room edits.** Each committed field is one `store.applyEdit` of one room change, so it is one undo step. Undo and redo follow ARCH "Patch store and outbox". The edit is saved through the existing save route, which parses it (ARCH Model schema "Save rule"), so it survives a reload (AC-4). Text fields commit on Enter or blur and reset on Escape, as P213b D-Length field does. Name and floor finish are trimmed.

### Part EZD-218a · Room fields and selectable rooms
- **Scope:**
  - **Schema v5.** `roomDataSchema.attributes` gains `roomType`, `floorFinish` and `ceilingType`, with exported `ROOM_TYPES` and `CEILING_TYPES`. A `newRoomAttributes(name)` helper returns `{ name, roomType: null, floorFinish: '', ceilingType: null }`. `CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION` becomes 5, with `MIGRATIONS[4]` (rooms only; it copies `data` and `data.attributes` and mutates nothing) and `samples/v5.json`. Every room-making path calls the helper: the five above, plus whatever EZD-214b leaves in `sync.ts` (L-052).
  - **Room pick shape.** `PickShape` gains `{ kind: 'ring'; points: readonly Point[]; area: number }`, and `roomPickShape(room)` is added. It returns `null` for fewer than 3 points or zero area, and area is `outlineAreaSqIn`. `shapeDistance`, `shapeBounds`, `shapeInRect` and `shapeTouchesRect` handle `ring` the way `quad` is handled, through `pointInRing` (`shapes.ts`).
  - **Pick index.** Rooms of the open floor are indexed, and EZD-214a's visibility filter applies to them like any object. `pick` puts rooms after walls and openings, as above. `inRect` and `all` include rooms. A new `outline(id)` gives a room's ring.
  - **Look.** The selected and hovered room outline (Q-0676 (a), settled above), through an outline lookup next to `setBodyLookup` (`hover.ts` `objectGeometry`, `controller.ts`).
  - **Drag from inside a room** starts a box when no wall or opening is under the press (Q-0677 (a); `selection-controller.ts` box start, `press.candidates`).
  - **Inspector** gets the selection without room ids (settled above). With a room selected alone it shows the room's name as its title and the section 6 line `office.inspector.room_in_rooms_tab` (Q-0679 (b)).
  - **Docs.** ARCH "Selection (EZD-208)" gets the pick rule with rooms. ARCH "Model schema (EZD-202)" gets version 5 with the room fields.
- **Tests (about 16) and files (about 14 source, plus the pinned-version and fixture edits listed under Why):**
  - migrate and schema tests: v4 room → v5 with `null`, `''`, `null`; the chain to v5; every room maker's output parses;
  - shape tests for `ring` (inside, edge, box inside and touch);

- **Q-0673: (c)** tabs Layers and Rooms only; Versions hidden until EZD-122.

- **Q-0675: (a)** `lock_open` grey `#9aa3af` unlocked, `lock` in ink locked, 18 px.
- **Q-0676: (a)** selected room: cobalt outline, hover: translucent hover lines, no fill.
- **Q-0677: (a)** a press with no wall or opening under it starts a box, even inside a room; rooms never move.
- **Q-0678: (a)** objects of a layer being locked leave the selection at once.
- **Q-0679: (b)** inspector title is the room's name plus one line pointing to the Rooms tab (section 6).

The questions as asked:
- Q-0673 (design): EZD-122, which fills the Versions tab, is phase 9, so in phase 6 the Versions tab (AC-1; board S03) could be (a) shown and disabled until EZD-122, (b) shown and selectable with an empty panel and one line of proposed text, or (c) hidden until EZD-122 under Q-0500 ("left-panel tabs … appear only when the ticket that builds them ships"), against AC-1's three tabs; recommended (a).
- Q-0674 (design): The Overlays rows Electrical, Ceiling and Architect DXF have no objects until slices 18, 16 and 13, and Dimensions none until EZD-216; options: (a) all four rows as on board S03, each eye on and each lock off at open, acting on nothing until its kind ships (the DXF row's expand and recolor wait for the DXF ticket); (b) only rows whose kind exists, with the Overlays heading hidden while it has none; recommended (a), since it follows the board and AC-2.
- Q-0675 (design): The lock left of each eye has no board (Q-0664), and undecided is its unlocked look: (a) Material Symbols `lock_open` in the board's hidden-row grey `#9aa3af` when unlocked and `lock` in ink when locked, 18 px like the eye; (b) `lock` in both states, grey when unlocked and ink when locked; recommended (a).
- Q-0676 (design): No board shows a selected or hovered room; options: (a) its outline drawn in the selection cobalt (hover: the translucent hover lines), no fill; (b) a translucent cobalt tint over the whole room; recommended (a), so walls and openings inside stay readable.
- Q-0677 (design): Once rooms can be picked, nearly every box select starts inside a room, and today a box starts only on empty space (P208a; S03 "Drag on empty space"); options: (a) a press with no wall or opening under it still starts a box, even inside a room, and rooms are never dragged or moved; (b) a drag starting inside a room moves the room's walls; recommended (a).
- Q-0678 (design): When a layer is locked while some of its objects are selected, they could (a) leave the selection at once, as Q-0671 (a) proposes for hidden objects, or (b) stay selected until the selection next changes; recommended (a).
- Q-0679 (design): With only a room selected, the inspector (whose view skips rooms, P213a) would show its empty text "Select something on the plan to see its details here." (W15); options: (a) keep that, with the room's fields only in the Rooms tab; (b) show the room's name as the inspector title and one proposed line pointing to the Rooms tab; (c) a room panel in the inspector with the same fields (needs a board); recommended (b).

# EZD-235 · Derived values

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-235-1, AC-EZD-235-2 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:1074-1075`, stage-0). AC-EZD-235-3 belongs to EZD-235b (split applied in git dcc76ffe).
- **Complexity:** medium (section 8)
- **Areas:** performance, testing, data-model, docs
- **User-visible result:** nothing new on screen. Room labels show the same areas, but moving a wall now recomputes only the areas of the rooms it changed, and nothing is recomputed while no view is asking.
- Phase: 6 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-11 · Status: planned (part a of the split in git dcc76ffe; replaces the split proposal text)
- Template: v2

## 1. What to build

Ticket row (`vault/tickets/phases/phase-02.md:57`): **Scope:** "One pattern for everything computed from the model: pure functions in the geometry package, cached by the object ids they read, recomputed only when one of those objects changes and only while a view is asking for the value. Room areas and auto dimensions are the first users. The Web Worker pool is EZD-235b." **Done when:** "Moving one wall recomputes the areas of its rooms only (the test counts recomputes); a derived value is recomputed only while a view is asking for it." **Depends on:** EZD-205, EZD-207. **Spec ref:** Non-functional · Performance (rules 2 and 3).

Short names used below: G = `packages/geometry/src`, A = `app/src`. Verify aliases: `gv` = `pnpm --filter @ezdraft/geometry exec vitest run`, `av` = `pnpm --filter @ezdraft/app exec vitest run` (both run from the worktree root). No table, migration, route, message or `schema_version` change. The behaviour of every export is in section 3 and the Decided table; this section says where and how.

Files (16): source and doc (builder) `G/rooms/area.ts`, `G/derived/derived.ts` (new), `G/derived/index.ts` (new), `G/index.ts`, `G/drawing/build.ts`, `A/editor/derived/model-derived.ts` (new), `A/editor/plan/batches.ts`, `A/editor/plan/controller.ts`, `docs/architecture.md`; tests (test-author) `G/derived/derived.test.ts` (new), `G/rooms/area.test.ts`, `G/drawing/build.test.ts`, `A/editor/derived/test-utils/two-room.ts` (new), `A/editor/derived/model-derived.test.ts` (new), `A/editor/plan/batches.test.ts`, `A/editor/plan/controller.test.ts`.

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D-Where | The cache, its types and `ROOM_AREA` are pure TypeScript in `G/derived/derived.ts` (no DOM, no Node API), so a worker or the server can run them. The store binding is editor code in `A/editor/derived/model-derived.ts`. | ticket Scope ("pure functions in the geometry package"); 11 Where each output is produced; ARCH Folder layout (`packages/geometry/` "pure TypeScript, no UI"); ARCH Entry points (`app/src/editor/` editor-only) |
| D-Pull | A value is computed only inside `get`. An edit, a store change or `prune` never calls a compute. A value nobody asks for is never computed. | 11 rule 2; ticket Scope; AC-EZD-235-2 |
| D-Source | A `DerivedSource` answers the same for its whole life. A changed model is a new source object; the cache never assumes a source changed in place. | 11 rule 2 (identity per object); CLAUDE.md rule 18 (one rule that cannot drift) |
| D-Read | `compute(read, key)` gets a recording wrapper of the source. Every `read.object(id)` call records `{ id, value }` (the returned reference, `null` included). Every `read.objectsOf(type, level)` call records `{ type, level, items }` (the returned array). Repeated reads are recorded again; nothing is deduplicated. | ticket Scope ("cached by the object ids they read"); glossary 00g "Derived value" |
| D-Valid | An entry is valid against a source when it was last checked against that same source object, or when every recorded `object(id)` read returns the same reference now (`null` equals `null`) and every recorded `objectsOf(type, level)` read returns an array of the same length with the same reference at every index. A valid entry is a hit and then records that source as last checked. An invalid entry is recomputed and replaced. `lastChangedIds` is never read. | ticket Scope ("recomputed only when one of those objects changes"); `A/editor/model/model-store.ts:95-112` (`applySavedNumbers` replaces objects without setting `lastChangedIds`); CLAUDE.md rule 18 |
| D-Key | Entry key `` `${def.name}\u0000${key}` ``. `key` is any string, `''` included; for object definitions it is the object's `Objects` map key. | P235 split proposal contract (`DerivedDef.compute(read, key)`) |
| D-Name | The cache remembers the first `DerivedDef` object seen for each `name`. security-review: no (no tables, routes, permissions, money, auth or stored data; pure in-memory computation in the browser).

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
Medium: pure functions and one store binding with counted unit tests, two widened signatures with optional parameters, no build, browser or database risk. Test-author sonnet-5-5; builder sonnet-5-5 (high).

## 9. Dependencies
- Ticket row: EZD-205 (EZD-205a, EZD-205b) and EZD-207 (EZD-207a, EZD-207b, EZD-207c), all done.

- Dependents: EZD-235b (worker pool; extends the new architecture section), EZD-216 (auto dimensions), EZD-6001 (adds `chosen` after `options`), EZD-218b (Rooms tab areas); EZD-702b, EZD-901b, EZD-1001a and EZD-1611a take both parts (README: a base-number dependency means every lettered part).

# EZD-216 · Dimensions and text (split proposal)

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-216-1 … AC-EZD-216-8 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:1002-1009`, stage-0), shared out to the parts below. AC-1, -2, -4, -5 and -8 are split by clause (see the AC map).
- **Complexity:** high (all three parts); reasons per part
- **Areas:** ui, data-model, testing, security
- **User-visible result:** The rail's Dimension tool (L) measures between two points, along a wall face, or as an angle, and the Text tool (T) places notes with an optional leader that print at a fixed paper size. Each room gets its width and depth dimensions automatically and the floor gets its overall dimensions. These follow a wall move, keep where the user dragged them, and hide with the Dimensions eye. The assistant can add text and dimensions.
- Phase: 6 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: split proposal (Q-0674, Q-0683 to Q-0687 answered; the angular dimension waits on Josh for Q-0682)

## Split proposal

**Why.** Planned whole, the ticket touches about 35 files and needs about 60 tests. That is over the size rule (PROCESS.md section 6 "Ticket size": about 20 files or 25 tests; Josh 2026-10-22). The parts:
- **Two new stored object types.** `OBJECT_TYPES` holds `floor`, `wall`, `opening` and `room` only (`packages/geometry/src/schema/index.ts:18`). Q-0667 adds a dimension (kind linear or angular, two points or a wall and face, offset, override text or none, auto overall / room / none, its room) and a text (position, text, leader end or none, paper size 3/32" / 1/8" / 3/16" / 1/4"). Each carries `status` and `level` (03f). Every reader parses through `parseStoredObject`, and the save route refuses an unknown type (ARCH Model schema "Read rule", "Save rule"). So the server validation, the editor's parsers (`app/src/editor/plan/batches.ts:42-55`, `app/src/editor/tools/model-changes.ts:29-45`) and the pick index (`app/src/editor/selection/pick-index.ts:85-99`, walls and openings only) all meet the new types.
- **Measurement and formatting.** Linear lengths show at 1/2" (`formatLength(inches, 2)`, `packages/geometry/src/length.ts:68`; Q-0207; S03 "Data shown"). Two points within 1/64" place nothing (03g; `pointsEqual`, `tolerance.ts:11`). There is no 200 ft limit (`MAX_WALL_LENGTH_IN` is a wall and room field limit, Q-0570). Angles show in whole degrees, half up (09-calc Q-0664). Worked values: 09m Dimensions rows 1 to 8.
- **Auto dimensions.** Each room gets its inside width and depth from its bounding box. Each floor gets its overall extents of all walls, per axis. Both are recomputed through EZD-235's derived cache, and the user's offset is kept after a move (09-calc Q-0664; P235 K1-K3, K8).
- **Drawing.** The drawing list already draws one linear dimension input as a line plus its text on the `dimensions` layer (`packages/geometry/src/drawing/build.ts:253-289`; `types.ts:61-69` `dimensionInputSchema`). It has no witness ticks (board S03Plan draws end ticks, `S03Plan.dc.html:101,103`), no angular arc, no text object, no leader and no override underline (09h line 13). The plan feeds it no dimensions (`batches.ts:74-87`). Dimension text is a fixed `PLAN_DIMENSION_TEXT_PT = 10.5` (`batches.ts:30`). Q-0664 makes it 1/8" on paper and sizes every note by paper size at the plan scale (screen = paper × 96 px × zoom; 09m Text rows 1 to 5; EZD-219 gives the scale).
- **Two rail tools.** Dimension (L) and Text (T) (S03 rail; 04 Tool rail rows "Dimension", "Text"; board `S03Plan.dc.html:71-72`). Each brings an in-place text edit (typed override, double-click; S03 canvas "Double-click") and a note entry. `DrawingToolId` is `'wall' | 'room-rect'` today (`app/src/editor/tools/tool-defs.ts:14`), and `DRAWING_RAIL_TOOLS` is pinned by `tool-defs.test.ts:74`.
- **Overlay, move and the assistant.** The Dimensions overlay eye (S03 left panel; EZD-218 "Membership": "Dimensions is EZD-216"). Moving a dimension or text with the move tool (AC-4). The assistant's `add_text` and `add_dimension` (05 Q-0664 "AI commands"; P5604a D-Schema).

**Why cut here.**
- Part a is pure data and drawing: schema, measurement, auto-dimension values, drawing items, paper-size maths and the assistant format. It needs no canvas or tool. Its tests are unit tests on 09m's tables.
- Part b is the two tools and the in-place text on the plan, with dimensions and text picked for double-click.
- Part c is the auto dimensions living in the model: they are created and kept with each edit, moved by drag, follow wall moves, and hide with the Dimensions eye. That is Josh's Slice 6 step 4.
- Each part is under the size rule: part a about 15 files and 23 tests, part b about 15 files and 22 tests, part c about 11 files and 18 tests.
- Built a → b → c. Each part is planned as its own unit from its section here, after the questions below are answered and after the plans of EZD-214a/b and EZD-218a/b exist. Each part applies the planner lessons for its areas:
  - Part a: L-042 (fixtures for the widened `ModelObject` union); L-043 (`formatLength`, `pointsEqual`, `roomAreaSqFt`, `createDerivedCache` by file path); L-049 and L-021 (tests that pin `OBJECT_TYPES`, `DrawingLayer`, the drawing-view members or the assistant recordings); L-050; L-052 (empty, over-limit and malformed text, NaN points, and every caller of `buildDrawingList` and `ObjectIssueCode`); L-058; L-062 (EZD-120d line: build test objects from the package defaults); L-064.
  - Part b: L-021 (`tool-defs.test.ts:74` rail list; message catalog lists); L-048; L-050; L-052; L-054 and L-060 (touch targets for the two rail buttons and any new control); L-064 (EZD-210b lines: snap-safe browser coordinates; `toBeCloseTo` for angled values).
  - Part c: L-050; L-052 (every caller of `wallEditChanges` and of the room reconcile); L-062 (one rebuild per edit, exact recompute counts through `DerivedStats`); L-064.

### Part EZD-216a · Dimension and text objects, values and drawing
- **Scope:**
  - **Schema.**
    - New `schema/dimension.ts` and `schema/text.ts`, strict like every object (ARCH Model schema; Q-0667 field list).
    - Dimension. Kind `linear` or `angular`. Geometry is two points, or a wall id and face (left or right of the wall line, as `thicknessSide`, `schema/wall.ts:11`). Angular geometry waits on Josh (Q-0682, escalated; the recommended (a) two non-parallel walls with (c) a Linear / Angular switch is pending, not decided). `offset` in inches. `override`: a string or null. `auto`: `overall`, `room` or null. `room`: an id or null. An auto dimension also needs its axis, `x` or `y`. Q-0667 lists no axis, but a room and the overall each have two (09m row 8 shows two values; 09-calc Q-0664 "per axis"). Q-0667 calls the field list a schema choice the code-reviewer reviews.
    - Text. `position`, `text`, `leader`: a point or null, `paperSize`: one of the four sizes. `text`: one or more lines (a line break is stored as `\n`), 1 to 500 characters, from the glyph atlas's characters only; the schema refuses anything else (Q-0687 (b)).
  - **Glyphs.** The Latin-1 letters á, é, ñ, ü, ° and ½ join the glyph atlas (`app/src/editor/plan/glyph-atlas.ts:18-23`) and the font table (ARCH Drawing list "Font table"), so notes print on permit sets and the crew can read Spanish (Q-0687 (b)). A note with several lines is drawn one line under the other.
    - Both join `OBJECT_TYPES`, `DataByType` and `DATA_SCHEMAS` (`schema/index.ts:18-45`).
    - The schema version stays: a new type keeps every stored object valid (ARCH Model schema "Version rule"; `schema/migrate.ts:2-3`). If EZD-218a has raised `CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION` by then, nothing changes here.
  - **Values** (`packages/geometry/src/dimensions/`):
    - The measured length of a two-point or wall-face dimension. A wall-face dimension is measured from the wall's current face, so it follows the wall. When its wall is deleted, the dimension is deleted in the same edit (Q-0686 case 2 (a)); the pure step below names it.
    - The angle of an angular dimension.
    - The shown text: the override if set, else `formatLength(x, 2)` or whole degrees half up.
    - Nothing is placed when the length is within 1/64".
    - Two `DerivedDef`s on EZD-235's cache (P235 K1, K3):
      - auto room: the inside width and depth of the room boundary's axis-aligned bounding box (09-calc Q-0664; boundary per `schema/room.ts:16`);
      - auto overall: the outer extents of all walls of the floor per axis, wall thickness included ("outer", Q-0664; wall faces from `thicknessSide` and `thickness`).
    - A pure `autoDimensionChanges(objects, level)` that names the auto dimensions to add or remove: exactly one per room and axis, and one per floor and axis when the floor has walls. Its status rule: an auto room dimension takes its room's status, and the auto overall dimension is Existing (Q-0667). The same step also removes every wall-face dimension whose wall is gone (Q-0686 case 2 (a)). Part c wires it into edits.
  - **Paper size.**
    - Notes are 3/32" by default. Labels and dimension text are 1/8" (09-calc Q-0664).
    - A paper size becomes model inches as paper × 12 ÷ scale (09-calc Q-0664 "Plan display scale": 96 px per paper inch, px per model inch = 96 × scale ÷ 12).
    - The screen height is paper × 96 × zoom (09m Text rows 1 to 5).
    - The plan's dimension text moves from `PLAN_DIMENSION_TEXT_PT` to 1/8" at the plan scale. The part plan states how this maps onto `sizePt` and `PT_TO_MODEL_IN` (`app/src/editor/plan/glyph-atlas.ts:14`) and which glyph measure is the "height".
  - **Drawing list** (`drawing/build.ts`, `types.ts`). Stored dimension objects are drawn as:
    - a dimension line with end ticks (board S03Plan `S03Plan.dc.html:101,103`);
    - text centred in a gap;
    - an arc for an angular dimension;
    - an underline under override text (09h line 13: "typed-override dimensions underlined"; the drawing list also feeds sheets and PDF, ARCH Drawing list).
    Text objects are drawn as text plus an optional leader line with an arrowhead. Everything sits on the object's status layer for display filtering (EZD-214a). A dimension is also marked for the Dimensions overlay (part c). The part plan keeps P235 K7's `buildDrawingList(document, view, dimensions, options)` signature or replaces `dimensions` with the stored objects, and updates `batches.ts` to match.
  - **Assistant.** P5604a's `assistantChangeSchema` gains `add_text` and `add_dimension` (05 Q-0664 "AI commands"; AC-7). `applyAssistantReply` lists them under `added`, with the view's status as for any add (EZD-214b). `add_dimension` may name a wall by ref for a wall-face dimension. The `D-Prompt` text gains one sentence each. A recording for each is added (P5604a D-Recordings pattern).
- **Tests (about 23) and files (about 15):**
  - schema accept and refuse, each field's empty, over-limit and malformed case (note text: 500 characters accepted, 501 refused, two lines accepted, a character outside the atlas refused; Q-0687 (b));
  - the atlas and font table hold á, é, ñ, ü, ° and ½ (Q-0687 (b));
  - every existing object still parses at the same version;
  - 09m Dimensions rows 1 to 7 and row 8 values (`11' 9 1/2"` and `14' 0"` for 141.5 × 168), plus an overall case;
  - derived recompute counts after a wall edit (P235 `DerivedStats`);
  - `autoDimensionChanges` cases: a new room, a deleted room, a second floor, a New room's status, a deleted wall that removes its wall-face dimension (Q-0686 case 2 (a));
  - 09m Text rows 1 to 5;
  - drawing items for linear, wall face, angular, override, note and leader;
  - assistant schema accept and refuse, and the apply of each new change.
- **Done when:**
  - Dimension and text objects save and load through the existing validated save path.
  - 09m Dimensions rows 1 to 8 and Text rows 1 to 5 hold as unit tests.
  - Auto values recompute through the derived cache only when a wall or room they read changes.
  - An assistant `add_text` or `add_dimension` change applies as an add.
- **ACs:** AC-EZD-216-1 (values: 1/2" precision, 1/64" nothing, no 200 ft limit), -2 (values), -4 (values: inside bounding box, outer extents, recompute), -5 (paper sizes and screen size), -7, -8 (stored with status and level; auto status rule).
- **Depends on:** EZD-235 (ticket row); EZD-207a/b/c (ticket row, done). **Missing from the row:**
  - EZD-5604a (change format) and EZD-214b (`set_status` in the same files; view status for assistant adds);
  - EZD-218a (it may raise the schema version and widen rooms in the same `schema/index.ts`);
  - EZD-219 (plan scale; part a takes the scale as a parameter, so this is order only);
  - done already: EZD-238, EZD-202, EZD-205a, EZD-209 (`formatLength`).
- **The part plan settles:** the angular geometry after Josh answers Q-0682 (until then part a is planned for linear and wall-face only, with the angular parts held); the exact field names; the end tick and arrowhead sizes from the board's measurements.
- **Complexity:** high: two new stored types every reader meets, derived values, drawing maths and the assistant format (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Sonnet 5.5, builder Opus 5.5.
- **security-review: yes**: data access and API. Two new object types are accepted by the save route's server validation (03b rule 5), with user free text bounded there. The assistant change format is parsed on the server (P5604a). **Reviewers:** code-reviewer · calc-auditor yes (09m values, rounding, paper-size maths) · security-reviewer yes · ui-verifier no.

### Part EZD-216b · Dimension and Text tools
- **Scope:**
  - **Rail.** Dimension (L, icon `straighten`) and Text (T, icon `title`) join `DRAWING_RAIL_TOOLS` and `DrawingToolId` (board `S03Plan.dc.html:71-72`; 04 Tool rail). They are hidden without Edit model, like the other drawing tools (05 Q-0664 "Views and permissions": dimensions and text need Edit model; ARCH Drawing tools "absent without Edit model").
  - **Dimension tool** (pure reducer like `wall-chain.ts`, ARCH Drawing tools). Click two points, with snaps applied (S03 canvas "Snap" row), or click a wall face (hover per P207b `getHoveredWallId`/`wallAt`). Then place the line by its offset (S03 rail "place the dimension line"). The angular mode waits on Josh (Q-0682, escalated; recommended (a) click two non-parallel walls, then where the arc goes, with (c) a Linear / Angular switch in the typed dimension bar (Tab): pending). Two points within 1/64" place nothing (part a). Typing while placing sets the override text (S03 rail "type to override text"): it fills a "Text" field in the typed dimension bar (Q-0683 (a)).
  - **Text tool.** Click to place a note. The leader is optional (S03 rail Text). A click opens a text box in place on the canvas; Enter commits, Esc cancels (Q-0683 (a)), Shift+Enter starts a new line and the box takes at most 500 characters (Q-0687 (b)). A press-drag-release draws a leader from the press point (the arrow end) to the release point (the note) (Q-0683 (a)). Empty text places nothing.
  - **Inspector.** A selected note shows Text and Size (3/32", 1/8", 3/16", 1/4"; Q-0664); a selected dimension shows Measured value (read-only) and Override. Built from the Studio shell components with no new board (05 Q-0664 "No new board" precedent), and listed for Josh to confirm at Stage 2 (Q-0684 (a)).
  - **In-place edit.** Double-clicking a dimension or text opens its text in place (S03 canvas "Double-click"; AC-3). Enter commits as one edit. Esc cancels. Clearing an override returns to the measured value (00g "Dimension override").
  - **Picking.** Dimensions and texts join the pick index, so a click selects one and a double-click finds it (P208a pick rules). Shapes go in `packages/geometry/src/selection/shapes.ts`.
  - **Status.** New dimensions and texts take EZD-214a's `newObjectStatus()`, so one drawn in Proposed is New and hidden in Existing (Q-0667; AC-8).
  - **Size on screen.** Notes and dimension text keep their paper size at every zoom and scale. They are drawn as model-space glyph quads from part a's sizes, with no React render per pointer event (11 rules 2, 4; `glyph-atlas.ts:1-3`).
- **Tests (about 22) and files (about 15):**
  - reducer tables for both tools: two points, wall face, zero length, override typed, Esc, Enter; note with and without leader, empty text;
  - rail list and shortcut tests, with the `tool-defs.test.ts:74` edit;

- **Scope:**

A room's two auto dimensions are created with it and removed with it. A room's status change carries to its auto dimensions in the same edit (Q-0667). A room or floor stored before this ticket gets its auto dimensions from the next wall edit on that floor; nothing is written on open or for a view-only user (Q-0686 case 1 (a)). A wall delete removes its wall-face dimensions in the same edit (Q-0686 case 2 (a)). Delete skips auto dimensions: with one selected, Delete removes nothing of it; the user moves them or hides them with the Dimensions eye (Q-0685 (a)).

The eye hides and shows every dimension, auto ones included, and its lock keeps them from being picked (S03 left panel "Overlay: Dimensions"; 00g Overlay; P218 "Membership"). Texts are in their Phase layer only (AC-6 names dimensions).
  - **Canvas cost.** The auto values come from the derived cache. A wall move recomputes only the rooms and floor it touches and draws once per edit, with no React render per pointer event (11 rules 2, 4; P235 K10).

# EZD-237 · Benchmark page

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-237-1, AC-EZD-237-2
- **Complexity:** high
- **Areas:** data-model, migrations, security, api, ui, testing
- **User-visible result:** Settings → System status has a Benchmark card: Run benchmark opens the benchmark project, runs a scripted pan, zoom and wall drag, saves the frame times, and the history lists every run, newest first.
- Phase: 6 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: questions (Q-0688, Q-0689 answered; waiting on Josh for Q-0665)

## 1. What to build

Data: new table `benchmark_run` (03e; Q-0664 03-data-model). No money field. Reads and writes only through two definer functions; `authenticated` holds no table privilege.

**M1** `supabase/migrations/<ts>_create_benchmark_run.sql`, `<ts>` later than the newest migration on develop at merge time (L-060; newest today `20261109100000`). Confirm on pinned version (L-009): none of this SQL has been run.
- Table: `id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid()`; `tenant_id uuid not null references public.tenant (id) on delete cascade`; `created_by uuid null references public.app_user (id) on delete set null`; `device jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(device) = 'object')`; `app_version text not null check (char_length(app_version) between 1 and 64)`; `results jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(results) = 'object')`; `run_at timestamptz not null default now()`.
- Index `benchmark_run_tenant_run_at_idx on (tenant_id, run_at desc, id desc)` (11 rule 10; audit needs `tenant_id` first, `app/test-harness/rls/audit.ts:152`).
- RLS on. Policy `benchmark_run_select` for select to authenticated using `tenant_id = (select private.tenant_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.user_permission up where up.membership_id = nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'membership_id', '')::uuid and up.tenant_id = (select private.tenant_id()) and up.permission_key = 'settings_system_status' and up.granted)`. Restrictive policy `benchmark_run_api_gate` for all to authenticated, using and with check `(select private.require_api_gate())` (pattern `20261107180000_create_sync_conflict.sql`).
- `revoke all on public.benchmark_run from public, anon, authenticated;` `grant select, insert, update, delete on public.benchmark_run to service_role;` `comment on table public.benchmark_run is 'Data model entity: benchmark_run (EZD-237)';`
- **F1** `public.record_benchmark_run(p_device jsonb, p_app_version text, p_results jsonb) returns uuid`, plpgsql volatile security definer `set search_path = ''`. Steps, first failure wins: (1) `perform private.require_api_gate()`; (2) `v_tenant := private.tenant_id()`, `v_membership := nullif(auth.jwt() ->> 'membership_id','')::uuid`, `v_user := private.app_user_id()`; any null → `raise exception 'permission_denied' using errcode = '42501'`; (3) fewer than 2 granted rows in `public.user_permission` for `v_membership`, `v_tenant`, keys `settings_system_status` and `edit_model` → 42501 (Q-0664 05-screens); (4) `p_device` or `p_results` null or not `jsonb_typeof = 'object'`, or `p_app_version` null or length outside 1–64 → `raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023'`; (5) insert `(tenant_id, created_by, device, app_version, results)` = `(v_tenant, v_user, p_device, p_app_version, p_results)` returning `id`.
- **F2** `public.list_benchmark_runs(p_page integer) returns jsonb`, plpgsql stable security definer `set search_path = ''`. (1) gate; (2) tenant and membership as F1 (no `app_user` needed); (3) no granted `settings_system_status` row → 42501; (4) `p_page` null, `< 1` or `> 1000000` → 22023; (5) returns `jsonb_build_object('total', <count of the tenant's rows>, 'rows', coalesce(jsonb_agg(...), '[]'::jsonb))`, each row `jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'run_at', run_at, 'device', device, 'app_version', app_version, 'results', results)` from the tenant's rows `order by run_at desc, id desc limit 50 offset (p_page - 1) * 50`, aggregated in that order (Q-0664; 11 rule 9).
- Both: `revoke all on function … from public, anon, service_role;` then `grant execute … to authenticated;` (L-016; `20261106140002_create_benchmark_project_function.sql:65-66`).

## 7. Security review
security-review: yes. Areas: migrations, data access, permissions, API (new tenant table, two definer functions, two routes; the browser sends `app_version` and device text, validated by D-Input and F1).

High: a new table with definer functions and permission checks, two routes, a new measured-script pattern driving the editor, and two UI surfaces across 17 builder files. Test-author Sonnet 5.5 / medium; builder Opus 5.5 / medium (PROCESS.md section 4).

# EZD-6001 · Floor switcher and floor tools

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-6001-1, AC-EZD-6001-2, AC-EZD-6001-3, AC-EZD-6001-4
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** ui, data-model, testing
- **User-visible result:** Josh picks which floor the plan shows; with Edit model he adds, renames and deletes floors, and deleting a floor that still has walls asks first and deletes them with it. View-only users can switch floors but cannot change them.
- Phase: 6 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-09 · Status: questions (waiting on Josh for Q-0666; Q-0690 answered)

## 1. What to build

Data: none new. A floor is a `model_object` of type `floor` (`floor.ts` `{ name, order }`); Create already makes "Floor 1", order 1 (migration `20261105200003`; Q-0508, Q-0664). Floor edits go through the model store and outbox like any object. No `schema_version` change, no money field.

Key: S = `app/src/editor/`. FV = `Pick<FloorView, 'getState' | 'subscribe'>`.

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `S/floors/floors.ts` | new | `FloorEntry = { id: string; name: string; order: number }`; `listFloors(objects: Objects): FloorEntry[]`; `resolveOpenFloor(objects: Objects, chosen: string \| null): string \| null`; `objectsOnFloor(objects: Objects, floorId: string): string[]`; `nextFloorOrder(objects: Objects): number`; `addFloorChange(objects: Objects, id: string, name: string): Change`; `renameFloorChange(objects: Objects, id: string, name: string): Change \| null`; `deleteFloorChanges(objects: Objects, floorId: string): Change[] \| null`; `FloorViewState = { chosenId: string \| null }`; `FloorView = StoreApi<FloorViewState> & { setOpenFloor(id: string \| null): void }`; `createFloorView(): FloorView` | `S/plan/batches.ts` `lowestFloor` and `parsedObjects` (floor reading); `S/model/model-store.ts` (`zustand/vanilla` store) | `pnpm --filter @ezdraft/app exec vitest run src/editor/floors/floors.test.ts` |
| 2 | `S/plan/batches.ts` | change | `openFloorId(objects: Objects, chosen: string \| null): string \| null` (second parameter required) = `resolveOpenFloor(objects, chosen)`; `planDrawingList(objects: Objects, chosen: string \| null)` (the chosen floor is the last parameter; any parameter EZD-214a or EZD-218 added stays before it) builds the list for `resolveOpenFloor(objects, chosen)`; `lowestFloor` removed | itself | `vitest run src/editor/plan/batches.test.ts` |
| 3 | `S/plan/controller.ts` | change | `createPlanController(o: { store: …; floors?: FV }, deps)`; nothing else exported changes | the store subscription in `createPlanController` | `vitest run src/editor/plan/controller.test.ts` |
| 4 | `S/selection/selection-controller.ts` | change | `SelectionDeps` gains `floors?: FV` | the store subscription in `createSelectionController` | `vitest run src/editor/selection/selection-controller.test.ts` |

| 7 | `S/EmptyPlanHint.tsx` | change | `EmptyPlanHintProps` gains `floors?: FV`; new `hasNoWallsOn(objects: Objects, floorId: string \| null): boolean`; `hasNoWalls` unchanged | itself | `vitest run src/editor/EmptyPlanHint.test.tsx` |
| 8 | `app/src/lib/outbox/outbox.ts` | change | `pickBatch` signature unchanged; new rule D-Batch | itself | `vitest run src/lib/outbox/outbox.test.ts` |
| 9 | `app/src/lib/outbox/outbox-idb.ts` | change | `put` signature unchanged; new rule D-Stamp | itself | `vitest run src/lib/outbox/outbox-idb.test.ts` |
