# EZD-387 · Fix: the phase-rank test blocks the real tickets of every signed-off phase, so a new sign-off cannot turn the gate red

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-387-1, AC-EZD-387-2, AC-EZD-387-3
- **Complexity:** low
- **Areas:** tooling, scripts
- **User-visible result:** none in the app; the gate stops failing on `EZD-360 T10` now that phases 7 to 9 are signed off, and later sign-offs cannot bring the failure back.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-10 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
Test-only structural repair of an earlier ticket's fixture (orchestrator decision, session 17: the test-author makes the change; there is no builder step). Applies to develop at 23fadf12.

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `scripts/ledger/phase-rank-order.test.mjs` (test-author) | change | none (a `node:test` file; no exports) | `scripts/ledger/phase-overlap.test.mjs` lines 83-84 (the line beginning `const signedPhases = new Set(`, then `quiet`) | `node --test scripts/ledger/phase-rank-order.test.mjs` prints `# pass 4` and `# fail 0` |

Edits in step 1, all in the `before` hook and the file header; nothing else in the file changes:
- E1. Directly above line 80 (`const quiet = …`), insert one line, a character-for-character copy of the `scripts/ledger/phase-overlap.test.mjs` line 83 that begins with `const signedPhases = new Set(` (the `const signedPhases = new Set(readFileSync(file('spec/SIGNOFF.md'), 'utf8')…` line). `readFileSync` and `file` already exist in the file (lines 6 and 19).
- E2. Line 80 becomes: `  const quiet = (ph) => (ph >= 1 && ph <= 6) || ph === 56 || signedPhases.has(ph) && ph > 6;`
- E3. Line 79 comment becomes: `  // Every real ticket of phases 1 to 6, 56 and every later phase signed off in the copy's SIGNOFF.md that is not done is blocked (a blocked row needs a note); other in-progress/review tickets are ready.`
- E4. Line 3, the clause `every real ticket of phases 1 to 6 and 56 that is not done is blocked;` becomes `every real ticket of phases 1 to 6, 56 and every later signed-off phase that is not done is blocked;` (the rest of lines 1 to 3 stays).

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Who edits | test-author only; the builder step is none | orchestrator decision (session 17); CLAUDE.md rule 5 (structural repair); `.claude/hooks/guard-paths.mjs` line 29 lets test-author write `*.test.mjs` (L-002) |
| Where `signedPhases` is read | the copy's `vault/spec/SIGNOFF.md` (`file('spec/SIGNOFF.md')`) at line 80, before the test appends its own rows for 5, 56 and 6 (line 110) | phase-overlap.test.mjs line 83 (the ticket row says line 84, which is the `quiet` line right after it); the copy is the test's own fixture (EZD-281 Q-0463) |
| Phases kept quiet | 1 to 6 and 56 as now, plus every signed phase greater than 6 | ticket row Build text; phase-overlap.test.mjs line 84 (`ph > 2` form) |
| Phase 0 | left as now (not quiet): the `ph > 6` term keeps a signed phase 0 out, so today's behaviour for phase 0 does not change | E2; ticket row ("no assertion, expected value or synthetic ticket changes") |
| Unsigned phases after 6 | left alone, as phase-overlap.test.mjs and `scripts/launcher/test-utils/ledger-copy.mjs` do | phase-overlap.test.mjs lines 81-82 comment |
| The ticket backfill loop at lines 91-95 | unchanged code; it already uses `quiet`, so it now also backfills `architecture`/`track` for phases 7 and later that are signed off, as phase-overlap.test.mjs lines 96-101 do | phase-overlap.test.mjs |
| Assertions, expected values, synthetic tickets (`EZD-9960` to `EZD-9963`), `reset`, `setStatus`, test titles | unchanged | ticket row Done-when; AC-EZD-387-3 |
| Comment wording | E3 and E4 state only what E2 enforces (L-039, L-030: restates line 80) | E2 |
| Formatting | run `pnpm exec prettier --write scripts/ledger/phase-rank-order.test.mjs`; if Prettier changes any other line, revert those lines (formatting is not gated) | docs/architecture.md `## Tests` |
| Before the gate | merge develop into the worktree (L-053) | lessons L-053 |

### Do not touch
Every other line of `scripts/ledger/phase-rank-order.test.mjs`; `scripts/ledger/phase-overlap.test.mjs`; `scripts/ledger/tooling-track.test.mjs`; `scripts/ledger/live-drift.test.mjs`; `scripts/launcher/test-utils/ledger-copy.mjs`; `vault/tools/next_ticket.mjs`; `vault/tools/phase-rank.mjs`; every vault file.

Ticket row (vault/tickets/phases/phase-01.md line 220):
- Scope: Defect (CLAUDE.md rule 17: it fails the gate). Found 2026-11-11 by the session 17 orchestrator on the EZD-382 gate and reproduced on develop: scripts/ledger/phase-rank-order.test.mjs T10 expects `build EZD-9962` and gets `plan EZD-104`, and EZD-281 T7 (which runs the ledger-reading suites on a drifted copy) fails with it. Cause: the test's copy blocks the real open tickets only in phases 1 to 6 and 56 (`quiet`, line 80), so phases 7 to 9, signed off on 2026-11-11, leak real tickets into its next-unit checks. phase-overlap.test.mjs and tooling-track.test.mjs already block every signed-off phase (`signedPhases`, line 84). Cost: one low tooling ticket, test file only. Build: phase-rank-order.test.mjs's `quiet` also covers every signed-off phase of the copy, the same way as phase-overlap.test.mjs line 84; no assertion, expected value or synthetic ticket changes.
- Done when: scripts/ledger/phase-rank-order.test.mjs passes on a vault copy where phases after 6 are signed off and hold open real tickets. EZD-281 T7 passes. No assertion or expected value in phase-rank-order.test.mjs changes.
- Depends on: EZD-360 · Spec ref: rule 17

## 2. Sources
- `vault/spec/sections/11-non-functional-requirements.md` **Operations** (the gate keeps local tests green); CLAUDE.md rules 12, 17 (defect: fails the gate), 5 (structural repair).
- Ticket row EZD-387, `vault/tickets/phases/phase-01.md` line 220; ACs `vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md` lines 622-624.

- Planner check at plan time: the E1+E2 edit applied to a copy of the repository (develop 23fadf12 plus the working tree) gives `# pass 4`, `# fail 0` for `node --test scripts/ledger/phase-rank-order.test.mjs`; develop unchanged gives `not ok 4 - EZD-360 T10 …`, `# fail 1`. EZD-281 T7 on the same patched copy (`node --test --test-name-pattern='EZD-281 T7' scripts/ledger/live-drift.test.mjs`): `# pass 1`, `# fail 0`, so the fix makes T7 pass.
- Lessons applied: L-002, L-026 (no test pins this file by hash or line count: grep of scripts, vault/tools, .claude/hooks finds no other reference), L-030, L-032, L-034, L-035, L-036, L-038, L-039, L-041 (the test already copies the vault, per EZD-360; this ticket makes it hold for any live sign-off set), L-053, L-057.
- No research report covers this ticket.

| local | `quiet` (inside `before`) | `(ph: number) => boolean`; true for 1 ≤ ph ≤ 6, ph = 56, or `signedPhases.has(ph) && ph > 6` |

## 4. Tests

Input where old and new code differ: the copy of the current vault, whose SIGNOFF.md lists phases 7, 8, 9 with open real tickets (EZD-104 is the first leaked one: old code prints `plan EZD-104` at T10 line 155). Output channel: the `--next-unit` stdout line.

# EZD-116 · Defaults framework (split proposal)

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-116-1 … AC-EZD-116-9 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:1136-1144`, stage-0), shared out to the parts below (each AC in exactly one part)
- **Complexity:** high (each part; reasons per part)
- **Areas:** ui, data-model, migrations, api, security, testing
- **User-visible result:** Josh opens Settings → Defaults and sees every company threshold, tolerance, limit and waste factor in the board's groups, with "Not set" where nothing is entered; he types values (lengths as 12'6", 150" or 12.5'), bad values are refused on the row, and Save keeps them; a new project keeps its own copy of the waste factors, overhangs and increments, and the editor reads the company values.
- Phase: 8 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-11 · Status: split proposal

## Split proposal

**Why.** Planned whole, the ticket touches about 31 files and needs about 36 tests, over the size rule (PROCESS.md section 6 "Ticket size": about 20 files, about 25 tests; Josh 2026-10-22). Sources of the count:
- 9 stage-0 ACs (`acceptance-criteria.md:1136-1144`); AC-EZD-116-4 alone carries 12 boundary cases (09o Value checks rows 1-6; Q-0697 03 "Defaults data" minutes 1 to 1,440; Q-0706 days 1 to 365, 0 for cleanup age and grace, reminder lead below expiry);
- a typed registry of about 50 rows over 15 groups (S15d Controls table rows 13-49; Q-0697 05 adds the Walls group of five rows and the Snap increment row, and splits S15d row 44 into two keys), each row with an `en.ts` label and hint key (board S15dDefaults per-row hints, Q-0697 05);
- a Settings page with nine field kinds on the board (length, two-field range, percent, days, minutes, count, segmented choice, on/off switch, scale chips) plus the waste factor table, Search defaults, Discard, the unsaved footer and status bar items (board S15dDefaults; Q-0697 05);
- a new write function on `tenant` with its permission check, a read and save route pair, the `tenant.defaults_updated` event (S15d Events; ARCH Events);
- changed project create functions (`public.create_project`, `20261105105039_create_create_project.sql:7`; `public.create_project_with_objects`, `20261107100756_create_project_with_objects.sql:3`) that main's live code still calls (Q-0264; template Live site), their two callers in `app/src/server/projects/projects.ts:228-229`, and the editor's model load (`app/src/server/model/model.ts:349-356`) and session, plus a first project-channel resync handler in the editor (no `src/editor` file uses the Realtime hub today: grep `realtime` in `app/src/editor`, 2026-11-11).

**Why cut here.**
- The Settings page and its save path stand alone: they read and write only `tenant.defaults` (Q-0697 03 "Defaults data"), so part a can be built and checked with Josh's Slice 8 script step 1 (`vault/tickets/PHASES.md` Slice 8) before any project code changes.
- Part b is every reader outside Settings: the copy made at project creation (S15d Decision 4; 09o Copy at creation), the editor's effective values (Q-0697 03), and the "Set in Defaults" note a feature shows (S15d Entry points). It needs part a's registry, effective-value helper and per-project flag, so it comes second.
- b's migration changes two functions main still calls (Q-0264), a different review from a's new function; keeping them apart keeps each security review to one write path.

Built a → b. Each part is planned as its own unit from its section here.

### Part EZD-116a · Defaults registry, page and save
- **Scope:**
  - one typed registry in `app/src/lib/defaults/` (browser and server; ARCH Folder layout `src/lib/`): per row key, group, label, type, unit, default, per-project flag (glossary 00i "Defaults registry"; AC-EZD-116-2); every S15d Controls row except the Keyboard shortcuts rows (Q-0697 05; Q-0226), the Walls group after Increments with the Q-0558 values (2x4 stud, 1/2" drywall each side, 4 1/2" thick, 8' 0" high) and the exterior block row, the Snap increment row under Increments (default 1/2", Q-0664), version cleanup age 30 days and grace 7 days as two keys (Q-0697 05); a value a row's source marks "Owner enters" has no registry default; mockup numbers are sample data (KNOWN-LIMITS item 5); iPad input's company default is "Pencil or finger" (Q-0392);
  - pure value helpers in the same folder: the effective value (stored, else registry default, else Not set; Q-0697 03; 09o Effective value), and validation by type: lengths through `parseLength` (`packages/geometry/src/length.ts:35`; Q-0561, refusal key `office.length.refused`), percents 0 to 100, minutes whole 1 to 1,440, days whole 1 to 365 with 0 allowed for cleanup age and grace, seating support limit above the standard overhang, share-link reminder lead below the share-link expiry (Q-0697 03; Q-0706; 09o Value checks);
  - the write: one `security definer` function on `tenant` (the EZD-112 pattern, ARCH Company settings "Write path"; `revoke all … from public`, then grants by name, L-016; added to `GATED_RPC_CALLS` with the list test's edit, L-049) that checks the caller's `settings_defaults` row and writes only the keys sent (Q-0697 03 "Save writes only edited keys"); migration timestamp taken after develop's newest at merge time (L-060);
  - routes: a read of the effective values open to any active member, a save behind `requireApiPermission('settings_defaults')` answering 403 without it (Q-0697 10; Q-0210; Q-0223); the save emits `tenant.defaults_updated` (S15d Events; new `EVENTS` entry, ARCH Events);
  - the page `/settings/defaults` inside `SettingsMain` (ARCH Settings shell page contract; `NoAccess` without the switch, nav item already filtered by EZD-103a): groups and rows in the board's order and controls, per-row hints, "Not set" on an empty row (S15d States), Search defaults by label across groups, Save disabled with no edits, Discard, the unsaved footer, `useUnsavedChanges` and `useSettingsDraft` (ARCH Unsaved edits and drafts page contract), status bar items through `useSettingsStatus` (ARCH Company settings "Shell additions"); no Keyboard shortcuts card (Q-0697 05; Q-0226); loading, failed load with Retry and offline read-only (S15d States; Q-0214);
  - Proposed wording (PROCESS 3a) for every refusal message and state not on the board.
- **Tests (about 24) and files (about 19):** registry and value-helper unit tests over every 09o Value checks and Effective value row; DB tests of the write function (permission, edited keys only, tenant isolation); route tests (403, 400 per type, any-member read, event emitted); page component tests (Save disabled, Discard, search, inline refusals); one browser spec for Josh's Slice 8 script step 1 with the visual checklist at desktop 1600 × 1000 (board S15dDefaults).
- **Done when:** Settings → Defaults shows every registry row in the board's groups with no Keyboard shortcuts card, and an empty row reads "Not set"; 12'6", 12' 6 1/2", 150" and 12.5' are accepted (12.5' saved as 150") and "12 6" is refused with the formats message; percent −1 and 100.5, minutes 0, 1,441 and 2.5, days 0 (not cleanup) and 366, seating limit 1 1/2" over a standard overhang of 1 1/2", and a reminder lead not below the expiry are refused on the row and nothing saves; Save is disabled with no edits, writes only the edited keys, emits `tenant.defaults_updated` and shows the saved value after reload; Discard restores the saved values; Search defaults filters rows by label across groups and clears back to the full page; without `settings_defaults` the nav item and page are absent and the save route answers 403, while any active member reads the effective values; loading, failed load with Retry and offline read-only follow the Settings shell.
- **ACs:** AC-EZD-116-2, -3, -4, -5, -6, -9.
- **Depends on:** EZD-103a, EZD-103b (row). Missing from the row (all done, `vault/tickets/STATUS.md` 2026-11-11): EZD-112 (write-function and page pattern, `useSettingsStatus`), EZD-201 (`parseLength`, `formatLength`), EZD-102 (`requireApiPermission`), EZD-022 (event registry), EZD-016a (browser harness; the visual checklist needs it).
- **The part plan settles:** whether the write function also refuses keys outside the registry and values of the wrong JSON type (rule 18: close the class; recommended yes, from a key list the migration holds), and how `formatLength` (denominators 2 and 16 only, `length.ts:71`) shows each length row (16 gives 1/8", 1/4" and 1/2" reduced).
- **Complexity:** high: a permission-checked write function on `tenant`, a route pair and a large form with many validation boundaries (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Opus 5.5 (boundary-heavy expected values), builder Opus 5.5.
- **security-review: yes** (permissions, API, data access, migrations). **Reviewers:** code-reviewer · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier yes · security-reviewer yes.

### Part EZD-116b · Project copy, editor defaults and "Set in Defaults"
- **Scope:**
  - project creation: the create route works out the per-project copy from part a's registry (the waste factors, the four overhangs, cabinet auto-fill and countertop increments; pattern adjustment is not copied) and passes it as a `jsonb` parameter to `create_project` and `create_project_with_objects`, which store it under `project.settings.defaults`, apart from `plan_scale` (Q-0697 03 "Defaults data"; S15d Decision 4; 09o Copy at creation rows 1, 4); a key unset at creation is not copied and reads the company value live (Q-0697 03; 09o Copy at creation row 3);
  - the live site: main's code still calls both functions with their current arguments (`projects.ts:228-229`; Q-0264), so the migration keeps those signatures working until the phase merge (template "Live site"); the part plan writes how (a new overload carrying the copy beside the current signature, or the copy as a trailing `default null` parameter), checked once on the pinned local stack (L-009);
  - the editor: the model load (`app/src/server/model/model.ts:349-356`, which already reads `project.settings`) returns the effective defaults (the project's copy over the company values over the registry defaults), the editor session carries them (ARCH Editor route `openEditorSession`), and the editor re-reads them on the project channel resync (Q-0697 03; ARCH Realtime `onResync`, `app/src/lib/realtime/hub.ts:380`); there is no tenant Realtime topic (Q-0697 03);
  - "Set in Defaults": one helper component and an effective-value reader a feature calls; a Not set value makes the feature show "Set in Defaults" linking to `/settings/defaults` (S15d Entry points; 09o Value checks row 6; Effective value row 3), shown with the link only to holders of `settings_defaults` (the part plan settles the wording for others under PROCESS 3a); its link goes into the touch-target list (L-060).
- **Tests (about 12) and files (about 12):** DB tests of both create functions storing the copy (09o Copy at creation rows 1 and 4) and of main's current call still working; create-route tests for the copy worked out from the registry; model load and editor session tests for the effective values and the resync re-read; helper component tests for "Not set" and "Set in Defaults".
- **Done when:** a project created while company tile waste is 10% stores 10% under `project.settings.defaults` and keeps it after the company value changes to 12%, while a new project gets 12% (09o Copy at creation row 1); pattern adjustment is not copied and every project reads the new company value (row 4); a key unset at creation reads the company value live; the editor session carries the effective defaults and re-reads them on the project channel resync; a value whose stored value and registry default are both empty reads "Not set" on the Settings row and a feature that needs it shows "Set in Defaults".
- **ACs:** AC-EZD-116-1, -7, -8.
- **Depends on:** EZD-116a. Missing from the row (all done, `vault/tickets/STATUS.md` 2026-11-11): EZD-118 (`create_project`, `POST /api/projects`), EZD-221a (`create_project_with_objects`), EZD-120a and EZD-120c (model load, `openEditorSession`), EZD-018 (Realtime hub and resync), EZD-219 (`plan_scale` beside the new `defaults` key in `project.settings`).
- **The part plan settles:** the live-site form of the two function changes (above), whether the functions check the copy's keys and value types against the registry's per-project list (rule 18; recommended yes), and where the editor's project-channel subscription lives so EZD-125's lock broadcasts can reuse it (Q-0697 03 "Edit lock data": broadcasts on the project channel).
- **Complexity:** high: changes to the only project write path that the live site still calls, plus a first Realtime handler in the editor (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Opus 5.5, builder Opus 5.5.
- **security-review: yes** (migrations, data access, API). **Reviewers:** code-reviewer · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier no (the helper is unit-tested; no new screen) · security-reviewer yes.

### AC map
| Part | ACs | Josh's Slice 8 script |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EZD-116a | 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9 | step 1 |
| EZD-116b | 1, 7, 8 | step 6's copied value (with EZD-130) |

Dependents: EZD-123, EZD-125, EZD-130, EZD-111, EZD-222, EZD-308, EZD-407, EZD-412, EZD-414, EZD-509, EZD-511, EZD-515, EZD-603, EZD-610 depend on the base number EZD-116, so on both parts (`vault/tickets/README.md` "How tickets are written").

## 2. Sources
- Spec: `vault/spec/sections/screens/S15d-settings-defaults.md` (Purpose, Entry points, Permissions, Layout, Controls rows 13-49, States, Validation & warnings, Events, Decisions 1-6); `vault/spec/sections/09o-edit-lock-and-defaults-examples.md` (Value checks, Effective value, Copy at creation); `vault/spec/sections/00i-glossary-phase-08.md` (Defaults registry, Company default, Project setting, Not set, Set in Defaults).
- Decisions: `decisions/03-data-model.md` Q-0697 ("Defaults data", "Edit lock data"), Q-0706 (day bounds, reminder lead); `decisions/05-screens.md` Q-0697 (board S15dDefaults, Walls group, Snap increment, two cleanup keys, no Keyboard shortcuts card), Q-0392 (iPad drawing default), Q-0185; `decisions/10-permissions-and-settings.md` Q-0697 (settings_defaults, any member reads, no money field), Q-0210, Q-0226, Q-0188; `decisions/09-calculations-and-rules.md` Q-0207, Q-0558, Q-0630 (door and window sizes, see QP-1), Q-0664; `decisions/04-app-shell-and-global-ui.md` Q-0561, Q-0214; Q-0264 (`QUESTIONS-answered.md`, live site).
- Mockup: `vault/mockups/S15dDefaults.png` and `html/project/S15dDefaults.dc.html` (Studio board; sample data is not a decision).
- Code read 2026-11-11 (develop 3bee5a6b): `supabase/migrations/20261019165201_create_tenant.sql:11` (`tenant.defaults jsonb not null default '{}'`, so no new column), `20261105105039_create_create_project.sql`, `20261107100756_create_project_with_objects.sql`, `20261110120000_add_project_plan_scale.sql`; `app/src/lib/settings/sections.ts` (`defaults` section, `settings_defaults`, badge `units`); `app/src/lib/permissions/catalog.ts:47`; `app/src/lib/events/registry.ts:60`; `packages/geometry/src/length.ts:35, 71`; `app/src/server/projects/projects.ts:210-229`; `app/src/server/model/model.ts:349-356`; `app/src/lib/realtime/hub.ts:129, 380`.
- Research: no research report covers this ticket.

Architecture: Settings shell (EZD-103a); Unsaved edits and drafts (EZD-103b); Company settings (EZD-112); New project wizard (EZD-118); Events; Editor route (EZD-120c); Realtime (EZD-018); Permission enforcement (EZD-102); Messages and language (t()); Browser tests (EZD-016a)

## 10. Open questions
- Q-0709 (was QP-1): Q-0630 (09) says the door (3' 0" × 6' 8"), window (3' 0" × 4' 0", 3' 0" sill) and rough-opening sizes "all become Defaults rows in EZD-116", but AC-EZD-116-2 and Q-0697's list of added rows leave them out; options: (a) add them to part a as an Openings group after Walls with those values, (b) add them to the Walls group, (c) leave them out and let the ticket that makes the door and window tools read Defaults add them (`vault/tickets/README.md`: "Any later phase may add its own values to Defaults").
- Q-0710 (was QP-2) (design): "Light target per room type" (board "7 rooms · Edit") and "Bath clearances" (board "6 values · Edit") have no editor on the board, and no source lists the room types or the six bath values; options: (a) Josh names the room types and the six values and Edit opens a popover under the row with one field per value, (b) as (a) but Edit opens a dialog, (c) both rows show "Not set" with no Edit until the tickets that use them (EZD-509 Auto-layout cans; the bath clearance check) add their values and editor.
- Q-0711 (was QP-3): Q-0558 gives the stud as 2x4 and names "an exterior block default" with no value or type; options: (a) stud is a choice of 2x4 or 2x6 (default 2x4) and exterior block is a length (block wall thickness) with no default, so it reads "Not set", (b) exterior block is an on/off "exterior walls are block" (default off), (c) Josh names the choices.
- Q-0712 (was QP-4): S15d gives "ACT minimum border" as "half a tile" and "Overhang: against wall" as "0 + splash" without saying what the owner types; options: ACT (a) a fraction of a tile chosen from 1/4, 1/3 and 1/2 (default 1/2), (b) a decimal from 0 to 1; against wall (a) a length, default 0", with a fixed "+ splash" after the field, (b) fixed text the owner cannot change.
- Q-0713 (was QP-5): Q-0207 makes plan and detail dimension rounding "changeable in Settings" but no source lists the allowed values, and the board's "+ Scale" chip adds a detail scale in a format no source gives; options: (a) rounding is one of 1/16", 1/8", 1/4", 1/2" and 1" and "+ Scale" is left out (the seven S15d scales are on/off chips only), (b) rounding is any multiple of 1/16" up to 1" and "+ Scale" takes a scale typed as N" = 1'-0".
- Q-0714 (was QP-6): S15d does not say whether a set value can be emptied again; options: (a) emptying a field and saving removes the key, so the row shows its registry default or "Not set", (b) a set value can be changed but not emptied.
- Q-0715 (was QP-7): No source bounds webhook retries (default 5), the field measure sanity range (default 0 to 200 ft) or the foot-candle targets (L-061 needs a bound for every number); options: (a) retries whole 0 to 10, sanity range min at least 0 and below max, max at most 200 ft (Q-0568's 200 ft limit), foot-candles whole 1 to 200, (b) other limits the orchestrator names.

# EZD-125 · Edit lock service (split proposal)

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-125-1 … AC-EZD-125-10 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:1145-1154`, stage-0), shared out to the parts below (each AC in exactly one part)
- **Complexity:** high (part a), medium (part b); reasons per part
- **Areas:** data-model, migrations, security, realtime, api, testing
- **User-visible result:** nothing new on screen until EZD-126 draws the banner, toast, prompt and Stop editing button (phase-01.md row EZD-126). After this ticket two people opening the same project cannot both change it: the first with Edit model holds the lock, everyone else's editor saves nothing, a Request edit that goes unanswered releases the lock after the Defaults minutes with the holder's saved work checkpointed, and a save from a former holder is refused (phase-01.md row EZD-125; S06 Edit lock; R24 #16, #17).
- Phase: 8 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-11 · Status: split proposal

## Split proposal

**Why.** Planned whole, the ticket touches about 27 files and needs about 40 tests, over the size rule (PROCESS.md section 6 "Ticket size": about 20 files, about 25 tests; Josh 2026-10-22). Sources of the count:
- 10 stage-0 ACs (`acceptance-criteria.md:1145-1154`), several with three or four refusal cases each (AC-5: the holder's own request, a second pending request, no Edit model, a free lock, Cancel; AC-6: holder-only Release, Keep and Stop editing, a late Keep, ask again after Keep; AC-7: deadline at request time, a later Defaults change, sweep, lock read and save each applying it);
- the database side: `edit_lock` gains `holder_app_user_id`, `since`, `device_id`, `offline`, and a new table `edit_request` (Q-0697 03 "Edit lock data"; 03c:20-21), each lock change one conditional write under `select … for update` on the `edit_lock` row (Q-0697 03; 03b rule 6), a redefinition of `public.save_objects` (latest body `supabase/migrations/20261109100000_number_model_objects.sql:128`) so a save applies an expired deadline (Q-0697 03 "Auto release"), a sweep function, broadcast triggers (ARCH Realtime "Clients never broadcast"), event_log rows in the same transaction (Q-0697 10) and an `edit_request` notification to the holder (04 Notifications "edit request"; ARCH Notifications `private.create_notification`);
- the server side: a lock module, four route files (state and acquire, release, request and cancel, respond), one more pass in the once-a-minute sweep route (`app/src/app/api/jobs/sweep/route.ts`, EZD-5601 precedent at lines 33-41), the model load's lock read (`app/src/server/model/model.ts:355`), the Realtime event map (`app/src/lib/realtime/events.ts`), the event registry (`app/src/lib/events/registry.ts:21-26, 90-95` already lists six `lock.*` names; `lock.request_cancelled` is missing, Q-0697 10), the generated database types, error message keys, the harness lists (`app/test-harness/rls/gate.ts`, `table-grants.ts`, `private-execute.ts`, `app/test-harness/money/route-cases.ts`) and `docs/architecture.md`;
- the browser side: a typed client for the lock routes, a lock controller over the project channel, the open flow in `openEditorSession` (`app/src/editor/editor-session.ts:60-74` today builds a sync for every `canEdit` viewer with the load's `lockEpoch`), Stop editing through EZD-224's `makeCheckpoint` (Q-0681 (a)) and the tab-close release (Q-0697 04).

**Why cut here.**
- The database and routes stand alone and are tested at the API level, which is what the ticket's Done-when names ("API test", phase-01.md row EZD-125). Every AC about who gets the lock, the epoch, requests, the deadline, broadcasts and cascades is decided on the server (03b rule 6; Q-0697 03 and 10).
- The browser half needs EZD-224's `makeCheckpoint` (`vault/plans/EZD-224.md` Build step 9; Q-0681 (a); Q-0697 03 "Phase 8 dependencies"), and EZD-224 is `blocked`, held for re-planning (`vault/tickets/STATUS.md` row EZD-224, Josh 2026-11-11). Cut here, part a can be built while EZD-224 is held; only part b waits.
- Part a's security review covers one set of definer functions and routes; part b adds no server surface.

Built a → b. Each part is planned as its own unit from its section here.

### Part EZD-125a · Edit lock: tables, functions, routes and sweep
- **Scope:**
  - Migration 1 (timestamp after develop's newest migration at merge time, L-060): `edit_lock` adds `holder_app_user_id uuid null` (null when free), `since timestamptz null`, `device_id text null`, `offline boolean not null default false` (Q-0697 03 "Edit lock data"; 03c:20; glossary 00i "Lock holder"); new table `public.edit_request` (`id`, `project_id`, `tenant_id`, `requester_app_user_id`, `requested_at`, `deadline_at`, `response` in `release`, `keep`, `auto`, `cancelled` or null, `responded_at`), foreign key pair to `project (id, tenant_id)` with `on delete cascade` (Q-0697 03 "Rows cascade with the project"; 03c:21), at most one row with `response is null` per (project, requester) by a partial unique index (Q-0697 03 "One pending request per user"; S06:75), the EZD-006 select policy, `<table>_api_gate`, `authenticated` select only and `service_role` all four (ARCH Model working copy "Tables" pattern; `TABLE_GRANTS` edit, L-049).
  - Migration 2, every function `security definer`, `set search_path = ''`, `revoke all … from public` then grants by name (L-016), each public one calling `private.require_api_gate()` first and added to `GATED_RPC_CALLS` (ARCH Model working copy "Functions"; L-049): acquire (free lock → caller, `since`, `device_id`, epoch + 1; caller already holder → `device_id` updated, epoch unchanged; held by another → answers the holder; needs a granted `edit_model` row and project scope, as `save_objects` steps 2-4, `20261109100000_number_model_objects.sql`), release by the holder only with reason `stop_editing`, `closed` or `request_accepted` (S06 Events "lock.released (reason: …)"; epoch + 1, holder null), request (refused for the holder, without Edit model, or with a pending request; on a free lock answers `lock_free`; `deadline_at = requested_at + p_minutes`, minutes whole 1 to 1,440; Q-0697 03 "Auto release"; 09o Auto-release deadline rows 1-5), cancel (the requester's own pending row → `cancelled`), respond (`release` or `keep`, holder only, `where response is null`, so a Keep after the deadline loses; Q-0697 03; 09o row 4), a lock read that returns holder id, `since`, epoch and the caller's pending request, and a `service_role`-only sweep. Every one of them, and the redefined `save_objects`, first applies any pending request whose `deadline_at <= now()` on the database clock: server checkpoint through `private.make_checkpoint` (`20261105200004_create_model_save_functions.sql`), every pending request of the lock set to `auto`, holder null, epoch + 1, then the call goes on (Q-0697 03 "The sweep cron, every lock read and every save apply it"). `save_objects` keeps its signature, language plpgsql and return shape; a save that finds an expired request does the auto release and then returns `{ status: 'stale_lock_epoch' }` without raising, so the auto release commits (Q-0697 03). Its callers stay as they are: `saveObjects` (`app/src/server/model/model.ts:223, 228`) and `public.save_objects_resolving` (`20261107180001_create_sync_conflict_functions.sql:289`). A release by `closed` or `request_accepted` makes a server checkpoint first in the same transaction; `stop_editing` does not, because the browser made one with its thumbnail just before (Q-0681 (a); Q-0664 "server checkpoint at lock release or timeout leaves preview_path null").
  - Broadcasts on `project:<id>` through `private.broadcast_project` from triggers on `edit_lock` and `edit_request` (ARCH Realtime "Clients never broadcast", "Payload rule"), ids and timestamps only (Q-0697 03), with each event name added to `ProjectChannelEvents` in `app/src/lib/realtime/events.ts` in the same commit (ARCH Realtime; `scripts/db/__tests__/realtime-sql.test.mjs` T19); `realtime.send` adds `id` to the payload and `toEventPayload` drops it (ARCH Realtime; L-021 rule on `realtime.send`).
  - event_log: `lock.acquired`, `lock.requested`, `lock.request_cancelled`, `lock.request_declined`, `lock.released` (with reason), `lock.auto_released` in the same transaction as the lock change, actor and IP from the route; an auto release has actor system and IP null (Q-0697 10; 11:80; Q-0695 event_log columns and IP rule). `lock.request_cancelled` joins `EVENTS` (`app/src/lib/events/registry.ts`).
  - A request creates one `edit_request` notification for the holder through `private.create_notification` (`20261102210539_create_notification_functions.sql:10`), payload `{ name }` = the requester's name (ARCH Notifications: `edit_request` needs a string `name`; `app/src/lib/notifications/kinds.ts:14`).
  - Server module `app/src/server/lock/lock.ts` and routes under `app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/lock/` (`requireApiPermission`, the `{ error: { code, message_key } }` body, 409 for a held lock or a stale epoch, ARCH Errors and logging); the lock read returns the holder's name through the scope-checked route, never in a broadcast (Q-0697 03). The request route reads the effective "Edit lock auto-release" minutes through EZD-116's effective-value reader and passes them to the function, so the one TypeScript registry is the only source of the default (S15d:45; Q-0188; Q-0697 03 "Defaults data"; rule 18).
  - Sweep: one more pass in `GET /api/jobs/sweep` (`app/src/app/api/jobs/sweep/route.ts`) through the secret-key client, a failure reported by code without changing the answer (EZD-5601 precedent, lines 33-41; ARCH Background jobs "Sweep": production only).
  - `loadModel`'s lock read (`app/src/server/model/model.ts:355`) goes through the lock read function, so opening a project also applies an expired deadline (Q-0697 03 "every lock read").
  - Proposed wording (PROCESS 3a) for every new error `message_key`, including the stale-epoch answer when the holder's other device released ("your other device released", 09o lock_epoch row 5; Q-0697 05).
- **Tests (about 26) and files (about 21):** DB tests of every function over 09o's Auto-release deadline rows 1-5, lock_epoch rows 1-5 and Requests rows 1-3, two simultaneous acquires (one holder, the other told who holds it), a late Keep, the save that auto-releases, cascades and tenant isolation; deadlines aged by backdating `deadline_at` through a service-role fixture, never a fake clock (Q-0697 03: `fake-clock.ts` cannot age SQL `now()`); route tests for 401, 403, 404, 409 and the holder-name read; the sweep route test's new pass; broadcast payloads and event_log rows per lock change; the harness list edits.
- **Done when:** an unanswered request whose `deadline_at` has passed releases the lock with a checkpoint of the saved rows first and writes `lock.auto_released` with actor system; two simultaneous acquires give the lock to exactly one user and the other is told who holds it; after a release `lock_epoch` is higher and a save with the old epoch is refused with `stale_lock_epoch`, while the holder's second tab re-acquires with the epoch unchanged; the holder's own request, a second pending request and a request without Edit model are refused, a request on a free lock answers that it is free, and Cancel ends the pending request; Release, Keep editing and Stop editing work only for the holder, a Keep after the deadline loses and the requester may ask again at once; the deadline is the request time plus the Defaults minutes read then, and a later Defaults change does not move it; every lock change is broadcast with ids and timestamps only and writes its event_log row in the same transaction; `edit_lock` and `edit_request` rows go with a deleted project, and no route lets anyone but the holder release.
- **ACs:** AC-EZD-125-1, -2, -3, -5, -6, -7, -9, -10.
- **Depends on:** EZD-120a, EZD-109, EZD-110a, EZD-116 (both parts), EZD-018 (row). Missing from the row (done, `vault/tickets/STATUS.md` 2026-11-11): EZD-009 (the sweep route and `createJobsDbClient`), EZD-102 (`requireApiPermission`), EZD-022 (event registry), EZD-299a (`save_objects_resolving` calls `save_objects`), EZD-140 (notification settings that `create_notification` applies), EZD-190 (`require_api_gate`). Not needed by this part: EZD-120b, EZD-120c, EZD-120d, EZD-110b, EZD-224 (part b).
- **The part plan settles:** the exact SQL signatures (run once on the pinned local stack, L-009), once EZD-109's plan names its in-transaction event_log writer and EZD-116a's plan names the auto-release key and its server reader (both are planned before phase 8 builds: EZD-109 is phase 7, EZD-116 is before EZD-125 in slice 8); the route paths and bodies; the link the `edit_request` notification carries (a relative path to the project editor `/projects/<id>`, inside ARCH Notifications' link rule); whether a Stop editing or a Release also closes other users' pending requests (recommended: every pending request of the lock ends with the release, response `release`, so no request outlives the holder it was sent to).
- **Complexity:** high: concurrent conditional writes under a row lock, a redefinition of the only save path, definer functions with permission checks and a cron pass (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Opus 5.5 (race and deadline rows), builder Opus 5.5.
- **security-review: yes** (permissions, data access, API, migrations). **Reviewers:** code-reviewer · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier no (no screen) · security-reviewer yes.

### Part EZD-125b · Edit lock in the editor: open, Stop editing, tab close
- **Scope:**
  - A typed browser client for part a's routes in `app/src/lib/lock/` (browser and server code folder, ARCH Folder layout `src/lib/`), each answer a result type with every failure code (L-058).
  - A lock controller in `app/src/editor/lock/`: the lock state for one open project, refetched through part a's lock read on every lock event and every resync of the project channel (`getRealtimeHub().project(id)`, `onResync`; ARCH Realtime "Resync", "Requests only on events"; 11 rule 11, no polling), with the actions EZD-126 binds to its controls: Start editing, Request edit, Cancel request, Release, Keep editing, Stop editing (S06 Controls; Q-0697 05).
  - Open: `openEditorSession` asks part a's acquire for a viewer with Edit model; the holder gets the autosave sync with the acquired `lock_epoch`; a user without Edit model, or anyone while another person holds the lock, opens view only with no sync and saves nothing (04:90; S03:16-17; AC-EZD-125-4). Start editing later builds the sync with the new epoch.
  - Stop editing and leaving the editor: drain the outbox, `makeCheckpoint` (EZD-224 step 9; Q-0681 (a)), then release with reason `stop_editing`, and wait for it; a failed checkpoint keeps the lock and returns the error, shown with Retry (Q-0697 04; S06 Decision 12; 03b rule 7). Release from the holder prompt drains first, then answers `release` (S06 "Release: saves holder's work").
  - Tab close: a best-effort `keepalive` release with reason `closed` carrying `lock_epoch`, not sent while this device's outbox still has entries, so the queued edits drain at the next open (Q-0697 04; 03b rules 7, 9).
  - The holder's own refused save after their other device released gets its own wording, not "Someone else is editing" (Q-0697 05; 09o lock_epoch row 5); the key comes from part a.
- **Tests (about 16) and files (about 9):** client result-type tests with stub fetch; controller tests over every lock event and resync (refetch once per event, no timer); session tests: free lock gives a sync with the acquired epoch, a held lock or no Edit model gives none; Stop editing call order (drain, checkpoint, release) and a failed checkpoint keeping the lock; tab close sends nothing while the outbox has entries and one keepalive release when it is empty.
- **Done when:** opening a project whose lock is free gives it to a user with Edit model and the editor saves with the acquired epoch, while a user without Edit model, or anyone while the lock is held, opens view only and saves nothing; Stop editing drains the outbox, makes a checkpoint and then releases, and a failed checkpoint keeps the lock and returns the error; a tab-close release is not sent while that device's outbox has entries.
- **ACs:** AC-EZD-125-4, -8.
- **Depends on:** EZD-125a, EZD-224 (`makeCheckpoint`; Q-0697 03 "Phase 8 dependencies"), EZD-120b, EZD-120c, EZD-120d (outbox, session, app-wide drain), EZD-018 (hub). EZD-224 is `blocked` today (`vault/tickets/STATUS.md`), so this part waits for its re-plan and build. Missing from the row: EZD-299b (the conflict list built in `openEditorSession`, `editor-session.ts:79-85`, which takes the session's `lockEpoch`).
- **The part plan settles:** which leave paths it wires now (the editor's wordmark and sign-out exist; the switcher is EZD-128 and the Stop editing button EZD-126, phase-01.md rows), and how the conflict list's `lockEpoch` follows a change of epoch after Start editing.
- **Josh's field check:** the slice 6 step moved here by Q-0681 (a): the dev hook `__ezdraftEditor.checkpoint()` writes a thumbnail under 40 KB (`vault/tickets/PHASES.md` Slice 6 step 6).
- **Complexity:** medium: one controller module and the session change, every behaviour fixed by AC-4 and AC-8 and the routes of part a, but with ordering rows over the outbox (PROCESS.md section 4). Test-author Opus 5.5 (call-order and held-promise rows, L-062), builder Sonnet 5.5.
- **security-review: no** (no new table, function or route; the server refuses a stale epoch whatever the browser does, 03b rule 6). **Reviewers:** code-reviewer · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier no (no screen; EZD-126 draws it) · security-reviewer no.

### Failure and edge cases
| Function or action | Case | Behaviour | What the user sees |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST sends | body not JSON, an array, or `note` not a string | 400 `invalid_input`, nothing written | `send-failed`, `error.invalid_input` |
| POST sends | `note` 1,001 characters | 400 `invalid_input` | same |
| POST sends | `note` 1,000 characters | 201, stored whole | `sent` |
| POST sends | `note` `"   "` | 201, `note` null | `sent` |
| POST sends | body carries `recipients`, `to` or `email` | ignored; email to the client | `sent`, To line unchanged |
| POST sends | project without client | 400 `no_client`; 0 rows in `sent_package` and `model_version` | `no-client` |
| POST sends | signed out / no switch / out of scope / malformed id | 401 / 403 / 404 / 404 | `send-failed` with the mapped key |
| POST sends | double click | Send disabled from the first click (`sending`) | one request |
| POST sends | two tabs send at once | two checkpoints, two rows, two emails, two links (each send is its own) | each tab `sent` |
| POST sends | email transport fails or `EmailInputError` | row kept, `email_sent_at` null, `emailSent: false` | `sent`, `office.send.email_failed`, Copy link |
| POST sends | `mark_sent_package_emailed` errors | `emailSent: true`; Sentry `sent_package_mark_failed` | `sent`, `office.send.sent_to` |
| POST sends | database down | 500 `db_unavailable` | `send-failed`, `office.send.failed` |
| POST sends | caller holds the lock or lock free | `holder` null | no notice |
| POST sends | another user holds the lock, no objects | `holder.savedAt` null | `office.send.holder_notice_no_time` |
| F-send | `p_expiry_days` 0 or 366, hash not 64 lower-case hex, note 0 or 1,001 characters | 22023 `invalid_input` | (route never sends these) |
| GET send-recipient | project without client | 200 `{ recipient: null }` | `no-client` |
| GET send-recipient | network or 500 | `{ ok: false }` | `load-failed` with Retry |
| Send click | outbox does not drain (`status` not `idle`/`saved` after flush) | no POST | `unsaved`, `office.send.unsaved` |
| Send click | offline | Send disabled | Send disabled |
| Copy link | clipboard refused or missing | toast | `office.send.copy_failed` |
| `resolveClientLink` | token 42 or 44 characters, `+` or `/`, empty, non-string | `null`, no database call | none |
| `resolveClientLink` | unknown, expired (`expires_at <= now()`), revoked, deleted project | `null` | none |

## 7. Security review
security-review: yes. Areas: data access (new table reached only through definer functions; tenant and project scope inside each), permissions (Send to client in route and function), API (two routes; an anon-executable resolver behind the gate), auth (client-link token: random, hashed, never stored raw), migrations.
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer always · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier yes · security-reviewer yes.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
High: a new table and three definer functions with a capability token, an anon resolver, an email side effect and a lock-aware checkpoint, plus a new dialog with eight states; 16 builder files, 3 harness edits by the test-author, 25 tests in 6 test files: at the split line (about 20 files, about 25 tests; Josh 2026-10-22), so it stays one ticket; a split into server and dialog parts would repeat the fixtures and the per-ticket overhead. Test-author Opus 5.5; builder Opus 5.5.

## 9. Dependencies
From the ticket row: EZD-110a, EZD-110b (no export of theirs is used: no AC asks for a notification on a send), EZD-120a, EZD-120b, EZD-120c, EZD-120d (checkpoint, outbox, editor route), EZD-116 (Q-0700: share link expiry). Missing from the row: **EZD-125** (`edit_lock.holder_app_user_id`, Q-0697; AC-EZD-111-7 cannot be built or tested without it), **EZD-130** (the Project settings dialog the no-client message opens; AC-EZD-111-3), **EZD-016a** (browser harness; visual checklist). All three are phase 7-8 or earlier, so slice order already puts them first; the ledger row should list them.

### Risks
| Risk | What could break | Gate notices it | Covered by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| EZD-125 or EZD-224 changes `private.make_checkpoint`'s signature or lock handling before this builds | F-send fails to create | yes: D1 | Stage 3 re-validation against EZD-125's and EZD-224's STATUS notes |
| A later ticket logs request bodies or captures route errors with the link | raw token in logs | partly: D2 | ARCH Errors and logging; security-reviewer |
| `sent_package.model_version_id` blocks EZD-123 cleanup deletes | cleanup of a sent version fails | no (EZD-123 is later) | EZD-121 freezes sent versions before EZD-123; EZD-123's own tests |
| Editor header crowding at 1600 px with Share added | header layout | yes: B8, ui-verifier | `EditorHeader` icon rule (Q-0055 (a)) |
| `ProjectEditor.tsx` changed by phase 6-8 tickets before this builds | merge conflicts in the header block | yes (typecheck) | re-validation reads the merged file |

## 10. Open questions
Q-0717 (was QP-1): EZD-116 (Defaults registry), EZD-125 (edit lock) and EZD-130 (Project settings dialog) are not planned yet, so this plan cannot name the reader EZD-111 calls for the "Share link expiry" Defaults value (S15d:46; P111 row S3, test D8) or the function `ProjectEditor` calls to open Project settings (D-Settings link); options: (a) keep EZD-111 in `questions` until those three plans exist, then fill the two names from their section 3 and add EZD-125, EZD-130 and EZD-016a to the ticket's `depends_on`; (b) have the EZD-116 and EZD-130 planners export `shareLinkExpiryDays(client)` and `openProjectSettings()` under exactly those names for this plan to call.

Already open, not new: Q-0701 (escalated to Josh, design): the Send dialog has no board; this plan follows its recommended option (a); if Josh picks (b), sections 5 and 6 are redone from the board.

# EZD-104 · Users table

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-104-1, AC-EZD-104-2, AC-EZD-104-3, AC-EZD-104-4, AC-EZD-104-5, AC-EZD-104-6, AC-EZD-104-7

### Failure and edge cases
| Function or action | Case | Behaviour | What the user sees |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Search input | empty or only spaces | `q` trims to `''`; all rows | Full list |
| Search input | over 1,000 characters | `maxLength` stops typing at 1,000 | Nothing extra |
| Search input | `%`, `_` or `\` typed | matched literally | Rows containing that character, else "No users match" |
| Search input | fast typing | each change aborts the previous load | Skeleton, then the last text's rows |
| Route | `q` over 1,000 after trim, or `page` `0`, `01`, `-1`, `1.5`, `abc`, `1000000` | 400 `invalid_input` | (not reachable from the panel) |
| Route | no session / no `settings_users` | 401 / 403 | Panel: inline error with Retry |
| Route | `list_users` fails or returns a bad shape | reported once, 500 `db_unavailable` | Inline error "Couldn't load users." with Retry |
| Panel load | offline or network error | fetch rejects | Inline error with Retry; status bar keeps the last counts |
| Panel | selected row gone after a reload | selection cleared | Inspector "Select a user" |
| Up / Down | no rows (no match) | table not rendered; nothing to move | — |
| Pager | double click on Next | second click lands on the disabled button or the next page; each page change is one load | Correct page |
| `touchLastActive` | database error, 42501, throw | never rejects; 42501 ignored; others reported with `alert: false` | Nothing; the request answers as usual |
| `touch_last_active` | invited or deactivated membership, no claim, ended session | returns false, writes nothing | — |
| `formatLastActive` | time in the future (clock skew) | `diff < 60,000` → Now | "Now" |
| `formatLastActive` | 40 min across midnight | minutes rule comes first | "40 min ago" |
| `list_users` | `p_page` null or below 1 | treated as 1 | — |
| `list_users` | member with role null | `role` null in JSON | No pill |

None: `membership.last_active_at timestamptz` and `membership.invited_at timestamptz` already exist (`supabase/migrations/20261019165204_create_membership.sql:11-12`); no column changes.

None: no table or policy changes. `list_users` is `security invoker`, so the existing tenant policies apply (`membership_select`, `app_user_select`, `role_select`, `user_permission_select` and the restrictive `*_api_gate` policies); the permission check is the route's (EZD-102: policies never read permission rows).

## 7. Security review
security-review: yes. Areas: data access (every member's email, language, role and switches go to `settings_users` holders), API (`GET /api/settings/users`), migrations (two functions), auth (a definer write on every signed-in request).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer always · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier yes · security-reviewer yes.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
High: a security-definer write that runs on every signed-in request inside `getPermissionContext`, a new data route and SQL function over four tables, and a new Settings screen with keyboard selection. Test-author Opus 5.5, builder Opus 5.5. Size: 20 build files (6 of them generated icon and type files) and 26 new tests plus 8 small inventory edits, inside the split line (no split; Josh 2026-10-22).

## 9. Dependencies
From the row: EZD-103 (EZD-103a, EZD-103b; done). Missing from the row, all done: EZD-101 (`role`, `user_permission`, `catalog.ts`), EZD-102 (`getPermissionContext`, `requireApiPermission`, `NoAccess`), EZD-015a (`AsyncView`, `Skeleton`, `InlineError`, `StateButton`), EZD-016a (browser harness; the plan has a visual checklist), EZD-010b (icon pipeline), EZD-113 (pattern only, not a dependency). Later tickets that build on this contract: the EZD-105 parts (Invite user button; EZD-105a adds the last-sender half of `canCopyLink`, Q-0718 (a); EZD-105d builds the More column and `UserMoreMenu.tsx` and wires the pending-row Copy link, Q-0722 (a), Q-0729 (a)), the EZD-106 parts (inspector body, deactivated rows; EZD-106b adds the member items to `UserMoreMenu.tsx`), EZD-107b (Roles row above the costs info note, Q-0719 (a)), EZD-138 (invite link and code shown to the sender).

Done-when artifact list (L-057): migration file; `database.types.ts`; `lib/users/users.ts`; `server/users/users.ts`; `context.ts` touch; route; page; `UsersPanel.tsx`; `Users.module.css`; `SettingsShell.tsx` and its CSS; `en.ts` keys (with `office.users.costs_note`); token in both files; `mail` icon files; `docs/architecture.md` section; tests U1-U8, D1-D5, R1-R3, B1-B10; edits E1-E8.

| Touch adds one round trip to every signed-in request | request latency; perf check budgets | partly (perf check) | run in `Promise.all` with `current_permissions`; U6 |

# EZD-126 · Edit lock UI Every v2 table has rows or `None: `; `plan_lint.mjs` checks them on a plan with the `- Template: v2` line (EZD-382). - **ACs:** AC-EZD-126-1, AC-EZD-126-2, AC-EZD-126-3, AC-EZD-126-4, AC-EZD-126-5, AC-EZD-126-6, AC-EZD-126-7 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:1155-1161`, stage-0) - **Complexity:** high (section 8) - **Areas:** ui, realtime, testing, api, security - **User-visible result:** two people can open the same project and see who holds it: the viewer gets the amber "[Name] is editing since 9:42 AM · view only" banner with Request edit, the holder gets a Release / Keep editing prompt with a live countdown, everyone gets the green "Available to edit" toast when the lock frees, the holder has Stop editing in the header, the status bar says "View only", and the header shows who else is in the project. - Phase: 8 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-11 · Status: questions - Template: v2 ## 1. What to build Execution-grade. # EZD-128 · Project switcher
Every v2 table has rows or `None: <reason>`; `plan_lint.mjs` checks them on a plan with the `- Template: v2` line (EZD-382).

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-128-1, AC-EZD-128-2, AC-EZD-128-3, AC-EZD-128-4 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:1162-1165`, stage-0)
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** ui, api, migrations, security, testing, data-model
- **User-visible result:** in the editor, clicking the project name opens a small menu with a search box, the projects Josh opened most recently (name and client), and Back to projects; picking one saves and releases this project's edit lock first, then opens the other project; a failed save keeps him editing and offers Retry.
- Phase: 8 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-11 · Status: questions
- Template: v2

## 1. What to build
Execution-grade. Ticket row (`vault/tickets/phases/phase-01.md:41`): Scope "Header project name menu: recent projects, search, Back to projects." · Done when "Switching opens the other project in the editor." · Depends on EZD-117 (tickets.json: EZD-117a, EZD-117b, EZD-125 by Q-0697/03 "Phase 8 dependencies") · Spec ref "App shell · Header card; S01 Entry points".

### Behaviour per role
| AC | Role | Behaviour |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Owner (all projects, Edit model) | Project name → menu opens with the search focused → recent list → click a project → this project is saved and released (holder), then `/projects/<id>` opens |
| 1 | Office (Designer, Edit model, not holder) | Same menu; picking a project navigates at once (nothing to release) |
| 1 | Field (Foreman, Crew: listed projects) | Same menu; only listed projects appear |
| 1 | View-only (View projects only) | Same menu; picking navigates at once |
| 1 | No permission (no View projects) | The editor answers `no-access` and the header shows only the wordmark (`ProjectEditor.tsx:290-294`), so there is no switcher |
| 2 | Owner, Office | Recent = the projects this membership opened, newest first, archived and benchmark left out, the open project left out (QP-1) |
| 2 | Field | As above, and a project no longer listed for them disappears from recent at once (scope read live, ARCH Row-level security `listed_project_ids`) |
| 2 | View-only | As Owner |
| 2 | No permission | `GET /api/projects/recent` answers 403; the menu is never shown |
| 3 | Owner or Office holding the lock | Pick → row shows "Saving…" → `stopEditing()` drains, checkpoints, releases → navigate. On failure the lock stays, the leave error with Retry shows, the menu cannot be closed while the save runs; once the failure shows, Escape closes it and he keeps editing with the lock |
| 3 | Office with a pending request | Pick → the request is cancelled (QP-2) → navigate |
| 3 | Field, View-only | Never hold the lock without Edit model (Q-0697/10); navigate at once |
| 3 | No permission | No switcher |
| 4 | Every role with the menu | Typing a term with no match shows "No projects match"; a failed recent or search request shows "Projects could not load" with Retry inside the menu |
| 4 | No permission | No switcher |

# EZD-105b · Owner-set password

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-105b-1, AC-EZD-105b-2, AC-EZD-105b-3, AC-EZD-105b-4 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:1110-1113`, stage-0)
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** auth, security, migrations, api, ui, testing
- **User-visible result:** On Settings → Users + permissions, an Owner presses "Set password" on a member's row menu or in the inspector. EZ Draft makes a 16-character password and shows it once with Copy. The member is signed out on every device and gets an email that their password was set.
- Phase: 7 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-11 · Status: questions
- Template: v2

## 1. What to build

Ticket row (`vault/tickets/phases/phase-01.md:14`): Scope "'Set password' in the S15 row More menu and the inspector for a member with the Owner preset (no settings_users needed); generates a 16-character password shown once with Copy; signs the member out on every device; emails the member that it was set; event_log row in the same transaction." / Done when "An owner sets a member's password, sees it once, the member is signed out everywhere and gets the email." / Depends on EZD-106, EZD-033 / Spec ref Q-0096 P3, P4, P5, P7, P10; Q-0695. The Stage-0 ACs AC-EZD-105b-1 to -4 replace the Done-when.

Design in one line: a POST route with no body checks the caller and the target inside one database function, makes the password on the server, sets it through the one narrow admin file, then a second database function ends the member's sessions and writes the event_log row in one transaction, and the member gets a company email. The same SQL predicate decides the route and the `canSetPassword` flag the screen reads, so the two cannot drift (rule 18; D3 (a)).

Order of the server steps, and why: (1) `owner_password_target` checks and returns the member's auth id; (2) the password is made; (3) `setMemberPassword` sets it in Auth; (4) `record_member_password_set` ends the sessions and writes event_log in one transaction; (5) the email goes out; (6) the route returns the password once. The event is registered but not emitted: its event_log row is the one written in step 4, so a later event-log sink cannot write a second row (AC-4 "an event_log row"; Q-0695 03 row 33). Auth is reached over HTTP, so step 3 cannot share a database transaction. If step 4 fails after step 3, the new password is known to nobody (it is not returned) and the member's old sessions stay until a retry. That is a safe state. The reverse order would log "password set" and end sessions when Auth then refuses the change. "In the same transaction as the change" (AC-4) is therefore the database part of the change: ending the sessions and the event_log row (Q-0695 row 65 leaves "how" to this plan; architecture "Password sign-in (EZD-033)" "For EZD-105b": ends the member's sessions).

| One predicate | `list_users` sets `canSetPassword` = `private.owner_password_refusal(m.id) is null` for every row; both public functions call the same function. No other code decides it | rule 18; D3 (a) |

## 7. Security review
security-review: yes. Areas: auth (a password set through the Auth admin API with the secret key on a request path; sessions ended), permissions (a write route with no permission switch, Owner preset checked in the database; a new `WRITE_PERMISSION_EXEMPTIONS` entry), data access (definer functions reading `auth.users` and other tenants' memberships), API (new POST route), migrations (three functions, one redefinition, grants).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier yes · security-reviewer yes.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
high: a secret-key Auth call on a request path, two definer functions with tenant, caller and target checks, a fixed step order across Auth and the database whose failure states must stay safe, session ending and a same-transaction audit row (PROCESS.md section 4). Recount without the one-line harness edits (code-reviewer phase 7 finding 6): 20 files, the 15 Build steps (one of them, `database.types.ts`, generated) plus the 5 new test files (`owner-password.db.test.ts`, `owner-password.test.ts`, `[id]/password/route.test.ts`, `set-password-dialog.test.tsx`, `e2e/settings-users-password.spec.ts`); 21 new tests. Not counted: E1 to E4 (one list entry each in 4 harness files) and E5, E6 (a `canSetPassword: false` field or an `onSetPassword={vi.fn()}` prop added to existing test literals, no expected value changed). Neither count is over the limit (PROCESS.md section 6 "Ticket size": over 20 files or over 25 tests; Josh 2026-10-22), so no split. Test-author Opus 5.5, builder Opus 5.5.

  - EZD-105c (the narrow admin file, `app/src/server/auth/admin-auth.ts`; AC-EZD-105b-4). Not covered by "EZD-106"; add EZD-105c to `depends_on` (Q-0732 (a)).
  - EZD-109, the ticket that creates `event_log`, `private.write_event_log` and `eventLogIp` (Q-0720 (c), Q-0734 (a): built before EZD-105b). Add it to `depends_on` (Q-0732 (a)).
  - EZD-105d (creates `UserMoreMenu.tsx`, Q-0722 (a)); reached through EZD-106b, which depends on it.
  - EZD-016a (browser harness; this plan has a visual checklist; done).
  - Done: EZD-101 (`role`, `user_permission`), EZD-102 (`requireApiSession`, write scan U8), EZD-007c (`createSessionClient`), EZD-008a (`sendEmail`, stub outbox), EZD-015b (`useToast`, `StateButton`), EZD-018 (`end_user_sessions` pushes `session.ended`), EZD-022 (event registry), EZD-108 (`Menu`, password email pattern), EZD-133 (money route harness), EZD-346 (same-origin walk).
- Questions this plan follows besides its own: Q-0696 (escalated design), Q-0720 (c), Q-0722 (a) (both answered-agent).

## 10. Open questions
- **Q-0731 (answered-agent, (a)):** Which members may an Owner set a password for? Q-0096 P4 says "any member", but Q-0094's EZD-105b list (as `vault/plans/EZD-033.md:52` records it) says "never another admin", and no source says whether a deactivated member counts. Options: (a) active members with a confirmed account only, never one with the Owner preset or holding `settings_users`, never yourself, never one with a membership in another company (this plan is written for (a)); (b) as (a), and deactivated members too; (c) any active or deactivated member except yourself and other-company members (Q-0096 P4 read literally). Recommended (a): the narrowest set, and an Owner cannot take over a peer who can change everyone's access.
- **Q-0732 (answered-agent, (a)):** This plan calls names from three tickets whose plans are not written yet: EZD-105c (`setMemberPassword` goes into its narrow secret-key file), the ticket that creates `event_log` (Q-0720) and EZD-106b (`UserMoreMenu`). Options: (a) those planners adopt the names in section 3 "Required from" rows: `app/src/server/auth/admin-auth.ts`; `private.write_event_log(p_action text, p_object_type text, p_object_id uuid, p_details jsonb, p_ip inet)` and `eventLogIp(headers: Headers): string | null` in `app/src/server/events/event-log.ts`; `UserMoreMenu` in `app/src/components/settings/users/UserMoreMenu.tsx`. Also add EZD-105c and the event_log ticket to this ticket's `depends_on`. (b) This ticket waits in `questions` until those plans exist, then is re-validated against their section 3.
- **Q-0733 (answered-agent, (a)) (design):** No board shows the Set password dialog (Q-0696). Should pressing Set password first ask, since it signs the member out everywhere? Options: (a) the dialog opens on a confirm step ("Set a password for {name}", what will happen, Cancel and Set password), then shows the password with Copy and Done (this plan is written for (a)); (b) pressing Set password makes the password at once and the dialog opens showing it. Recommended (a): it cannot be undone, and Project Delete also asks first (S01 Controls).

## 1. What to build

Ticket row (`vault/tickets/phases/phase-01.md:17`): Scope "event_log (actor, action, object, at, ip) and a write helper used by permissions, invites, locks, approvals, issues and deletes." / Done when "A permission change writes a row with actor and IP." / Depends on EZD-005, EZD-106 (dropped: Q-0734 (a); `depends_on` is EZD-005a, EZD-005b, EZD-022, EZD-101, EZD-006) / Spec ref "Data model · event_log; Non-functional · Security". The columns, the write rules and the "same transaction" split are Q-0695 (`vault/spec/decisions/03-data-model.md:33`), which overrides the 03c row's five columns.

Design in one line: one append-only table, two `private` SQL writers that other definer functions call inside their own transaction, one gated `public` RPC for the default sink, and one server sink that writes every emitted event the per-event rule map marks `sink`. Built in this order because the phase 7 tickets that change permissions, roles, members and invites call the writers from their first commit (Q-0720 (c), confirmed by Q-0734 (a): built before EZD-105a, EZD-105b, EZD-106a, EZD-107a and EZD-129).

Three paths write a row:
- **Same transaction (AC-3).** A definer function that changes permissions, roles, members, project scope or invites calls `private.write_event_log(...)`. That function takes the tenant and actor from the token claims. A flow with no tenant claim yet calls `private.write_event_log_as(...)` with explicit ids: invite acceptance, a job, a system action. A failed write raises, so the change rolls back (Q-0695: "write their row in the same transaction as the change").
- **Default sink (AC-3).** `emit()` hands every event to `defaultSinks`. `eventLogSink` looks up `EVENT_LOG[name]`. On `sink` it calls `rpc('log_event', ...)` with the signed-in user's session. A failure is reported with `reportError` and never thrown, so the action that already committed stands (Q-0695: "reports a failed write and never undoes the action").
- **System (AC-4).** `private.write_event_log_as(action, tenant, null, ...)` stores actor null, actor name null and ip null (Q-0695 "null for system"; Q-0697 "An auto release has actor system and IP null").

### Data flow
| Hop | From | To | Exact name |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | route or server action | emitter | `emit(name, payload, ctx)` (`app/src/server/events/index.ts`) |
| 2 | emitter | sink | `eventLogSink(event)` |
| 3 | sink | rule map | `EVENT_LOG[event.name]` → `sink` / `transaction` / `none` |
| 4 | sink | request headers | `requestIp()` → `eventLogIp(await headers())` |
| 5 | sink | database | `createSessionClient().rpc('log_event', { p_tenant_id, p_action, p_object_type, p_object_id, p_details, p_ip })` |
| 6 | `public.log_event` | writer | `private.write_event_log_as(...)` → `insert into public.event_log` |
| 7 | sink | error report on failure | `reportError(new Error('event_log_write_failed'), { source: 'function', location: 'events.event_log', tags })` |
| 8 | same-transaction caller (EZD-106 and later) | writer | `perform private.write_event_log(...)` → `private.write_event_log_as(...)` |
| 9 | sign-in | writer | `link_app_user()` → `private.write_event_log_as('user.joined', …, null)` |

security-review: yes. Areas: migrations · data access · auth (`link_app_user` is redefined) · API (`public.log_event` RPC, gated, authenticated only).

## 7. Security review
security-review: no. No auth, permission, data access, money, API or migration. The new code reads plan files, which sandboxed units can write; that text only decides which `plan <T>` unit or wait comes next, for ticket IDs taken from `tickets.json` (never from the plan), so it gains no power the plan files do not already have (L-047: plan text is data). If the gate prints a SECURITY FLAG for the `.claude/` edits, the orchestrator dispatches security-reviewer.
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer always · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier no · security-reviewer no.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
Medium: launcher-wide scheduling and lint rules with exact texts, but no database, app code or `scripts/run.mjs` change. Test-author: Sonnet 5.5 at medium effort. Builder: the orchestrator in fix mode (dispatch, 2026-11-11).

Every test title starts with `EZD-224b` inside a top-level `describe` titled `EZD-224b …`, so the phase 6 gate scope runs them (ARCH "Test scope (Q-0006)"). Nothing else is added. Ticket and dependency IDs are checked against a fixed form before any path is built (C-Dep, C-Ledger), and HEAD is read only through `readHead`, which reads tracked paths only (`vault/tools/contract_check.mjs:45-74`). If the gate prints a SECURITY FLAG for the `.claude/` edits, the orchestrator dispatches security-reviewer.
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer always · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier no · security-reviewer no.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
Medium: launcher-wide scheduling and lint rules plus one read-only check script reusing the EZD-383 parser, all with exact texts, but no database, app code or `scripts/run.mjs` change. Test-author: Sonnet 5.5 at medium effort. Builder: the orchestrator in fix mode (dispatch, 2026-11-11).

## 9. Dependencies
- **EZD-384 (part a; merged on develop as bdd94b3a, STATUS `ready` until its ledger step records it done).** Re-validated 2026-11-11 against develop HEAD cc2d7f44 (sections 1, 3, 4, 9): every section 3 `(exists)` row it created is at HEAD (`PLAN_STEPS`, `planStep`, `planStepFor`, `scripts/process/plan-brief.test.mjs`, `scripts/ledger/plan-steps.test.mjs`); the Decided rows name the merged functions (`archProblems`, `briefLint`, `fullLint`, `legacyLint`, `qpProblems`, `briefRowProblems`, `headerOf` in `plan_lint.mjs`; `planStepFor`, `stage1` (variable `s1` in the loops), `planStepProblems`, `questionsWork`, `trackProblems`, `withTrack`, `report` in `next_ticket.mjs`) with their line numbers; every Old text occurs once at HEAD; Connections line numbers are at cc2d7f44. No test value or behaviour of this plan changed.
- **EZD-383 (done, 34026da0):** `checkContract`, `readHead`, `paramCount`, `cellPath`, `blockTables`, `ROOT`, `readyProblems`, `checkConnections`, `planV2`, `initRepo`; every such `(exists)` row in section 3 is at HEAD.

Splitting the plan into design and code-bound units gives each its own 100 turns.

### Risks

| A ticket merged after cc2d7f44 moves a line or an Old text this plan cites | this plan's Old texts and Connections rows | yes (connections_check at ready) | re-check the Old texts with `grep -F -c` before the build (section 9 re-validation) |

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-135-1, AC-EZD-135-2, AC-EZD-135-3 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md:1091-1093`; `tickets.json` EZD-135b `acs`)

- **Areas:** ui, api, testing, security

## Brief

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plain words | Build the Settings → System status page on EZD-135's data: four cards in the Settings shell (Job failures with 50 per page, Webhook failures, Last off-site backup, Last restore drill with a Failed mark when the drill failed), an empty state on each card, the no-access line for a user without the switch, and change the job-failed and webhook-failed alert emails' button to open `/settings/system-status` |

### Failure and edge cases
| Function or action | Case | Behaviour | What the user sees |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| card load | route answers non-200 (400, 401, 403, 500) | `throw new Error('system_status_load_failed')` | that card's `InlineError` "Couldn't load this section." with Retry; the other cards unaffected |
| card load | 200 with a body that is not JSON | `res.json()` rejects | as above |
| card load | offline (`fetch` rejects) | rejects | as above; Retry reloads that card |
| Retry | pressed twice fast | `useAsync` aborts the earlier run and keeps the newest (EZD-015a, `use-async.ts:17-26`) | skeleton, then data or the error |
| Next / Previous | double click before the reload | each click calls `onPage(data.page ± 1)` from the reply on screen, so both clicks ask for the same page | the next page once |
| Next / Previous | page change while the previous fetch is pending | the new `load` identity aborts the old fetch (`use-async.ts:18`) | the newest page |
| table load | `rows: []`, `total > 0`, `page > 1` (rows went away) | sets that card's page to `Math.ceil(total / 50)`, which loads once more | the last page |
| table load | `total === 0` | empty text | `No failed jobs in the last 30 days` / `No webhook failures` |
| table body | `total` exactly 50 | no pager (shown only when `total > 50`) | 50 rows, no pager |
| table body | null `error` or `ref` | `—` | a dash |
| `BackupsBody` | `files` or `dbDump` null | `not_recorded` | `Not recorded yet` |
| `DrillBody` | `restoreDrill` null | `drill_empty` | `No restore drill recorded yet` |
| `DrillBody` | `status` `failed` | Failed mark after the line | `… Failed` in red |
| `formatBytes` | 999, 1000, 999949, 999950, 1500000000000 | `999 B`, `1.0 KB`, `999.9 KB`, `1.0 MB` (rounding moves up a unit), `1.5 TB` (TB is the last unit) | as text |
| page | `settingsPermissionContext()` answers `'failed'` | `return null` | the layout's `SettingsLoadError` |
| alert email | `job_failed` or `webhook_failed` | link `appOrigin(env) + '/settings/system-status'` | "Open EZ Draft" opening System status |
| alert email | `error` kind | unchanged (Sentry link or bare origin) | as before |

A deleted file counts. `--no-ext-diff --no-textconv`: no diff driver from the worktree runs in the unsandboxed merge. | AC-EZD-385-2 ("the squashed diff", ticket Scope); `scripts/process/` reviewers' diff form `git -C <worktree> diff develop...HEAD` (`.claude/skills/build-ticket/dispatch.md:22`); `vault/tools/trusted-git.mjs:110` |

Node built-ins only.` / `//   node vault/tools/merge_check.mjs <plan> [--root <dir>]   MERGE CHECK OK \| SKIP \| FAIL (n) and one problem per line \| ERROR` / `// Exit 0 OK or SKIP (a v1 plan), 1 FAIL, 2 usage or a read error (fails closed, L-059). scripts/unit-steps.mjs merge runs it.` Imports: `lstatSync`, `readFileSync`, `realpathSync` from `node:fs`; `path` from `node:path`; `fileURLToPath` from `node:url`; `templateVersion` from `./plan_lint.mjs`; `ROOT`, `HeadError`, `readHead`, `contractRows`, `cellPath`, `isRepoPath`, `exportedNames`, `runCli` from `./contract_check.mjs`; `checkConnections` from `./connections_check.mjs`; `trustedGit`, `TrustedGitError` from `./trusted-git.mjs`. | `vault/tools/connections_check.mjs:1-10`; L-039 (each claim is what D-Merge enforces) |

Not `existsSync`, which also answers false on EACCES or a dangling symlink and so would skip the check (fail open). (2) `wt = path.join(root, '.claude/worktrees', t)`. # EZD-388 · Fix: the pan.test P2 iPad pan count fails under load (6 where 8 are expected)

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-388-1
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** scripts, testing, performance
- **User-visible result:** none in the app; the perf tool's own fixture test P2 stops going red when another lane runs a gate, so builds are no longer held up by it.
- Phase: 4 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-11 · Status: questions
- Template: v2
- Plan step: code-bound

## Brief
| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plain words | `scripts/perf/__tests__/pan.test.mjs` test `EZD-207c P2 wheel steps reach the page` runs the perf CLI on the fixture `/wheel.html` (each wheel step busy-waits 200 ms of wall time), and expects 8 counted long tasks on `long-tasks-during-pan:ipad` (pan.test.mjs:100-111). The iPad long-task row runs at a 4x CPU throttle (Q-0616 (a); docs/architecture.md "Performance check (EZD-017)", Benchmark pan) and counts a task only when cpu × 4 − ms × 3 > 50 (D-Split, Q-0623 (a); `splitTasks` in `scripts/perf/trace-tasks.mjs:92-97`). When another lane's gate runs, the Mac takes CPU away from the 200 ms task: by Q-0623's own cost line, one task preempted 38 ms or more falls under the line, becomes a wait, and P2 counts 6 or 7 instead of 8 (EZD-372 STATUS note, D-Runs gate 4, 2026-11-10). The ticket finds whether the load sensitivity is in the count, in the D-Split rule, or in the fixture's margin, and makes P2 hold 8 under load without a retry, a loosened count or a weaker check (ticket Scope; CLAUDE.md rules 16, 17). The same fix must keep I2 (`/wait.html`, a pure wait is never counted, pan.test.mjs:197-216) and EZD-356 T1 (8 tasks listed, pan.test.mjs:144-165) passing. |
| ACs | AC-EZD-388-1 |
| Screens | none |
| Tables | none |
| Routes | none |
| Files (estimate) | 9 |
| Tests (estimate) | 12 |
| Split | no |

## 1. What to build
The diagnosis is in section 2 ("Diagnosis"): the load sensitivity is in the D-Split rule, not in the count and not in the fixture's margin. The fix moves the iPad long-task pan row to a new unthrottled profile `ipad-cpu` and counts the trace's own main-thread tasks by CPU time × 4 there. **These code-bound blocks are written for Q-0737 option (a), the planner's recommendation; Q-0737 is still open.** If it is answered (b) or (c), this plan goes back to step code-bound before any build (section 9).
